description: Award-winning online retailer of equine supplements & care products, pet products, flea treatments and wormers. Established 15 years; Supplement Solutions prides itself on providing excellent customer service and helpful advice from its team of friendly Supplement Specialists.

records.title: Brilliant company for all supplement supplies…
records.text: Brilliant company for all supplement needs for my horses. I would recommend their worming programme, keeps me up to date and ensures I don't either under or over worm the neddies. It is a pity you don't do prescription supplies, would be useful. Lovely helpful staff, and the deliveries are prompt and a treat to open!!!

records.title: Always a pleasure to shop here
records.text: Always a pleasure to shop here, so much choice of quality goods and knowledgeable advice if needed.

records.title: Fab company to order from
records.text: I would definitely recommend ordering from this company. I got my parcel today (Christmas Eve) in less than 24 hours of ordering it on the 23rd December. Always great service. Hope you all at Supplement Solutions have a lovely Christmas 🎄 😊

records.title: Excellent!
records.text: Excellent range of products, easy to use website and ordering process. Fast delivery with a little treat in the box as well!I always love buying from Supplement Solutions, it feels like I know the team!

records.title: Order always arrives very quickly
records.text: Order always arrives very quickly, great products at a good price

records.title: Just a very fast and efficient service
records.text: Just a very fast and efficient service. You do promotions shame that the calmer I  buy from you is never on promotion. Buy a great service all the same.

records.title: The Best Hat Fitting Experience
records.text: The most thorough caring hat fitting we’ve ever had, and 5 children we’ve had lots!! The first place that’s actually had a hat that fits our youngest daughter properly.  The colour my daughter wanted wasn’t in stock but only took 1 week to arrive and a phone call as soon as it had. Amazing customer service with amazing products won’t go anywhere else for hats again after trying here. Thankyou!

records.title: Fantastic company huge range on all…
records.text: Fantastic company huge range on all products but for me  what makes this my number one choice always is the lovely bubbly helpful staff ❤️

records.title: Excellent service from supplement…
records.text: Excellent service from supplement solutions as always. Slight issue with delivery company and the girls sorted it in no time and it arrived the following day.

records.title: Easy ordering
records.text: Easy ordering. Product was delayed form the suppliers. A representative supplement solutions contacted me to advise of the delay. Product was delivered on the correct date and i was advised when it was going to be delivered each step of the way.The product is extremely good. My horse is very susceptible to laminitis being a good doer puts on weight, just by looking at grass. This combined with restricted gazing and part of a balance diet gives my horse the right amount of minerals/protein that they require to help control laminitis

records.title: A utterly fabulous team and company
records.text: A utterly fabulous team and company, competitive prices and great customer service. The only reason they don’t get 5* is not even their fault but as an overseas customer post Brexit……Other than that they’re the best, which is why I’ve been a customer for many years and hope to be so for many more.

records.title: Great offer but didn’t arrive for over…
records.text: Great offer but didn’t arrive for over a week

records.title: I love you guys
records.text: I love you guys! The 4* is only because I live outside the UK and getting your products here……it’s a bit of an odyssey. And so I now don’t get those little treats you used to surprise me with 😢, but your company is great! Great selection, prices and sales! And your customer service is a 10* all of its own!!! Me and my brood are devoted fans 🥰

records.title: An exemplar company
records.text: The only reasons there are not 5*s is there was no treat in with my order 🤭 and following brexit getting an order out to me is more expensive and can no longer be delivered to my home. Despite this I am happy to pay more and again on arrival and travel to collect because the company and its personnel are honestly second to none x

records.title: Disappointing post delivery
records.text: The service i was given was excelent and the only reason i did not give 5 Stars is because the post after paying for guaranteed next day delivery my package was still in the post office. Sophia in the office who helped me was amazing and definitely i will order again.

records.title: Efficient & helpful service
records.text: Efficient & helpful service. Only criticism I have is it doesn’t give an estimated date for results….Only…may be delayed due to staff absence!!??Hence 4 stars

records.title: Very easy to order and delivery was…
records.text: Very easy to order and delivery was next day which was great, yet to find out if the supplement helps though

records.title: The product was recommended by my vet…
records.text: The product was recommended by my vet as a ear cleaner for my rabbits. Unfortunately the instructions are somewhat lacking.

records.title: Updated promptly when delay with…
records.text: Updated promptly when delay with product ordered and alternative offered- - fast delivery nonetheless

records.title: My first time with you
records.text: My first time with you . Product seems to be good. Excellent service. Easy website to use

records.title: Quick response on questions and a good…
records.text: Quick response on questions and a good bargain.

records.title: Promptly received and to easy to…
records.text: Promptly received and to easy to communicate with

records.title: love you guys!
records.text: What bad can I say about a company that sends me chickpea and sweets when I make an order?! The product choice is great and the prices are good (I monitor the sales like a hawk!)If I had a single gripe it would be the cost of p&p to current destination (to my home was lost with the advent of the beloved BREXIT 🥺) please let me know if p&p to Spain is ever resolved 🙏🏼🙏🏼

records.title: First order went well
records.text: Helpful team. order went well.

records.title: Good service and prompt delivery
records.text: Date of experience: 21 September 2023

records.title: Excellent prices and speed of delivery
records.text: Excellent prices and speed of delivery. Green credentials nearly perfect. Little sweetie very nice, but would give it up if you could find a replacement for the plastic top and bottom packaging. Cardboard box great and potato starch infill ideal it’s just that one more thing…..

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service, excellent products, especially like being able to buy Pro Feet pellets in large quantities, would it be possible to do this for Muddy Marvel 7 day mud away, such a good product?A couple of very small quibbles, the Annual strategic worming programme was advertised with a weight tap and "gift", neither of which were included and your advert online offered a discount code, which I looked for but must have missed while going through the checkout process until it was too late, it didn't seem obvious, so having gone for quite a large spend I was a bit miffed to miss out! Probably my fault?

records.title: Very professional Company
records.text: Very professional Company.  This is the first time I have placed an order with Supplement Solutions.  I had a problem with their website (which could just have been me...) so I called them direct to place an order.  The lady who took my details was very efficient and already had my details from the website.  The order was despatched and arrived within 24 hours of placing the order.  Exceptional service, would definitely recommend and will be a returning customer.  Only dropped one star due to the issue with the Website - next time, I am confident this will be a 5 star rating.

First delivery from the team was incredible! Prompt and at a very competitive price. Second order, we’re having a few issues with delivery, but do honestly believe I’m in the minority that have had this issue.

records.title: Wouldn’t buy this product again
records.text: Packaging was way over the top such a huge box for a tiny product! Product itself is not well thought out at all and I ended up buying a human nasal dispenser pirateze which worked much better

records.title: The price was competetive
records.text: The price was competetive.  The purchase was simpleThe delivery was quick - Would have every confidence in using this supplier again Too much/many polystyrene 'wotsits' used in packaging - could have used shredded paper, better for recycling

records.title: Very fast delivery many thanks but one…
records.text: Very fast delivery many thanks but one item did not have a great expiry date left on it.

records.title: Big promise of free shipping that…
records.text: Big promise of free shipping that doesn't apply to NI. Why why why????

records.title: I'm sure it will be fine when it gets delivered!
records.text: As my order hasn't arrived, and is now nearly two weeks late, due to issues with the delivery company, I can't really review anything.

records.title: Speedy delivery and fast dispatch but…
records.text: Speedy delivery and fast dispatch but didn’t receive any communication regarding my order until the courier emailed me. Sort the communications out and the service would be fab

records.title: I have never had a problem with…
records.text: I have never had a problem with Supplement Solutions before, but on this occasion, after placing my order, I was told one of my items was not in stock but that it would be with me in a few days. Two weeks later, I still haven’t had my product, and had to chase again. I am assured it will be with me in a few days. I understand these things happen sometimes but I feel I should have been notified they didn’t have my item in stock before checkout and payment. My horse has now been without his supplement (which is very important to help manage a condition in his back legs) for 2 weeks. I have now shelled the money out again and ordered from a different supplier and my product will be here tomorrow.

records.title: The donkey food was surrounded by non…
records.text: The donkey food was surrounded by non recyclable packaging, a type of bubble wrap. Another bit of rubbish for the landfill sites. Why not chopped paper or cardboard?

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: I was disappointed to find out, after selecting to pay £15 priority delivery, that they would only send the goods once their own stocks were replenished. I expected they would have the goods in stock but obviously not. Compared to other suppliers I buy from regularly this is a very expensive delivery charge and quite a slow turnaround time. I only went with them as I needed the product urgently and it looked like they could get it to me the fastest but unfortunately this was not the case. The courier service they use didn’t have any updates once the parcel arrived in France. So I had no idea when to expect delivery, something I have never experience with other courier services that I use regularly. I think £15 for such poor service is extortionate. I won’t buy from this company again even though the price for the products was quite good.

records.title: Delivery time
records.text: Ordered my item for our dog as it states Royal Mail 24/48  As she was running out and 48 hrs at latest was fine  but it took a week to arrive,

records.title: Stock level updates slow
records.text: I ordered a supplement via the website on the 18/5 that I was subsequently told was out of stock.  I wasn’t contacted until the 25/5, so didn’t know until then that it was out of stock.  I understand that the stock availability might be down to the manufacturer, but surely supplement solutions would have known that they had sold a product they didn't physically have.  The communication was professional and courteous, and I was offered the option to cancel my order or go for an alternative product.  I opted to wait as there wasn’t a suitable alternative, but this took a further few weeks (their communication suggested that they hoped to receive and ship the week after emailing me, again I understand the supply is down to the manufacturer, not the retailer, but I received no further updates on wait times).   Had I been contacted when I placed the order to let me know it was out of stock, I could have tried to source the product or a similar alternative elsewhere.  That’s the reason for not giving a higher star rating as I’d have liked to have been made aware of the product being out of stock much sooner, and I would have liked to have been updated as the wait time was extended.

records.title: Good product but v slow to post out
records.text: Good product but v slow to post out. Didn’t receive item until nearly 2 weeks after paying. However competitive in price

records.title: Since Brexit the orders are complicated…
records.text: Since Brexit the orders are complicated and expensive. Please think of a solution to make purchases from the EU easier and cheaper again.

records.title: 3 weeks for delivery and brexit customs…
records.text: 3 weeks for delivery and brexit customs by Italians Job are so bad!Good items but bad shipping policy

records.title: The containers were much smaller than…
records.text: The containers were much smaller than the old one with the grauels, not as good value.

records.title: Having used supplement solutions for…
records.text: Having used supplement solutions for years I've never had an issue previously but you only know how good a company is when things go wrong. On this occassion the product was clearly faulty however it took 3 phone calls, 3 emails and a working week to get a refund of £7, I was made to feel like I might ve trying rip the company off which I thought was really poor from a longstanding  customer who has spent considerable sums with this company

records.title: The clippers don’t work properly and…
records.text: The clippers don’t work properly and didn’t from the first switch on. The solution given is to speak to the manufacturer, when they should be sent back to yourselves and replaced. I now have a horse that needs clipping and clippers that are faulty

records.title: Awful delivery, excellent products
records.text: What I bought was excellent. The 2 stars are for the Parcelforce service. They never left a card, their automatic telephone service never registered my request and it is impossible to contact them.

records.title: Delivery took almost a week
records.text: Delivery took almost a week. After messaging to say it was meant to be a 24/48hour delivery and that I’d had a dispatch email 5 days before there wasn’t much of a care to chase. Just hope it turns up soon….

records.title: Nothing wrong with the product but it…
records.text: Nothing wrong with the product but it took so long for it to arrive. I chose the standard delivery but it still took 10 days for my purchase to arrive.

records.title: Took FAR too long
records.text: Took FAR too long, other sites are cheaper and faster!

records.title: Item arrived damaged and leaking into…
records.text: Item arrived damaged and leaking into soaked packaging including exterior box. Advised by postman when he delivered. Photos sent immediately to company, who offered to send me a new spray head, and 5% off my next order, but no compensation for the actual spilled product or offer to replace. Had to send a further 2 emails to get a refund of product only (no post refund even though it was effectively a failed delivery). After refusing the offer of a spray head and future discount voucher, they initially wanted me to repackage a leaking item to return to them to get a refund, which obviously was stupid as was only going to leak more. Not good customer service on this occasion.  Order value was under £15 including postage, just can't understand why they were so reluctant having clearly shown them the product was not acceptable as it had leaked (was to be a gift for a friend).

records.title: NEVER USE THESE SCUM THEY HAVE NO INTEGRITY
records.text: Avoid these people they are insincere and have no idea about customer service whatsoever. They are extremely rude, ignorant, extremely obnoxious. They fail to deliver items and fail to give refunds so court action will be taken against them to recover the money they have effectively stolen. I will never use these thieves again. Beware they do not package your products properly with enough protection in transit as I have constantly had ripped and torn boxes from them in the past.

records.title: Really poor experience
records.text: Really poor experience. Placed an online order, money taken. Order cannot be fulfilled and am now waiting for a refund of £195. Have had to place an order elsewhere. The company shouldn’t take the money if they can’t fulfil the order.

records.title: 4 weeks on order still not here ?
records.text: Sadly I ordered over a month ago a lot of vitamins and minerals as I run a rehabilitation and retirement livery , it was not cheap and a month on I’m told it still will be another week I won’t order from this company again

description: A wide range of yoga supplies, including yoga mats, equipment, mat bags, bolsters, cushions and accessories. We are the supplier of choice for studios, teachers and yoga practitioners throughout the UK and Europe. High-quality, eco-friendly & organic w...

records.title: Fabulous blue yoga cushion!
records.text: Fabulous blue coloured yoga cushion and such great quality! Every step of the customer journey has been brilliant from an easy to navigate website, swift delivery with a personal thank you for your order email. Love everything about this family run business ❤️

records.title: I would buy again without hesitation
records.text: I didn't even know what a yoga bolster was (it was a Christmas request) but when this arrived it was beautifully made with a stout, heavy cotton outer (I got the orange, spelt-filled bolster) and a fantastic texture. It arrived very swiftly, packaged without plastic. I would buy it again without hesitation. The recipient loves it.

records.title: A simple an straight forward process
records.text: A simple an straight forward process. Products delivered to schedule.

records.title: Lovely experience dealing with this company, love supporting small business enterprise who actually care about their customers! Well done to all at Ekotex
records.text: I haven’t opened this yet as it is a Christmas present for myself but I just want to commend this company on their engaging communication and response to queries. I will add my review when I use the product but I have a strong feel that I will be very satisfied. I love a small company going the extra mile!

records.title: Prompt delivery, no plastic wrappings. …
records.text: Everything arrived quickly and looks to be exactly what was wanted. So pleased it was all made sustainably. Not used yet so send us another survey in a year’s time and we’ll be able to comment on how well things wear.

records.title: Nice quality
records.text: I've ordered quite a few things from Ekotex over the past few years - eye pillows, bolsters etc. all have been really nice quality and colours.Email communication has always been pleasant and helpful, and items have arrived packaged very well.Would definitely recommend :)

records.title: What an amazing little company this is
records.text: What an amazing little company this is. I ordered a Zafu for daughter as a Xmas present it arrived well packaged is very good quality. I'm sure I'll be placing more orders in the near future.

records.title: Supporting small business!
records.text: Ordering was easy and received a BF discount. Item arrived quickly and beautifully packaged. It’s a gift so I haven’t opened it as didn’t want to spoil the lovely packaging. If the item is as good as the packaging and the the service received I’m sure it will be great. Nice to buy from a small family business too! Always makes you feel good.

records.title: Supporting better businesses
records.text: This was my second purchase from Ekotex Yoga and I just love this family-run business and their products!Their products are made with care and environmental awareness and the styles and materials resonate with my preferences and values. Hope the eye pillows are available soon!

records.title: PERFECT IN EVERY WAY !!!
records.text: I’ve made several purchases from this company. The products are of a very high quality. Delivery is prompt and well packaged. The customer service is excellent.

records.title: This is a Christmas present sent…
records.text: This is a Christmas present sent directly to my daughter. I am not able therefore to give feedback on the product but the ordering process was easy and delivery as stated.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: Requested click & collect. Confusingly all the update emails referred to my purchase "being delivered". Had to message them to confirm pick up. Package was then one eye pillow short. However extra pillow quickly delivered and love the product. Very clean simple cotton with lovely scent of lavender from the filling. I’ll use them again.

records.title: Good service from first contact
records.text: Good service from first contact. Needed to call in before ordering as I had a query about stock. Very helpful on the phone and delivery was quick. Items were beautifully packaged and in keeping with eco, natural materials. Just waiting for more stock to come in so I buy again from Ekotex.

records.title: Mindful Yin Kit
records.text: I ordered the Mindful Yin Kit from Ekotex Yoga and would like to thank them for the fast and reliable delivery and the very friendly customer service.The quality of the individual products is very good, with one reservation about the Earthling Yoga Mat.  After using it several times, I am not (yet) convinced of the mat's grip during asanas, but I hope that it will improve over time.

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order, choose and pay and I thought the delivery would be straightforward. However, despite being given a delivery slot and being home all day, the package was taken to a collection point 7 miles away.That was disappointing.The product is good quality, with the discount it compares well to other ethical yoga product suppliers.

records.title: Delivery of the yoga mat and yoga bolster was timely and the packaging excellent.
records.text: Delivery of the yoga mat and yoga bolster was timely and the packaging was excellent.  The colour of the bolster matched the colour on the website so that was a bonus too.  The yoga mat was thinner than I expected but otherwise the colour was perfect.  The guidance sent on care of both items was very helpful,  particularly for the yoga mat.  There are many exercise items on the website and other bolster covers are available too.  Great products available and I will be adding to my collection.  I recommend the items I bought.

records.title: Yoga leggings purchase
records.text: There wasn’t a great deal to choose from in Yoga wear, unfortunately.  However, the assistant did show me the leggings she was wearing and from her account on the fit and comfort of them I did purchase similar.

records.title: Great service starter kit arrived…
records.text: Great service starter kit arrived promptly Mat sticky my hands kept slipping any advice would be welcome

records.title: Lovely!
records.text: Great service from Ekotex again. Always well packaged and delivery came earlier than expected. Very happy with my zabuton cushion :-)

records.title: Good quality
records.text: So there was a few issues with stock availability however they were quick to email and swap colours of items, they did say I would receive a carry strap as compensation for the fuss unfortunately it didn't come within my order.The products themselves are fantastic no faults and good quality even with the issues I had, I have order an additional item from them as the where honest, quick delivery, good quality items and lovely customers support.

records.title: Order can amazing quick in just 3 days
records.text: Order can amazing quick in just 3 days, even though it was delivered second class! No plastic packaging in site and in perfect condition. However customer service is a bit rubbish. I rang loads about another order and didn't get a response, but I understand as they say they're only a small team so took that into consideration when rating them :)

records.title: I love the this mat - grippy not sticky
records.text: I love the this mat! The mix of rubber and ground pumice stone in the top layer creates grip without a stickiness, which I really like. I also like the way the pumice creates patterns in the rubber where your feet have been. It works equally as well on my house carpet as the hard surface in the local yoga studio. The only niggle I have, is that it could be a little longer. I am 5.9 and it comes up a little short at times during practice.

records.title: Lovely natural products that bring a sense of calm to your practices.
records.text: I love Ekotex products and the ethos behind them. I am enjoying practising yoga using natural products. I would say the Earthling Mat and the yoga blocks do have a strong smell, almost like tar, at first. But, I have gotten used to it. The eye pillow smells divine! And is perfect for calming the soul. The coolness of the Earthling Mat on your hands and feet during a session is such a refreshing experience. I will definitely shop here again.

records.title: Quick and easy and would recommend!
records.text: The ordering process was very easy and I received the bolster in a good amount of time. I love the colour and the texture - it's perfect for my yin practice.The only reason I didn't give this 5 stars is because I wrote out the delivery instructions in the order and the driver didn't bother following them - he left it with a random shop nearby instead of reading the label (my instructions were actually printed on the label on the box).

records.title: Late but good
records.text: I ordered some products that I knew were OOS but had a delivery date, this was then further delayed quite substantially (missing the birthday they were a gift for ☹️)which was annoying but they communicated well and I imagine it was just unfortunate.Lovely products once arrived, just as expected, very happy.

records.title: A real nice yoga Matt
records.text: A real nice yoga Matt.  It is a really good length I’m 5”5 and it is soft but also firm.  It doesn’t slide around during yoga and it rolled out almost flat after opening.   It has made doing yoga so much more comfortable rather than trying to do it on the carpet.  Was kept update to date from purchase to delivery and it came a day earlier than expected.  Also it Was nice to support a small new business.

records.title: Very efficient service
records.text: Very efficient service The mat is longer than I thought I like the fact it’s biodegradable I only used it once and the pink side is actually slippery, but overall I think it’s worth the money Let’s hope it will last years

records.title: super quick delivery.
records.text: super quick delivery.Obviously I had to pay dutys tax but that's not at all your problem - perhaps good to inform customers in Europe that that's going to happen.Also the blocks are fab, I actually prefer this thinner size, however, they are SUPER compact. I have another cork block which is a different brand and has a little more "give" to it which is a bit more comfortable to use. I use blocks a lot in my teaching for various things from lifting the ground closer, to myofascial support, to making asanas more challenging. So overall I'd rate it as a great block and love how it's manufactured in an environmentally conscious way but it is more compact and "harder" than I'd like.

records.title: Good quality thick mat
records.text: Good thick mat. Return information on reverse of  delivery note.I will keep the mat but it is helpful if return information is made very clear before you unpack the cellophane.Very good quality mat for cushioning.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, only thing is it would be great if an email was sent explaining that the parcel was ready for pickup and when and where (or how to arrange) to pick it up.

records.title: Really wanted to love it but ….
records.text: I use Ekotec mats at my yoga studio & decided to order my own because the 6mm mats there were perfect for both yoga & Pilates.  Sadly, the 6mm mats were no longer available so I chose a 5mm mat which I thought would be the next best choice.  It arrived very quickly & in perfect condition.  It has excellent grip but is so dense & hard that I have to use another mat underneath to pad it.  I was also so disappointed that this mat doesn’t have the iconic logo.

records.title: Too slippy!
records.text: Yoga mat arrived on time in lovely condition with a complementary chocolate. Unfortunately, although advertised as sticky mat I've found it to be the slippiest mat I've had! I've used it quite a few times in case it just needs wearing in but still slippy. I just use it as extra padding under another mat now.

records.title: Bit disappointed
records.text: Up to now I’ve been delighted with everything I have bought and the service I have received from the company. However I am a bit disappointed with the yoga mat. It’s a bit thin and a bit slippy

records.title: This strap for a yoga needs a Velcro fastening
records.text: This strap for a yoga mat would’ve been better with Velcro to hold it on as it’s hard to get it in the correct position and it falls off easily. Not great

records.title: Lovely quality and colour
records.text: Lovely quality and colour, but it’s much higher than my previous meditation cushion which I am finding tricky to adapt to. I think I’d prefer it slightly lower to the mat.

records.title: Quality is good but I wasn’t overly…
records.text: Quality is good but I wasn’t overly happy with the replacement sent in parcel without consulting me first

records.title: Too thin and too small to provide much…
records.text: Too thin and too small to provide much padding for backstands.

records.title: I ordered some cushions last week a…
records.text: I ordered some cushions last week a week ago and they made one attempt to deliver. Beware if you are not in on that first attempt as the goods will be returned. I have sent 3 emails to enquire about the delivery had no response or confirmation of refund

records.title: Wouldn’t recommend this product
records.text: I purchased The Recycled Sticky Yoga Mat. It has a strange slimy feeling to it more than sticky and doesn’t feel nice to use. After my first use the bottom of the mat stuck to my floor and the mat tore off in 3 places. I’m really disappointed in the quality of this mat and for all it’s sustainable composition it will probably end up in the bin very soon. My last mat lasted years and was also an eco mat. Emailed the company but haven’t heard anything back. Won’t be buying from them again.

records.title: Great products terrible delivery
records.text: Products are fantastic, really high quality. Unfortunately had a nightmare experience with the carrier meaning that the products purchased for my wife's birthday didn't arrive in time, even though they had received them well before. Really dissapointing will likely look elsewhere to purchase in future.

records.title: My yoga mat was delivered dirty and…
records.text: My yoga mat was delivered dirty and worn/ripped.

records.title: One of the worst yoga mats I've bought…
records.text: One of the worst yoga mats I've bought (and I've had a few!) I'm not a massively sweaty person, but there is no grip at all on my "grippy" Ekotex mat. In fact, my hands and feet slip so much it's dangerous and distracting. I can't even do a basic downward dog 😑 Total waste of money, but perhaps I should have known better as £19 is pretty cheap for a yoga mat. Would not recommend or buy again. Should be renamed the 'slippy mat'.

records.title: Ekotex Yoga used the Worst Delivery…
records.text: Ekotex Yoga used the Worst Delivery Service on the Planet - DPD - who simply left the parcel inside the front gate of the house and can't be bothered to ring the house bell - so it could easily be stolen as it is on a main road. They are LAZY B*STARDS, and I think that Ekotex Yoga are Highly Irresponsible. If I had known this beforehand I would NOT HAVE BOUGHT FROM THEM!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  Ekotex have said that they could use a different courier were I to order from them again, which is appreciated.  Nevertheless my experience of DPD has been built up over several months and nearly a dozen such LAZY, THOUGHTLESS DELIVERIES, which firms are very unlikely to hear about - the customer's actual experience.  I would not be at all surprised to find that DPD have an APPALLING CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

records.title: The yoga mat does not stop my hands…
records.text: The yoga mat does not stop my hands from slipping - hence the 1 star.The block and bolster were fine.  Delivery prompt and efficient

records.title: I still haven’t received my purchase a…
records.text: I still haven’t received my purchase a week after ordering it 😢

description:
Our mission is very simple - to offer the best value golf equipment in the game! Founded in 1996, we first started trading online in 2004 and have upheld the same unwavering commitment to offering the highest quality golf equipment, clubs, clothing, shoes and accessories available at industry-low prices ever since.
Our fundamental ethos is customer service. We strive to provide all our customers with the most thorough and helpful advice possible with the help of our PGA professional recommendations and expert staff knowledge. We actively encourage you to contact us where required through the channels below.
So whether you're thinking of upgrading to a new set of clubs, treating yourself to the latest electric trolley, or simply stocking up on essentials for the season, Snainton is here for you

records.title: Can’t recommend enough!

When they were delivered the extra club was missing, after they finally agreed that a club was ordered the told me that they would have to order it, no apology they said they would ring me to let me know how long it would take. I had to call them and was told 2 weeks. they rang me to let me know it had arrived and that it would be sent out 6 days later the the weekly collection was made. No attempt was made on their part to pay for a delivery outside their normal operation despite the wait I'd endured, No offer of a freebie by way of acknowledgment of their mistake and my inconvenience not even a sleeve of balls. Well I won't use Snainton Golf Scarborough again as clearly they don't know how to treat customers with respect

records.title: Ping or Snainton Golf Service issue - you choose
records.text: I have previously purchased from Snainton Golf, and impressed with their service and good customer attitude. I gave them 5 stars.Recently, I got a quote for an additional PING iron to supplement a set I had previously purchased. I provided the serial number code for the irons, agreed a price and informed by Snainton Golf that they would place the order with PING on the Friday, and they would get in touch when they arrived. (After the weekend).After waiting a week, (on the 2nd Friday) I had heard nothing, so phoned up Snainton Golf again, to be informed, that the order had been placed with PING, but they hadn’t put it on their system. But PING had agreed to Priority build the club and prioritise it so it would be shipped after the second weekend.After waiting another week, (on the 3rd Friday) and with no update from Snainton Golf, I had to call them again to establish the situation. They cleared blamed PING, saying the PING currently did not have the right length of the type of shaft to match my set, but said they could utilise a longer shaft, modify this and get it to me, within the week.I verbally cancelled the order with Snainton Golf, and placed the order with the Golf Pro at my local Golf Club. This was done on the following Tuesday, and PING delivered the club, within 4 days.Whilst Snainton Golf were the customer focused part of the supply chain, I am unsure who was really at fault, but listing this same report on both TrustPilot Accounts I have given 2 stars ★★ to Snainton Golf, as they should have been chasing my order throughout, and 4 stars ★★★★ to PING, as my custom fit irons have lowered my handicap, and they evidently need to aware of this failure of delivery to tighten up their supply chain situation with their multi-faceted supplier relationship.

From their first hop skip and jump to their first dip for the finishing line, you’re there for them every step of the way; for the casual players to the serious contenders, the fun seekers to the trophy chasers, the active to the athlete, for all ages, for all levels, for all that is great about being active.

description:
Elite Mountain Supplies was founded in Gloucestershire in 2010 as an independent online retailer for high quality trekking, camping, climbing and mountaineering equipment.
EMS is a UK company and all of our stock and staff are in the UK to provide you with fast deliveries & returns with friendly, knowledgeable customer support via email or telephone. As such, our customers have awarded us the maximum Five Stars for excellent customer service on Trustpilot’s independent customer feedback website.
Since 2010 we have delivered over sixty thousand orders and become one of the leading retailers for technical brands such as MSR, Petzl and Black Diamond. 
We spend our leisure time in the hills and mountains of the UK and Europe, which gives us practical experience and first hand knowledge of the equipment we choose to own and sell.

records.text: I bought 2 items from Elitemountainsupplies. Both arrived swiftly and in great condition so the service is good. My ratings is based on the items purchased which one is not really geared to British weather.The first one: MSR Hubba NX tent in green (1 person). The tent is lightweight and easy to set up, as advertised. However it is not built for British humid weather. The inner tent is mostly made of mesh. The top ceiling had an accumulation of humidity drops that trickled down the side on the mesh part and got my belonging on each side of me a bit wet. This happened over the 2 nights camping, one under the rain, the other was a dry night. I like the practicality of the tent but it is a major issue to have such large area of the inner tent being mesh. Also the free plastic under plastic sheet provided only covers the base of the tent and is very narrow. I give the tent 2 out of 5 stars.The 2nd one is the Thermarest X therm Max regular. This is an all round 5 stars. The mattress which has an R rating of 6.9 really isolâtes from the cold. I didn’t feel any humidity coming from the bottom despite rain coming down on my first night. The only downside is that I wished I had taken the largest version as I used my duvet as a blanket and my arms were falling on the side of the mattress. My own fault here. Please note that the mattress is slippery and makes noise when you move. Not an issue for me but might be for light sleepers.

description:
Canterbury of New Zealand was established back in 1904 when John Lane, Pringle Walker and Alfred Rudkin began producing woollen garments deep in the Canterbury Province of New Zealand.  Before long, they were making uniforms for the army during the First World War, and they earned themselves a reputation for manufacturing tough, durable kit.  So much so, the legendary All Blacks rugby team approached them to produce rugby attire in which they could play.

The rest as they say is history; Canterbury of New Zealand outfitted the All Blacks team for over 75 years and is now the largest dedicated rugby brand in the world.  Canterbury currently supplies kit to numerous high-profile national rugby teams; England Rugby and Ireland Rugby, as well as leading clubs such as Bath and Ospreys.  

The brand has its roots firmly in the southern hemisphere with its spiritual home in New Zealand. The Kiwi heritage strongly influences both the design of Canterbury product and the ethos of the company.

records.title: Great Teamwear and Equipment
records.text: Woodstock are a fantastic nationwide cricket bat and teamwear provider. We are a club of over 100 members, use Woodstock for teamwear and a number of our players use their batting equipment and we are delighted with the quality of the products. Johnno and his team do a brilliant job in ensuring that the products are right for our players and we are so happy to be supporting a local business trying to do right for the cricket community. Their initiatives for the 2024 season going forward being able to pay over 12 months, and supporting outstanding charitable causes through the purchase of their equipment is pioneering and should lead the way for other cricket equipment providers to enable this to the game. Cricket is often seen as an elitist sport and Woodstock are actively trying to change this for the better of our game in this country. As Head of Cricket at Farnsfield, I am proud to be partnering with a great local business like Woodstock and look forward to our partnership growing in the years to come.

records.title: Continued excellence
records.text: Always a great company to work with. Woodstock have provided our teamwear for a couple of years and it is excellent and I’ve been using the bats, as well as a full kit bag, for about 10 years. Great quality and fair pricing!

records.title: Class bats used them for years
records.text: Class bats used them for years. Johnno’s a great bloke trying to change the industry for the better.

records.title: Poor Customer Service
records.text: Ordering process was easy, hence the 3 stars. Trainers arrived and the material was very obviously discoloured and faded on the toe of one trainer. It looked like a blob of Bleach had fallen on them, so I returned them. Returns process seemed easy, I followed instructions that said to send signed for and to enclose their returns slip. When the refund came through, there was no refund of the original postage or the postage I paid to return. I contacted Lovell and initially they claimed not to have a returns note. I asked how they knew who to refund, because if they didn't get my returns note, how did they know who returned the trainers. Then they replied to say I should have contacted them for a returns label and they asked for photos of the damage (nothing on their returns policy to state about postage label or about taking photos). After a few emails back and forth, they've now deemed that the trainers are not faulty and therefore they will not refund the postage. So it is expected we accept a pair of trainers with a mark on the front!! I was going to reorder from Lovell, but have purchased elsewhere.EDIT: Thank you, I have received a refund for postage of original dispatch, but not postage paid to return the trainers. The return process followed was on the return note and there was no obvious mention of this being different for faulty goods on the paperwork. I'm also struggling, even now, to find a different process for faulty returns on the website.

records.text: I ordered gloves which did not arrive and were apparently lost by courier which was really disappointing and communication from the courier regarding this was non existent and required me to contact One Glove directly.Kallie's service in resolving the issue though was excellent though and her communication was prompt and helpful.

records.title: Poor padding quality
records.text: Good points: good grip, sticky Palm , comfy to wear.Bad point: unfortunately I have used the gloves 3 times and the palms have just fallen apart, I personally would not buy again. After the first use the padding started to wear even though I followed all the pre wash instruction and during game instructions . I did email the company but I was just told I had to expect some wear, I appreciate they are going to wear however not after 1 use.

records.title: Customer service non existent
records.text: Customer service non existent. No contact number to get it rectified quickly. Have to wait for an email. Gloves haven’t turned up and want to get them ASAP. Delivery isn’t free so paying for a service that hasn’t been provided. Brought last week due to needing them at the weekend no looks like won’t be here in time. Easy to buy and then hard to communicate with when you actually need helpEdit - got my gloves and had an acceptable resolution

records.title: Do your research
records.text: The shipment and gloves were good out of the box, unfortunately my gloves are torn up and not as grippy as they first were, after my first use of just cathcingn the ball the finger tips were ripped.

records.title: First pair of ONE Gloves for my son, and only.......
records.text: Bought a pair of gloves for my son. They were decent for the price. We quit purchasing gloves from here because of the lack of styles and design. All they have been offering is the same pair of gloves just different colors. Same cut, same wrist wrap etc. They need to turn the lights on in the brain storming room

records.title: The gloves are a 4 out of 5 but......
records.text: The glove are a 4 out of 5 as the spines keep breaking but the customer service is below average have been waiting almost 3 weeks for our 2nd replacement spines, my son from plays for the local youth team and is going out as a mascot this weekend would really like to show of his gloves infront of a home crowd.

records.title: Bought a pair for my son for his…
records.text: Bought a pair for my son for his birthday. They came faulty. Got hold of customer service. Customer service initially said they must have been tampered with. They also are taking 2 days to reply to each response. 12 days now and still no closer to getting sorted. Can see the gloves are quality but overall experience has been terrible

records.title: Poor customer service,poor responses…
records.text: Poor customer service,poor responses from the staff.Our gloves perished immediately they offered  a discount on the next purchase and then after I  suggested that at least they offer free shipping they added that on.If their product us so good why didn't they just send out a new pair.They even directed me to loads of their information to tell me that they perish immediately  but it doesn't say that it says after continuing use thay can perish quickly.For a 12 year old to wear these out in 3 weeks Really Poor customer experience

records.title: Customer service is shocking
records.text: This review is not about the gloves but the service. This company is impossible to get hold of. I ordered on a pair of gloves (which my boy loves) but immediately after ordering i was taken to a screen that said PAY NOW at the bottom. I assumed my order had not gone through properly so i clicked the button again. This instantly ordered another pair of the same gloves and the money was taken. There was not another basket to confirm it just takes your money. I instantly tried to get hold of this company and there is no way of speaking to anyone. Emails are not responded to....Customer service is shocking so make sure you know exactly what you want and don't get scammed into the extra pair like i did. Struggling to get a response to return the extra pair that i was scammed into buying.

records.title: Junior sized
records.text: Just ordered some one glove geo 3 AMJ…Just ordered some one glove geo 3 AMJ junior keeping gloves for my 8 year. Sized him according to the charts. Came upAs a 5, same size as his current gloves. These gloves are massive!! 2 inches spare on the finger length. I’m an adult man and can put these on. God knows where you have got your sizing from. If you are ordering these gloves for your child, I would recommend going down at least a size.Reply to one glove- stating they are reviewing their sizing.Thank you for the reply.  The issue I have is.As I was getting these personalised I put in extra work checking and sizing. I used both your website guidance and pro direct soccers, also other general guidelines on the internet as I knew these couldn’t be returned. I left the same feedback on PDS website pilot.  Who have offered a refund, exchange but doesn’t really help me! As these are personal I can’t return them.  I have no issue with the quality, actually impressed.  However they are completely unusable.  I tried to make him use them, but they just fall off and can’t catch anything due to the size. So I’m stuck with a pair of £50 keeper gloves that can’t be used due to bad sizing advice. I would love to send some images so you can see how far off these are v His current sells gloves. The size chart on the back of the glove still shows he should be a 5.I look forward to your response and if there is anyway this could be resolved.

records.title: Poor sizing guide, paid for return but not sent me a replacement. Currently £40 down!!!
records.text: Not been sent replacement gloves even though I have proof they were delivered back. Currently about £40 out of pocket and nothing to show for it. Followed size advice online and measured as advised, where still at least 2 sizes too big, they were ridiculous. Having already shelled out £3.99 delivery for expensive gloves I had to pay the same again to return them. Proof of delivery about a week ago but heard nothing. Emailed to find out what was going on but no reply. Regret using this company. AVOID.

records.title: Awful substandard quality
records.text: Just used my gloves for the 1st time in a game ,within 20min the palm split open ,across the entire glove .Never had a pair gloves so poor ,I train over 30 keepers and will definitely be advising the kids and parents to not waste their money ,stick to T1tan uhlsport or reusch .  Appropriate name ONE -USE ONCE NEVER AGAIN

records.title: Wore them twice and they are ripped…
records.text: Wore them twice and they are ripped already. Not happy , bought 4 pairs of these and 3 of them have ripped.. good grip for about 3 games and they it goes. Definitely won't be purchasing another pair!

records.title: Joke and Cowboy Company
records.text: No products available on website ( JOKE ) how can you run an online store and only  have 1 item and a few sizes in stock available ??Purchased a size 9 only the receive confirmation of size 11 ( Cowboys )Tried to email i received a response stating they only have size 11 or refund. My concern was my son would be without a pair of gloves for Monday school Foolsball Match.  Sent 3-4 emails after withing Working hours  and i was tottally ignored which was very concerning.They repied on Monday 7th Oct staing "release date for our new models is today - which is why you would have seen lower stock levels than usual the last few weeks. My question as a business owner " Why wait until all your stock has sold out. Also if your new stock release is today you must have stock in your wharehouse.  Why not post me my gloves?   I also requested i pick up the size 11 or them hand delivering as we are in the same town or according to their business address on googe in the next town which is not very far. (However their google address is another coampy -very bizzare). This would have demonstrated customer care and good costomer service.  I dont normally order from One glove but in the past when i have their was always and issue.I will never order from them and i would not recoommend any one ordering from this "Joke  & Cowboy Comany"  NO Wonder this comapny does not leave a Busineess number.MY SON IS STILL WITHOUT A PAIR OF GLOVES. What are you gonna to do about this " One Glove " ???

records.title: Waste of money. Do not wear well!
records.text: Used them for 3 weeks and about 8 times for grassroots football. Wore terribly. They went Bally and uncomfortable inside.First pair I had were ok.Customer service once’s interested.Don’t waste your money.  Nothing special Paid £55 and won’t be buying another pair:

records.title: Spent 70 euro on gloves after 1 wear…
records.text: Spent 70 euro on gloves after 1 wear they were very badly worn.When I complained customer service said thats what happens goalkeeper gloves and have refused to engage anymore with me.These gloves are not worth buying stay far away.

description: We stock over 5,000 of the latest & best cricket products as used by some of the world's greatest cricketers. With huge mega stores in Leeds and Sheffield.

records.title: Very fast service and amazing would…
records.text: Very fast service and amazing would recommend.

records.title: I am obliged to give this positive comment
records.text: I am obliged to give this positive comment to AllRounderCricket.com. I placed an order in the past around three years ago and i had very bad experience with this seller. They took more than 6 months to deliver my product. There was no customer care and no response to my calls and email. I got frustrated and provided a very bad and negative comment.This time (i took my chance again, not sure why), i place a new order again on friday and i have received the product by monday. Amazing. Also to be on safer side, i tried to contact the customer care to see if someone responds, and they responded quickly. That  gave me some confidence to place order.

records.title: After an initial disappointment with a…
records.text: After an initial disappointment with a pair of hockey shoes that I think were labeled with the wrong size I was pleased with the service that followed. the gentleman that called me was great really thorough and the replacement shoes arrived two days later.After a bumpy start they redeemed themselves.

records.title: Contrary to the reviews.
records.text: Contrary to the reviews.I was let down at short notice by another company and needed a full set of kit with next day delivery. A quick phone call to the Sheffield store who took my order number and then passed this directly to the warehouse so that the order could be shipped the same day. I couldn’t ask for better customer service, and both the store and warehouse went above and beyond - for reference, I’m an average cricketer, who didn’t spend a fortune - therefore my expenditure didn’t attract a different level of service. I would happily use these guys again, whilst I appreciate some may have had bad experiences I have nothing but positive to say.

records.title: Was looking for a specific pair of…Wicketkeeping Gloves
records.text: Was looking for a specific pair of keeping gloves that appear to be out of stock across the country. Dealt with Matt W who searched the warehouse and both stores and managed to find what I was after. Then did his best to get them sent next day via courier. Couldn't ask for better service, will 100% go back to All Rounder again in the future.

records.title: Fantastic service,Great product
records.text: A fantastic service from start to finish.All rounder supplied our club shirts for 3 senior teams. Macey was fantastic with her help and advice attention to detail with nothing too much trouble. The product proved to be an excellent quality and a very reasonable price.Will be using  AR again both personally and as a Club.

records.title: The kits products were best quality.
records.text: The cricket kits are best quality as expected on order. Now placed another order of 200 more because it has met my expectations. So it deserves 5 stars for the service provided by Andy over the phone.Just wanted the delivery better Thanks AllrounderCricket

records.title: Purchased equipment
records.text: Purchased a wheelie bag, pads and helmet. Fantastic quality and best price I found on numerous cricket sites. I bought the wrong size helmet and the team at AllRounderCricket were prompt with email replies and really helpful in exchanging the product. Thanks very much!

records.title: A big thanks to Macey who helped to get…
records.text: A big thanks to Macey who helped to get an order get to us in time for my son’s birthday. She suggested an alternative product that could be shipped faster and even arranged next day delivery, literally saving the day. She spent a long time on the phone with me and also followed the plan up in writing so I was reassured that the order would arrive in time. Great service thank you.

records.title: New junior cricket bat
records.text: Ordered an emergency new bat for my son after his old one broke mid-season. Excellent choice on the website - and the bat was delivered promptly, was well packaged and in excellent condition - complete with the knocking in service.   Happy customer.

records.title: A satisfactory ending to a hopeless situation.
records.text: Well let me begin with the fact that I never received my goods and had to buy it from elsewhere but through no fault of All rounder cricket. Their courier leaves a lot to be desired and most probably costs them a lot in reputation and costs of lost goods but their service in rectifying my situation was handled as well as I could expect. I received a full refund and was kept informed by Laura all the way. Thanks for the service but you really need to change your courier, Evri are letting you down as a business, big time!

records.title: Ask for Macey!
records.text: I placed a large order and having not received it when I expected to, I used the chat function (as that seems the only way to get hold of them!) and my first experience with dealing with someone told me my items would be dispatched in 24 hours. Having waited 24 hours and no sign of despatch, I contacted them again through the chat function and got Macey, who was brilliant! She followed everything up for me, spoke to the Warehouse team and even sorted a replacement helmet as the original one in the order was damaged and sent me a confirmation email of what was agreed. My items were then dispatched that day and should arrive in time for my sons birthday tomorrow!. I have to say my experience of the company in general not amazing but Macey saved the day and if you need to contact them ask for Macey!

records.title: Last minute ordering
records.text: Last minute ordering. Needed the kit for Friday evening. Encouraging telephone calls from Andy. Kit arrived Friday afternoon. A little sore feet but that was expected from new boots.Rod Merry

records.title: Nice shirt, timely delivery
records.text: Site was easy to navigate. We ordered a club cricket (match) shirt which showed as an in stock item. Courier delivered within 2 weeks. Packed well and shirt seems of good quality. One point for improvement which cost one star would be to give an indication of delivery time when the order is placed. I could not readily find a way to understand the wait time.

records.title: The lettering on the bat hasn’t been…
records.text: The lettering on the bat hasn’t been applied properly, peeling away without being used yet. I’ve bought all my bats from your company and I’ve never had this problem before, slightly disappointed with the effort that’s been put in considering I’ve paid over £250 this last month

records.title: After sales could have been better
records.text: After sales could have been better, never received a reply to a query so had to send item back at own expense and then reorder costing additional delivery, could have been resolved pre dispatch.  Other than that quick and efficient.

records.title: Easy online order quick delivery reasonable customer services
records.text: Order was easily made online and even got £5 discount code for registering first order. Items were good competitive price. Order arrived quickly so very pleased. An incorrect bat grip was sent that was of inferior quality which was not wanted so had to phone in for replacement. First call was not answered for over several minutes so used online chat to leave enquiry. This was not  answered for 3 days so phoned again which was picked up much quicker and the item I had ordered was not in stock anymore (hence the wrong item being sent obviously) so was offered refund. Not sure why but the item cost £4.99 but I was refunded £4.80. Not worth complaining about so left it as is but didn’t understand why. Refund came through with an email after 2days or so. Overall happy with purchases

records.title: DSC Cricket Shoe
records.text: I purchased two pairs of Cricket shoes for my sons, NB & DSC. while the NB was perfect in every aspect the DSC shoe size was way off. purchased size 4 (label says size 4) while the actual shoe is about size 5.5-6.

records.title: The item was received as ordered
records.text: The item was received as ordered. It was packaged well and arrived in about 7 days from placing the order. The item was as described. The only thing I would say is that the item is quite costly and with delivery on top of that. It is quite an expensive purchase.

records.title: Took about bit long to arrive , but happy with the stuff
records.text: Took about bit long to arrive , but I’m happy with the stuff I ordered, so far spent £2500+ this year with them ,,, genuine kits 🏏👍👍

records.title: Amazing bat
records.text: Had for 2 days and love it quick shipping and amazing quality definitely recommend 👌

records.title: Very happy with product
records.text: Very happy with product. Went back for size exchange and a very quick turnaround.

records.title: The shirt was very good and fits very…p
records.text: The shirt was very good and fits very well. Only the number on the back was a bit wrinkled. Apart from that it is very good.

records.title: I placed an order in March, nothing arrived and no response from Customer Service
records.text: I placed an order in March. NO despatch update and cannot reach AllRounder by phone or email.....Poor service and I am just hoping that eventually someone responds and I get my items.....Reading the other reviews, perhaps I am just very unlucky. If anyone from AllRounder is reading this - please just respond...pretty simple customer service 101....I need to update as I got a very helpful phone call to sort. Perhaps I just needed to bang the drum!

records.title: Good customer care.
records.text: I ordered some Puma cricket spikes and was contacted a few days later and told due to an oversight on their website the size I ordered was no longer available but sent a email with alternative options. I contacted the team sorted an alternative which I was more than happy with and they were delivered 2 days later. The customer care I was given was great and I will definitely be ordering from them again before next season starts!

records.title: Great range of products and loads of…
records.text: Great range of products and loads of choice, always best to see what’s in stock and then go in store to get a good feel for the products. Last set of pads I purchased spent a couple of hours trying a wide variety on and went with the gray nicholes test spec ones. Same with the bats went in wanting a GM and walked out with a new balance as it felt the best and looked fantastic.

records.title: Tom is great!
records.text: I have had mixed feelings about Allroundercricket. It must be said that the original experience wasn't ideal. There was a definite lapse of service early on and I felt that this could have definitely been better. However, Tom has been brilliant, he sorted all issues and had everything resolved. If I was to use allroundercricket again I would recommend dealing with Tom directly. He seems to get things done and actually follows up on his promises.

records.title: Wicket keeping gloves…
records.text: Bought a pair of wicketkeeping gloves from all rounder, unfortunately during the first time using them, they split. Took them back the next day with a receipt and got them exchanged free of charge - great service.

records.title: took a while to come but good quality…
records.text: took a while to come but good quality stuff

records.title: Macey Logan's service was exceptional.
records.text: This is an edited post where I initially gave them 1 star and honestly wanted to give zero if I could. I was disgusted by some delays and poor service however all the credit goes to Macey Logan from all rounder. She picked up my review and emailed me and offered to rectify this and have explanation as to what was happening which was the severe delay from the manufacturers in India due to covid outbreak. Not only she contacted me but she also gave me updates and made sure I received my helmet through express delivery. What was a horrible experience ended in a very good one and I really appreciate the professionalism of Macey. I would go back and order again just because of Macey. I hope other customer services advisors I spoke to before follows her example.

records.title: Nothing wrong with the product but I…
records.text: Nothing wrong with the product but I paid £5 for delivery, waited a week then by chance I tracked my order and was told it was damaged beyond repair, so I had to phone and get the them sent out again but they didn’t have the original order in stock.Then when I got them the pads were too big( not all rounders fault) but I had to send them back and that cost me £7 so that’s £12 I paid for nothing!

records.title: I am quite doubtful (after reading all…
records.text: I am quite doubtful (after reading all of these reviews) that my order which I only placed on 30th November will arrive! I have emailed them today as it's my sons birthday on Friday to see if I can expect it by then. The payment was processed on the day but haven't had any shipment acknowledgment yet. I will keep you all posted. Please All rounder cricket! Your chance for one customer to give you 5 stars if I get them by Friday! MS

records.title: stock issues
records.text: Unfortunatley my item was out of stock so they sent a replacement (i asked for a refund prior to this). Sent it back and got refund quite quickly to be fair.  Not the quickest service but correct items received were all fine.

records.title: Finally got my delivery
records.text: First post was on 9/SepPlease don't use this website. You will be wasting your money and time. I have ordered a bat for my son in April. Still not received it. But they have taken the money. Called so many times and sent emails. No response from their customer care.Update on 14/Sep: After posting this comment here, I was contacted by AllRounderCricet and they have offered for a replacement bat. This is positive. Hope I get the product to my hand.Update on 15/Sep: Finally got my order. I wish AllRounderCricket were like this in April. They were quick and prompt in the response on 14/Sep and genuinely tried their best to provide a replacement product. Next day morning i got the product. But I cannot give more rating than Average as the experience in April and May was terrible. In Sep, there customer service in resolving this issue is really good.

records.title: Good products let down by customer service
records.text: Overall I was happy with the quality of the products I ordered and the cost was competitive with other suppliers.  Unfortunately the service was not as good as I would expect.  Having ordered extra balls for the Feed Buddy these were not originally delivered.  I tried the customer service line twice and no-one answered.  I followed tis up with 3 emails none of which were answered.  Eventually another call to the phone line was answered and to be fair the issue was then dealt with quickly and the product delivered.

records.title: Don’t bother
records.text: Crap. No communication they ignore messages, calls etc. They state business as usual on their site as well as express delivery. All lies, AVOID AT ALL COSTS.Update Received my order 7 days after ordering, still no communication but guess I should be happy I’ve got mind compared to other people

records.title: Recently purchased cricket boots
records.text: Recently purchased cricket boots, great quality however the sizing is in correct i advise you buy one size above..Cant fault the price and quality.  and thank you for an easy pleasant exchange.This organisation can be great if customer service was given priority which they lack..

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: Ordered a cricket bag on the 6th December and payment taken. The bag eventually arrived on the 15th December but not after me making over 40 calls to contact them. I managed to ring the Sheffield office and that’s when I received the help needed. All this company have to do is answer the phone and improve the communication by email to the customer. In the end the bag received was perfect.

records.title: Lack of communication
records.text: Ordered cricket helmet and a club cap for £86  no email confirmation received after 3 days so carried out a webchat only to be told that the cap will take longer to despatch than the helmet and there would be a separate delivery charge if I wanted items sent out separately ! Would of been nice to of been advised of this when order was placed! Just said to send out together as not prepared to pay a second delivery charge! Looking after your customers keeps them coming back!!!

records.title: Look for professional place who care about your purchase
records.text: Like the previous review, very unprofessional approach to shipping the item and knocking is not enough. They shipped in a garbage bag and I can see some wood dents on the back of my bat, small though and that is probably because of shoddy packaging. I have a business that I do where I ship items to customers, wooden item wrapped in proper packaging and at least cardboard cover. These guys just do a horrible job.The bat does not come with a cover, no toe guard. So the bat looks good with some damage but whole experience sucks.

records.title: Great customer service in the end!
records.text: I have given three stars because of the difficulty contacting and finding out what had happened to my order!  However - once I got hold of someone on the phone - Macey, she was very helpful relying via email and giving me all the info needed to track my order. It turned out there were issues between the company and the courier - but Magnificent Mo sorted it after I contacted him via Facebook Messenger! He called me up and arranged for a replacement to be sent that day, which duly arrived via next day delivery and DHL. So, perhaps they are overwhelmed with orders, but once they were on the case, they were amazingly helpful!!

records.title: Worth the wait
records.text: Very good pricing for kookaburra bat , the only gripe was the length of time it toon to be delivered, after a few complaining emails that weren’t replied to either I received my bat which I’m very happy with

records.title: Manager helped redeem the service level
records.text: Initially the service wasn't great but the manager Macy helped all rounder cricket redeem themselves.  She was very helpful and made the experience seamless as it should be.

records.title: I ordered batting gloves and they…
records.text: I ordered batting gloves and they didn’t say they weren’t in stock so I had to call up. They offered another pair but didn’t respond when I asked for a different pair. Overall annoying but not bad service

records.title: I ordered size 10 received size 10.5
records.text: I ordered size 10 received size 10.5Please contact me .Thanks. Shipment #200098190Order #200123679Order and Shipment Information

records.title: OK in the end!
records.text: Horrendous service absolutely no communication what so ever.I made an online order via the claimed Australia site. Clearly don't care about providing anything other than taking funds from people. I've sent emails and messages trying to follow up on a special order that was supposed to take 14 days. It's been over a month now and I can't get a response. The website now says allow 25 working days, but my order was placed beforehand. Even if i could get an update that this will take longer, that's fine but nothing at all tells me that there's a solid chance I've lost my money to a scam. The other positive reviews don't seem legit at all, if they were I wouldn't need to write this one now. Definitely don't deal with them unless it is in person by the sounds of it.**Update**Today I got delivery of my helmet. Happy with the product, but not happy about the lack of communication. Perhaps in stock items are OK, but special items are a problem even before the season started.

records.title: Purchased their bat with knocking in…
records.text: Purchased their bat with knocking in service and it seems a very good piece of equipment so far but wasn't fully knocked in as paid for.

records.title: Good recovery but needs to improve turnaround of Teamwear orders.
records.text: Updated from 1* as Customer Service Manager Macey picked up on my last email sent and has been 5* since. Because of the lack of communication etc. and with it being my son’s first cricket match that weekend she managed to get the order embroidered and sent the same day and delivered the day later in time for the match. Impressive turnaround but they shouldn’t have been in that position in the first place. Started well - the next working day after placing my order (responding to an email I sent following an issue using PayPal) the finance team confirmed they had received my money and would pass the order on to Teamwear. Some weeks later though my order hadn’t appeared on the order section of their website, the telephone staff (on the only time I actually managed to get through to someone, what an agonising process - an hour wait at least, get some more phone staff please) couldn’t even find my order, and until Macey nobody had the courtesy to call back or reply to emails (in spite of having my details and making multiple attempts to contact them via email just to confirm what was going on without ever being anything other than polite). All rounder need to stop using COVID as an excuse for delays - business have had almost 18 months to put in processes to maintain efficiency under COVID-conditions and the cricket season timing is hardly a surprise either.

records.title: I bought a Gravesend’s CC jumper…
records.text: I bought a Gravesend’s CC jumper adidas. It took around 10 months to be delivered.

records.title: Problem that took some time to sort
records.text: Received size five cricket shoes for my 11 year old son in March out of his birthday money, returned to address as advised by website, expecting a refund. After receiving no refund i e mailed allrounders around end of March, no response. Sent online contact e mail again end of April, no response. Thought this might have something to do with Covid 19 so didn’t send an e mail again until 15th June, amazed to receive an e mail back, no apology just asking for proof of postage. After three months of no contact I must have misplaced my postage receipt so  couldn’t do that. I responded asking “Macey” for a name and address of the director so I could write a complaint, no response again. Customer satisfaction 0% and terrible costumer services. I have spent a lot of money at the all rounders shop in Headingley as have my friends but the online service is truly terrible and will not be using them again as my son is £23 out of pocket. If I hear anything further I will update this review.PC sports in Yeadon are very goodSome hours after I did get a response, no address for complaints as asked for, just asking for proof of postage. If anyone uses this company make sure you put your postage receipt in a safe place to refer to after a few months of first contact. Lesson learned and £23 lost.Update Macey sorted this issue, I went to the Headingley shop and she apologised and game me the size up in the shoe, my lad is now happy and I will continue to use all rounders. I will put the down to Covid 19. Thank you Macey you are a credit to Allrounders.

records.title: Seems to be complete chaos
records.text: Sadly much the same experience as most of the other reviews (wish I had read these before using this company). It appears to be absolute chaos, they are not coping with Christmas deliveries. I had no choice but to pay £6 for delivery, despite a large order. Heard nothing for 8 days so chased the order via email. Support eventually replied said there was a stock issue, but assured me parcel would be with me in 24hrs. Parcel did turn up 3 days later hence 2 stars not 1, but I wouldn’t use them again I don’t have any confidence.

records.title: Whats App discount scam
records.text: Wished I’d read reviews prior to falling for exclusive whatapp discount scam. Ordered and paid for stock item 29th April. Still await said goods. Why companies can’t just state not in stock up front to manage expectations. Order 2000216656.

records.title: Adidas team shirt sizing
records.text: I ordered a Junior size 8y adidas shirt for my son’s birthday. Having had it embroidered with his initials I cannot return it (which is fine as our younger son can use it in a few years time), I was disappointed to see that the 8yr shirt is probably more suited to a 5-6 yr old sized boy.I have since had to order a new size 9-10yr shirt for my 7yr old. Can you review the sizing advice please?

records.title: Really dissapointing
records.text: Really dissapointing. Ordered Boots on 8th April for 3-5 working day delivery, was told on 13th April via live chat they would be posted out for early W/C 18th April, but after received no dispatch email and communication, have now been told they don't have the boots in stock.. Keep being told they can't email me as I have a gmail account, yet I received my order confirmation and their marketing just fine. Have now been told to wait 3-5 days for a refund, which am not overly expecting to receive on time. Polite enough on the phone, but just very poor service for a company that promises so much in terms of delivery time and available stock.

records.title: Excellent prices... for a reason
records.text: Hard to beat on price but that's for a reason. Have made several orders from All Rounder over time, sometimes bats, sometimes gloves, sometimes boots etc. My gut feeling as that the reason their prices are so low is that they are sometimes taking manufacturer-defected products wholesale at bargain prices and distributing them at regular sale prices, making a very tidy profit by doing so. The Grade 1 bats I've received from them are never quite right in terms of quality, whether that be the springiness of the blade, the condition of the edges or handle flexibility. They aren't the kind of the quality you would expect for the range/grade, but they are the kind of quality you would expect for the price, if you catch my drift.The gloves I purchased were DSC's top of the line but the RH thumb is stitched on poorly and at an odd angle, making them a slightly uncomfortable wear. They were half price compared to RRP and significantly cheaper than could be found elsewhere. I guess this is the reason why. If you're looking for cheaper intermediate gear, it's OK. If you're looking for top-of-the-line products, pay the extra and go elsewhere. No matter what they say they're selling, it's never quite what you expect it to be.

records.title: Poor customer service
