The bat came on time which I was happy about but after paying for the knocking in service my bat started to crack in a few places

records.title: Absolute Joke
records.text: Such a disappointment. I called in advance and checked that before my 1 hour drive to the store in Leeds, that someone would be there to help with full first hard ball season kit for my 10 year old. No one answered the phone but I did speak to someone on instant chat who confirmed that we would have help in store.So, on arrival I say "can someone help me find all the kit we need and right sizes" only to be told be the assistant "no, I don't know anything about cricket". Not even an attempt to say the junior kit can be found over there, make sure you get x, y and z. They did give me a number to call for help after I complained, but no one answered the number I called.Having driven so far, and being so desperate for kit needed for games this week, I tried the instant chat again while in store snd finally managed to speak to someone who did the best they could to guide us over the phone.I was totally perplexed. I was desperate so had to buy the kit in this store. I wanted to buy from a shop rather than online or from a big sports chain store. I wish I could have just walked out.Honestly I wouldn't ever tell anyone to go to this store. I was embarrassed for my boy to see and experience that level of poor service in a store that should be passionate about his favourite sport.2 stars only because of the help over the phone in the end. Otherwise ZERO stars.Absolute joke.Store visit Leeds, 11th April 2022.

records.title: My main complaint is that you didn’t…
records.text: My main complaint is that you didn’t put the key info about the size of the frame and what it is made of.

records.title: Good but probably over priced
records.text: Great product although on reflection over priced.

records.title: Final result of order
records.text: Final result of order DHL were shocking causing excessive stress

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: Good customer service

records.title: Great and fast service shame the amount…
records.text: Great and fast service shame the amount of money I spent the item was not in a frame

records.title: They told me it was delivered when it…
records.text: They told me it was delivered when it was not, then it came a day after

records.title: Fantastic products
records.text: Fantastic products. Great customer service. Expensive shipping is the only downside.

records.title: Great Product and great quality
records.text: Great Product and great quality, my Son will be over the moon on Christmas Day... A couple of slight negatives , the frame doesn't come with any way to hang it on the wall so you have to add wire hooks yourself, which I'm  really not comfortable doing especially on a £250 item, should state when buying as i wouldnt have purchased.. Also the price on the website didn't match the basket price, had to ring up to be told the price on the website cant be honoured as its an IT issue

records.title: Okay
records.text: Speedy service with good customer care.Only issue for me is the quality of the shirt itself.I bought Paul Gascoigne 96 front signed England shirt but the England badge was very poor quality which makes the shirt a bit of eye sore when it shouldn't be, especially when it would have been framed with signature and badge on display.

records.title: Missing COA
records.text: Not my first time buying from A1 or Icons, always love the items they have. But this time A1 sending my items ( 2 signed boot ) without the COA which the most important authenticity document. Mailed them twice still have no answer at all. Please help me to get the COA.Thank you

records.title: Disappointed signed gordan strachan…
records.text: Disappointed signed gordan strachan shirt size XL and signed in wrong place.A1 Sporting memorabilia have two images of the signed shirt but only have one shirt to buy false advertising and give a crap excuse for the XL shirt when it arrived

records.title: Good quality shoes, packaging/shipping problem
records.text: Nice shoe and signature. However, packaging is unacceptable, like someone has kicked into the box several time. I received the squished box, that made the certificate paper wrinkled. Please consider about packaging/shipping.

records.title: The service and delivery was good but…
records.text: The service and delivery was good but the product had a scratch on the front perspex sheet. I didn't return or complain as my son really wanted the item and custom changes would apply. I will just change the perspex myself.

records.title: Bought a framed autographed photo
records.text: Bought a framed autographed photo. The item was packed very well and delivered with care. Unfortunately the photo was not assembled correctly in the frame. It was not flat with the clips not closed correctly. This caused the photo to bend. Luckily we were able to remove the photo and reposition it. It’s not perfect now but hope it will flatten out in time.

records.title: No means to hang the framed shirt
records.text: I find it really strange that after paying good money for a framed item, there is no means to actually hang the item up. You wouldn't buy a picture then have to to add a hook or cord to the back, would you?!! Very strange indeed.

records.title: No issues with the website or ordering…
records.text: No issues with the website or ordering process, and the product itself looks like it’s really good quality. The delivery process was poor. Communication from the courier company was limited, offering a delivery slot before 1300 and then not turning up until 1600.

records.title: Poor quality frames
records.text: Poor quality frames. Sent damaged. Frame backing all loose and damaged and packaging was awful. Hence you get what you pay for.

records.title: Did not like how the signed photo came…
records.text: Did not like how the signed photo came rolled up. It is very difficult to get it to lay flat now and I am not satisfied with this. This is 2/2 items that I’ve had issues with now. I didn’t even use the discount given from the previous issue. (Bent corner on Wayne Rooney old trafford sign)

records.title: Item was not delivered have emailed you awaiting your response  contacted for…
records.text: Item was not delivered contacted for help was told to ring post office have done awaiting investigation as apparently I signed for it but was at work over two hundred pounds wasted avoid this site at all costs no support given or options absolute conThe company have reached out and sent a replacement Thankyou for this it has been received

records.title: My order came quickly and safely…
records.text: My order came quickly and safely packaged however when I opened it I could see the brown tape that's used to tape the shirt to the frame, folded over the shirt visible inside the frame which disappointed me as I chose to buy the framed version to ensure that it would be to a good quality finish so was disappointed to have to open it up and fix it myself.

records.title: Alistair Cook Shirt
records.text: When I placed my order on Monday 3rd August I was promised that it would be sent in time to arrive Friday as it was a birthday present. I called on the Friday to check my orders status and was advised that it was being dispatched that day to arrive Monday. I was obviously less than happy about this but to your credit it was sent for delivery the next day do thank you.

records.title: Poor presentation.
records.text: The product arrived promptly as promised and was packaged well however the picture I had ordered was poorly placed in the frame, the metal clips had been forced inwards as the wooden background had been forced on top which meant I had to dismantle and put back together.I expect for the price you pay for a frame that the product should come complete and not require assembly and correction.

records.title: Great man city shirts
records.text: Great man city shirts , only my signed foden shirt was size 3XL…

records.title: Messi Photo
records.text: My only complaint is the shipping. It was shipped in a tube that was dented. Inside the tube the photo was completely naked. It wasn’t in a sleeve to protect it or any tissue paper at the ends.  This was a $300+ signed photo and I couldn’t believe it actually made it here (across the pond) without a dent. Good company and I’ll purchase from again.

records.title: Receiving contact back is limited
records.text: Receiving contact back is limited. Items are good and quality BUT to help and keep customers happy and to keep them returning the Seller should know about import taxes to other countries (I do) and they should as a common courtesy do their best to keep item/parcel valuations to a minimum. $75 AUD over the $1,000.00 limit cost me another $180.00 in charges for something that could have been very easily avoided and unnecessary.

records.title: The only down side is delivery
records.text: The only down side is delivery as it was left outside in the rain, with out me know that it was delivered or it was even outside my house. With the amount of money you spent you expect a little better, but apart from that the product was fantastic.

records.title: A bit disappointed.
records.text: I was disappointed that the signature was of such poor quality. It had been signed using which looked like a felt tip pen and therefore losing the detail. It didn't help had there was a printed copy of the signature on the poster to compere the two. The date of the competition was also wrong.In your favor you had explained that there was defects in the signature and hence the cheaper price.I have brought several items from you before and I admire your honesty and am sure I'll be purchasing other items in the future.

records.title: Sorry I ordered a Kevin Ratcliffe…
records.text: Sorry I ordered a Kevin Ratcliffe signed photo, when my husband opened it on Christmas morning noticed right away that Everton were League Winners in 85/87 however on the photo it’s says league cup winners. This is an error

records.title: poor customer service
records.text: I have used the sports memorabilia framing company on many occasions for frames for football shirts.I’ve ordered many frames for charity nights over the years with no issues.  However I contacted Naomi from tsmfc on 29 January to advise that the text on the frame was incorrect and at the time I was unsure if this was my mistake it tsmfc.Naomi emailed back and advised that the error was on there part and I would receive a new name plate. I’ve since contacted them on three different occasions to be advised that the name plates have been sent out , however I’ve not received these yet.My charity night is Friday 23 February so fingers crossed I receive it prior to then

records.title: Little bit disappointed that the frame…
records.text: Little bit disappointed that the frame didn't come with pre installed hanging hooks did reach out to the company I was advised to hire a handy man to attach it to my wall . I have brought framed shirts before from a different company and they all ways  have the hooks making it easier to hang

records.title: Very poorly framed had to spend an hour…
records.text: Very poorly framed had to spend an hour correcting this issue not worth sending item back to mutch trouble resending and re reseaving had framed shirts before and they were fine really poor quality this time.

records.title: They don’t send authentication documents.
records.text: I got a Kell brook signed photo and have requested the authentication documentation. I confirmed my order number, security code and authentication code on email and haven’t received anything. I called last week to chase this and still they haven’t sent anything. I’m now thinking if the item is genuine.

records.title: Item damaged
records.text: My second purchase from A1 Sporting Memorabilia and this time my item is damaged. DisappointedDelivery was however very quick.

records.title: Poorly put together
records.text: Poorly put together. Back panel was loose and shirts visible. Had to add nails to secure back panel.

records.title: I received my goods but they’ve arrive…
records.text: I received my goods but they’ve arrive with some stains on them. Not ideal for something I’d like to hang on a wall really.

records.title: I had to pay an additional 75 euro in…
records.text: I had to pay an additional 75 euro in taxes.

description: Hollywood Bowl Group is the UK's largest ten-pin bowling company with 66 centres located all across the country. With state of the art bowling lanes, a delicious food & drink menu and an amusement arcade, there's something for everyone. So whether its a night out with friends, kids’ birthday parties or a team event, come and join us for a great evening out! Pre-book online and sign up to our VIP mailing list for the very best offers and exclusive discounts.

records.title: Love bringing the kids here
records.text: Love bringing the kids here! The addition of the arcades means something to keep them occupied before or after the game (though you spend more!) The food and drinks were the usual choices of fast food and expensive but we enjoyed our drink and snack. What really makes this place enjoyable is the staff, they can’t do enough to help! Everyone was friendly, welcoming and they all seem to enjoy working there. Interacted with patience and jokes with the kids and nothing was too much to sort out - really makes the spend worth it as everyone comes home having had a good time!

records.title: We love Hollywood bowl
records.text: We love Hollywood bowl. It is our NYE tradition. Great staff, great food, arcades are fun especially the ball drop game which is a family favourite. It’s always clean and tidy. We will always return.

records.title: Absolutely love it at Hollywood bowl
records.text: Absolutely love it at Hollywood bowl, always have a great time bowling and in the arcade! Food is great value and the staff are amazing! Always helpful and courteous especially michaela! She's so lovely!

records.title: We are always happy after we visit the…
records.text: We are always happy after we visit the local facilities of Taunton in Somerset.The staff is super friendly and despite the heavy footfall that there have been in such place, they keep maintain it well presented yet.We are particularly happy with the service provided by Shirley and her colleagues. Thank you for help me and my family have good time while there.

records.title: Great Experience
records.text: For the third year in a row, we have enjoyed the hospitality of the Lincoln Hollywood Bowl on Boxing day to hold our family challenge (won for the second year in a row by the wife). Food and drinks were supplied promptly and quality was good. Lanes are clean and equipment readily available. There is also a plentiful range of amusements including whack-a-mole, "tipping point" tuppeny push, and air hockey. We will be back again next year for a few visits!

records.title: Superb New Year’s Eve bowl on VIP lane
records.text: Superb New Year’s Eve bowl on VIP lane! I’m a regular & Belle & Nicole were welcoming, professional & helpful! Thank you to all the team!

records.title: Amazing customer service …
records.text: We were at Hollywood bowl in Tunbridge wells yesterday 29/12/2024 to celebrate my sons birthday ( not as a party package) and unfortunately my husband was poorly and unable to attend, I was asked to confirm the number of bowlers and having booked for 7 only 6 were able. I was not expecting any form of refund as this was completely unexpected and not the Centre’s fault my husband could not attend, However I was issued a voucher for one person to have one free game of bowling within the next 3 months. The customer service was outstanding and much appreciated.

records.title: Great place for bowling as long as your…
records.text: Great place for bowling - as long as your not wearing sandals you dont have to wear bowling shoes. Arcades and pool tables are great and overall experience is great value for money

records.title: Great staff
records.text: Great staff, great food, and fun arcades, especially the ball drop game, which is a family favorite. It’s was clean and tidy.

records.title: Good atmosphere
records.text: Good atmosphere,  good pleasant staff , drinks are expensive buy can take your own in x

records.title: Family trip and fun experience overall
records.text: Family trip and fun experience overall. Reception helpful and gave us a lane early as we arrived early.  No issues with the bowling but the lane areas were untidy and food rubbish on table in VIP area, plus lack of variety of ball sizes for children. Limited staff on during busy early evening. Enjoyable bowling but not cheap !

records.title: Great place but expensive
records.text: It's clean and in good condition. It has amusements which can be fun because there are a good range and you are rewarded with tickets to purchase toys and sweets. Free parking in a good size car park. However, it's very expensive considering how long a game of bowling actually takes.

records.title: Bowling alley…
records.text: On the whole we found Hollywood Bowl very easy to book, the staff very friendly, the games are all set up for you which we found very beneficial to us, we will definitely be returning, many thanks.

records.title: Great time bowling
records.text: Great time bowling at lakeside hollywood bowls, got on the lane quickly, Staff were friendly and the lanes were cleaned quickly. Bar is a little slow so would advice ordering at lane.

records.title: Was a great day out other then beung…
records.text: Was a great day out other then beung forgot about till we approached them 20 mins past waiting booked time. Would 9f been 5 stars otherwise was put into vip to say sorry so was all good

records.title: Fun bowling, environment could be better.
records.text: Efficient booking process, friendly staff, and no problems with bowling.The whole place is VERY loud though - so don't be able to speak to your friends!Also, very over-heated.

records.title: Nice clean bowling area
records.text: Nice clean bowling area , friendly staff .Everything was pleasant only thing was the online booking was not matching the in house spacing .

records.title: Good value for money bowling
records.text: Good value for money bowling in a centre with adequate dining facilities and amusements. It’s a bit small and sometimes seems cramped when it’s full. Could do with more staff helping out but a good place to spend an hour or two.

records.title: Afternoon out with family members
records.text: Went with family members (all adults). We had a fun time, playing 2 games of bowling and a mini golf. It was busy and there were not enough staff members available, meaning there were long queues. Some fries and nachos were ordered. These took 55 minutes to arrive which we thought was a very long time. Staff member apologised offering a refund but also said the food was then on its way up.

records.title: Great atmosphere
records.text: Great atmosphere. Been here many times . Always a winner taking the kids to bowl and the arcades. Although the arcades have got more expensive at some machine being 2 pounds.

records.title: 2 Games of Bowling.
records.text: Enjoyable evening Bowling. Good atmosphere, friendly staff and easy booking online. Would recommend to everyone. Thank you!

records.title: Always good fun bowling
records.text: Always good fun bowling, especially with the grand kids but a touch on the pricey side. Not much change out of £80 for 2 games, one drink each and a quick go on the amusements. But we all enjoyed it, staff were great, very attentive and it all went smoothly

records.title: Bracknell Hollywood Bowling 🎳
records.text: We had a lovely time and great entertainment at the Hollywood Bowling 🎳 Bracknell.

records.title: Great place for family
records.text: Easy to book online, give all names of your party and bowling lane is set up for your arrival. Great experience. Only downside is it is a bit expensive

records.title: Fun for all
records.text: Booking was easy, venue was clean, staff were helpful, bowling was fun for all the family BUT the amusements are sooo expensive we couldn't afford them.

records.title: Great atmosphere
records.text: Great atmosphere.  Perfect family evening full of fun.

records.title: L9vely staff
records.text: L9vely staff,  easy to book a slot,  great atmosphere

records.title: Decent bowling experience
records.text: Decent bowling experience. Clean and nice staff. Food is as youd expect tbh, but everything else the kids loved .

records.title: Easy process and nice venue.
records.text: Easy process and nice venue.

records.title: Good facilities friendly staff
records.text: Good facilities friendly staff, queuing when arriving was a little confusing as people with tickets from arcades were a little all over the place, felt they could of had a few more cheaper arcade machines available as paying £2/3 when you have to kids can be way too expensive, but overall good experience! (Swindon site)

records.title: First visit
records.text: Really long wait time for drinks and food and then for food order wrong. Bowling however that was great no issues at all.

records.title: Nice evening out but very overpriced in…
records.text: Nice evening out but very overpriced in my opinion

records.title: This is my local bowling alley
records.text: This is my local bowling alley,  so it always gets busy on the weekend. Had a 7.10pm lane booking but didn't get on till 7.35pm.   When we first got there, went to the bar but had to wait well over 5 minutes to be served.

records.title: Kids had a great time
records.text: Kids had a great time. More lighter balls would of been better, the hotdog rolls crumbled as the kids tried to eat because they were so stale and toilets were not checked regularly as stated, but overall ok

records.title: Not a bad experience for a play and eadtbe very wary if you have a nut allergy
records.text: Not a bad experience for a play and eat for the kids however. Toilets are dirty whenever you go Lanes aren't cleanAah a but allergy sufferer not very confident when the lanes have nuts all over dropped crushed on the seats/sides. Even ar the bar there is a big counter full of them. It's an incident waiting to happen. Wouldn't ever risk ordering food myself from there as I'm not confident they are awarebofbthe seriousness of not handling allergies.

records.title: I was at the Dunfermline Hollywood Bowl. There was no hot food available. Very disappointed with that. Everything was ok.
records.text: I was at the Dunfermline

records.title: Oxford Hollywood bowl facilities were…
records.text: Oxford Hollywood bowl facilities were great but get some staff! 40 minutes waiting for a drink to table service and still had to get a refund because the drinks never came.  Took the fun out of the afternoon.  Such a let down and would not recommend.   Got a very generic response from HB to cover there tracks!  It’s quite simple guys everyone pre books their lanes so you know how busy you are going to be, you should be able to work out the optimum staff numbers to cater for the number of customers.  Stinks of greed, I would be happy to help you on your operational pitfalls

records.title: Good fun and plenty of different weight…
records.text: Good fun and plenty of different weight balls available. It’s great that we do to have to change shoes anymore. It’s just so expensive. £50 for 3 plus £10 for amusements and extra for junk food! A lot of money for a couple of hours entertainment! I would defo come more often if not so expensive

records.title: Serious lack of staff
records.text: Serious lack of staffLong queue at reception. Had to go find someone to help only member of staff was 1 person behind the bar with a queueFinally got someone to deal with the queue at reception Toilets dirty. Area of bowling dirty.I can only attribute this to not enough staff on duty.Shame as we did enjoy the bowling.

records.title: Bowling great 👍 but toilets a letdown
records.text: Bowling great 👍 Staff friendly and helpful👍Amusements fun👍Only down pointToilets- need a deep clean or refurbishment and ventilation ⚠️ smells awful!

records.title: A fun treat but expensive
records.text: Although its fun and we as a family enjoy bowling every now and again it is certainly not value for money and is rather pricey which is probably why the centre we went to was dead, there were probably only 4 lanes being used. Years back we would go bowling quite often but very rarely go now as it's simply too expensive to take the family.

records.title: Don’t order food if your hungry your get it next week.
records.text: I wanted to change my booked dates and it cost me £15 to call up and change it, the lady knew this and spoke so slow,rude.First time we ordered food and it took nearly an hour to arrive, nothing exceptional just some chicken sides and nachos, when it finally turned up they were over done. Second visit I ordered a jug of juice which took nearly 40 minutes to arrive, faster for me to go to the bar myself what a joke.

records.title: Bowling was great! Manager needs customer service training
records.text: Bowling was great, food was good! Child’s meal stated on the receipt that we ordered wasn’t received and the Manager on duty was very rude (younger lad) even offered to pay for another so he could eat as at this point was quite late! Guys at the bar were very helpful and seen there was a mistake but the Manager didn’t care and still told us we was wrong when it was in black and white.

records.title: The bowling experience was great, but...
records.text: The bowling experience was great, but I wanted to leave a review to warn others about potential pick pocket gangs operating in the amusement arcade area. 2 out of 6 of the teens in our party had their mobiles taken from their pockets whilst playing games. Such a shame, ruined what was a lovely couple of hours out for my daughters birthday. If we visit again, we will take more care, or even avoid the amusement area altogether

records.title: Visit ok BUT seriously underwhelmed by…
records.text: Visit ok BUT seriously underwhelmed by the attitude of the duty manager. Felt he was dismissive and unhelpful when I tried to express my dissatisfaction about the long wait we had for drinks. I cancelled my drink. The other drinks turned up about 30 mins after we ordered.Bar staff were fine, just extremely understaffed. Q : Who would’ve thought it’d be busy during the Easter holiday?A : Not Hollywood Bowl.(Realise that’s not really an answer.)

records.title: Match Day problems
records.text: We often go to Hollywood Bowl with the family and the place and facilities itself is great. All the staff members are friendly and helpful. The only down side is on match days. The bar area is flooded with home and away football supporters getting drinks, so the paying customers and families using the bowling facilities have to queue around 20 minutes just for a drink in a rowdy atmosphere. This needs to be reviewed by the venue.

records.title: Tethered pins are crap
records.text: Tethered Pins are crap, it's like playing an arcade game rather than real life bowling.Strikes are not registered as such and non strikes are registered as strikes, makes a complete mockery of scoring. Guess this is the progress automation brings to our lives. Saves money for the company at least, nevermind the user experience!

records.title: Had a good time despite its appearance!
records.text: Had a good time despite the place looking worn, bowling alleys warped and dirt, mess and stickiness in lanes. Amusement overpriced and not enough appropriate rewards to justify paying this much to win tokens. Spent over £100 to win tokens which got us a few bags of sweets. Overall wouldn’t want to come back but it is a nice day out for the kids.

records.title: Couldn't order food being new years…
records.text: Couldn't order food being new years eve, we was looking forward too spend the new year bowling and having food,  but if you was a party of 6 you can order food , how bad is that , your place is a joke I'm disguised with your attitude towards any customer.. you're toilet were disgusting,  food waste every where , learn to clean ,

records.title: RUBERY Hollywood bowl
records.text: I’m have always came here for bowling since I was a child , always great staff and a lovely time. Only downside I would say is everytime without fail the ladies toilets are disgusting - they seem like they’re cleaned maybe once a week. If staff spent more time checking the toilets and it meant waiting slightly longer for drinks I’d rather do that. I have to walk into about 5 different cubicles before I find one that’s decent to use. Other than this, really great time and nice facility :)

records.title: Never been so stressed during a game of…
records.text: Never been so stressed during a game of bowling. Only given 40 minutes to complete 2 games even though booked in advanced. Didn’t have time to eat or drink during the game and was just constantly rushing to try and finish the 2 games.Paid £31 and wasn’t even given an hour of time, way too expensive for this experience.

records.title: very very rushed
records.text: very very rushed, and kept missing goes randomly - seemingly due to taking to long to take a go. most of that was bowling etiquette - i.e. letting the next lane have their go before taking ours.the emphasis was to get us in as out as quickly as possible without any regard to the fact we had children who we were trying to teach to bowl properly.rushed and not enjoyable

records.title: The bowling itself was fine, but ...
records.text: The bowling itself was fine, but the environment was way to overstimulating for my friend's child who is sensitive to sound. My friend's child also doesn't have access to video games or much screen time, so was totally overwhelmed by all the amusements and massive game screens she had to pass by just to reach the bowling. It just seems that venues like this seem to think that the more extreme the range of sounds, screens, games and volume of music, the happier human beings will become. What happened to simple pleasures? The food also lacked nutritional value and the price of playing was shockingly high around Xmas.

records.title: Needs an update
records.text: Noisy and worn out / dated equipment. VIP area same as normal areas but very uncomfortable seating. Bowling balls are old and only a few sizes available. Service is good from staff but this centre needs a massive refurbishment. Overall it’s just OK and not very good value for money.

records.title: I wouldn't come back here.. go merry hill
records.text: Went on Saturday.. bar was a mess. Prioritising orders and not people at the bar. Manager expected customers to inform them of who is next. There was a a lot of disorganisation. There was only one change machine working but folded notes were difficult to accept took over 20 times to take the money.  Some ticket machines were empty staff seemed unconcerned with the inconvenience caused. The change machine needs changing.

records.title: 4 adults £68 discount offer provided…
records.text: 4 adults £68 discount offer provided didn't work. Not enough spare balls to fit fingers, and some in poor condition. That said, it was good entertainment and atmosphere, just too expensive.

records.title: Very disappointing
records.text: Very disappointing. Venue was very unclean, staff not particularly friendly - in particular the bar staff. Lanes weren't ready on arrival, told to return ten mins later. Returned ten mins and they'd been ready. Started our game late as a result but they stopped it dead on the hour. Unable to finish our game or even see final results. Bar staff incredibly unfriendly, took ages for service. Would never return and would definitely not recommend.

records.title: Bowling was standard
records.text: Bowling was standard - you would expect.Kids drinks overpriced, food - over an hour wait even though the tables around us were empty. Food was cold and seemingly microwaved. Some parts inedible. Toilets were smelly and unclean. The locks on doors not working. Not a pleasant visit. Whole experience was over priced.

records.title: Glasgow’s Bailieston Disapointing
records.text: Glasgow’s Bailieston 1st the doors were locked, for over 10 minutes, no apologie, our game finished early no reason or notice given. We were not advised of the time finish time. Which was insufficient. The seating area was sticky and damaged. No engagement with staff very unhelpful, faulty amusements not producing tickets. Food and prices were over rated.

records.title: Pins and scoring system don’t work…
records.text: Pins and scoring system don’t work properly. We bowl at this centre quite a lot and this is the first time it has happened. We didn't initially raise it at the time as we thought it was a one-off but by the end of the games it had happened many times. The machine was scoring incorrectly, awarding strikes when not all the skittles had been knocked over and recording lower scores when all the skittles had been knocked over (the pins were balancing on a corner held up by the string, had there been no strings, the pins would have fallen, it’s impossible for a skittle to balance on it’s edge for some time). I did bring it up afterwards with a member of staff but he didn't seem interested. It completely spoiled our game, as all of us are keen bowlers, and were it not for this being the only place out of the city centre, I wouldn't visit again.

description:
Circle One are a progressive Surf & Watersports company specialising in the supply of Surfboards, Wetsuits, Bodyboards, SUP boards, Skimboards, Board Bags, Surf Travel Hardware and a large range of Accessories including Buoyancy Aids.  Founded in 1969 by one of the original home-grown surfboard shapers, Jeff Townsley, we have a rich heritage and vast experience and lead the way for the UK Surf & Watersports industry.

We’re passionate about riding the wave of innovation, developing all our products in the UK and using only the best materials such as superior strength porcher fibreglass in our Surfboards, hi-tensile carbon fibre in our carbon skimboard range and Superstretch SCR grade neoprene in our wetsuit and neoprene accessories.

Shop Here

records.title: Good price and quick delivery
records.text: Good price and quick delivery. I was looking for a good board to get back on to the water. After looking around and at second hand boards I found a complete package on sale with circle one.Ordering was simple and there was a great deal of communication from the company to keep me informed.The board and other items were delivered safely and well packaged by DPD and I was easily able to track the arrival of it all.I will definitely consider Circle One if I need anything else while I get back into surfing again.

records.title: Exceptional will use again
records.text: Great service! Very quick delivery. Item is high quality and perfect for our needs. Well made, feels warm and durable. Bought for a wheelchair user to make trips to swimming pool less stressful as can wear to and from home. Sleeve design makes it perfect for self propelling whilst keeping warm and dry.

records.title: The best suit I’ve ever bought and worn…
records.text: The best suit I’ve ever bought and worn was incredibly good value. It is used for dinghy sailing, stand-up-paddle boarding, and surfing all seasons.Amazing surf board, buoyant and easy to use on small waves

records.title: Simple ordering process
records.text: Simple ordering process, great value, Bought one of their own surf board bags. Good quality, well made item. Delivered on time and exactly as advertised.

records.title: Ordered and promptly delivered after a…
records.text: Ordered and promptly delivered after a recommendation from a friend for swim changing robes! Arrived safely after transport from Royal Mail with a two day turn around. Well packaged and really pleased with the quality of these robes compared to some more expensive brands on the market. The robes are an excellent fit and look to be made from quality materials.

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Excellent. It’s really soft and comfortable to wear. Plus, really, really important, this wetsuit is so easy to put on-off. It is used for dinghy sailing, stand-up-paddle boarding, and surfing all seasons. The best suit I’ve ever bought and worn was incredibly good value. Highly recommended.

records.title: Great professional attitude and board design.
records.text: Great professional attitude, 'old skool', and I now have had 3 boards from CO plus bags and stuff.  The first board (an old Heritage log) was good, now sold on and I've had 2 bamboo; a 2020 9' 6" and now a 2021 9'.  Bamboo's look beautiful (and garner compliments) and just creamy to use. (Like old G&S Yo Yo' wheels for shredders reading this) If I ever have query or issue, like other reviewers, they immediately respond professionally..(perhaps they ought to retrain Apple stores/ Genius bars?).My other boards are 9' 4" McTavish Fireball and Electro Fish 8" twin so my CO is in good company.

records.title: Exceptional customer service
records.text: Brought a carbon fibre skim board on Amazon from this company. We had an issue with the board, and ended up speaking with the owner of this small company, he was very patient and listened to us and resolve the the problem. He showed excellent customer services which you would never get dealing with a larger company.

records.title: Sizes in stock and quick service!
records.text: I lost a wetsuit boot last weekend, somewhere between the beach car park and getting home, and wanted to get a new pair quickly (as I’m a wimp in the cold!). Decided to try circle one as I recently got a wetsuit from them which is fantastic, the best wetsuit I’ve ever had in terms of fit and feel in the water. Turned out really well for the boots too, as they had my size in stock (when other companies seem to be sold out of average sizes...) and delivery was super quick so I’ve happily got a pair ready for this weekend already :-)

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Excellent customer service, slight hiccup with the online order but soon rectified with amazing customer service. Above and beyond. Very happy with the board and products ordered. Will use again 100%! Very fast delivery even when ordered on a weekend. Thank you circle one! One very happy customer.

records.title: Customer service is excellent
records.text: Customer service is excellent. All products are very good quality. Beware of stones when skimboarding. My daughter caught a small stone on her first use and it chipped the acrylic coating!  Not a criticism of the product but an epoxy skimboard will not tolerate stones.

records.title: The customer service as excellent
records.text: The customer service was excellent, helpful, informative and really speedy. However the wetsuit didn’t properly fit me so I returned it.. the refund was prompt so no complaints there. I went for the ‘unisex’ wetsuit, but the body was too long and the legs both too narrow and not long enough.  The neck was too loose as well.  I am 5’11 and a ladies size 14-16.  I wanted a winter wetsuit for stand-up paddling and sadly this wasn’t the one. My search continues, but I would recommend this local company.

records.title: Circle One Pro Zipless wetsuit…
records.text: Bought a Circle One Pro Zipless wetsuit which is a great product. Fits well and feels great quality. Only reason I marked my review down was there was a slight problem with a broken velcro tab on the neck seal. Thankfully it didn't cause any issues for wearing the suit correctly. I phoned the company where we came to a speedy agreement on what to do about the problem. The guy James that I spoke to was really polite and helpful. I have also bought 2 kids wetsuits previously and will definitely use Circle One again in the future. Highly recommended!!!

records.title: Disappointing roofrack straps
records.text: I was not satisfied with the roofrack straps I received. The buckles don't grip adequately and had to be re-tightened frequently. I've had much better quality straps in the past. However, Circle One have generously offered me a refund, so at least post-sales customer care is good.

records.title: Really good service
records.text: Really good service, uncomplicated, just ordered and it was delivered. Marked down by a star as delivery time was slightly longer than stated on the website. I was however made aware of this on ordering.

records.title: Nice cheap summer wetsuit
records.text: Nice summer wetsuit,  quality feels OK, not sure of the sizing but all brands sizes vary.

records.title: The store's collection of wetsuits…
records.text: The store's collection of wetsuits caters to various water sports enthusiasts, including divers, surfers, and swimmers. Each wetsuit is thoughtfully designed with premium materials and advanced technologies, ensuring a snug fit, excellent insulation, and enhanced flexibility.

records.title: Great price. Fantastic board. Loving it.
records.text: Bought direct. Great price. Fantastic board. Loving it.Circle One 8'2" Bamboo. Sweet.Delivery was a bit all over the place. Had to chase for a tracking number. Tuffnells are useless in terms of being able to track.Had to physically call the courier to find out where the board had got to.

records.title: Genuinely helpful attitude to surfing and gear.
records.text: James was really helpful. Genuinely interested in talking through concerns. My old circle One Heritage board is 'fat' so needed to ensure board bag was capacious enough..it arrived earlier than expected too.  Bag fitted my 9 2 x 23.25 x 3.5 with room to spare.

records.title: Great quality product
records.text: Great quality product. Only a slight issue with parcelforce48 stated on invoice So after 3 days I called and was told it was sent Royal Mail as it was only one item. Good communication though, otherwise it would be 5 stars.

records.title: All good bar the fact the board could…
records.text: All good bar the fact the board could have been better protected during transit. Extra layer of bubble wrap wouldn't have gone a miss considering the price of the board.

records.title: Very satisfied with the service. Wrong colour though..
records.text: Very satisfied with the service. Board came with the wrong colour but in excellent condition. I would have given 5 stars if the colour of the board was the one I ordered.

records.title: Very good deal
records.text: Very good deal, only problem was... one of the fins broke after my first wave, can’t understand why.

records.title: Great products and delivery love my new…
records.text: Great products and delivery love my new board and love the extras would buy again

records.title: Excellent and fast service
records.text: Excellent and fast service.  Very pleased with our boards and carry bag.

records.title: Took a while to arrive!
records.text: Took a while to arrive!! But, quality bit of kit.

records.title: Great honest advice and fast delivery.
records.text: Great honest advice and fast delivery.I can’t fault them at all.

records.title: I  can only leave one star as I haven't…
records.text: I  can only leave one star as I haven't seen the item which I ordered on 48 hr delivery because it came a week later and I'm on holiday without it. It might be amazing or rubbish!

description:
Hand made Pool table,and Football tables made in the UK by expert craftsman.
Free delivery on every pool table. We also do dining pool tables at great prices. Visit us now at Table Top Sports.co.uk

records.title: Some issues
records.text: Paid for express 8-12 week delivery, £135, arrived after 15 weeks, no refund of delivery cost.Ordered with gift pack, company claim no gift packs left and socannot provide.Table delivered with dent in the side, awaiting details re next steps.

records.title: Placed an order but when I tried to…
records.text: Placed an order but when I tried to call or email no one ever responded. I was unable to speak to anyone about the order placed.

records.title: Misled
records.text: Ordered a black table worth £2000 and got delivered a grey DPT table worth £1250. Very disappointed as they wont even refund the difference. Beware of them offering an alternate and not sending you details to confirm before delivery. Always ask for the link to ensure you are getting what you paid for as we were clearly cheated.

description: Payntr are an independent UK cricket brand specialising in professional and innovative game changing cricket products.

records.title: Our boy loves Payntr
records.text: Our boy loves Payntr. He has been using Payntr for the last 3 years and won’t use any other cricket shoe.Comfort and performance are absolutely top!

records.title: Service from start to finish was…
records.text: Service from start to finish was outstanding. Boots arrived within 3 days of ordering and were spot on.

records.title: Excellent shoes
records.text: Excellent shoes - on advice purchased a size up which proved to be the correct decision.

records.title: Replacement bowling spikes
records.text: Replacement bowling spikesPurchased a pair of bowling spikes at the start of season in April, by August unfortunately the sole on left boot was coming loose. I emailed support with photo evidence and proof of purchase and they arranged a replacement pair straight away - as they did not have size 13 of the old range in stock, (orange colourway) they sent me the latest range instead (green colourway). All within a week - cannot fault the service, very welcome and much appreciated!

records.title: The shoes are really comfortable
records.text: The shoes are really comfortable

records.title: Really great customer service
records.text: Really great customer service, the shoes are epic too. Where i play we only have an astro wicket and other shoes i've used over the years provide no grip and you end up sliding all over the place. These boots from Payntr are like you're cemented to the floor - that front foot doesn't slide, even as a pace bowlerI wouldn't ever look anywhere else for cricket boots again, best pair i've ever bought!

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Excellent customer service, particularly from Jack.  I did have an issue with the first pair of golf shoes I received, however following emails identifying the problem I received a return label & they were swapped within a couple of days. Looking forward to seeing how they perform on the course. It would also be beneficial to identify on the website that the sizes are snug fitting, and a half size increase on standard size should be ordered.

records.title: Great service as ever!
records.text: Great service as ever!Ordered a pair of white bodyline 412 trainers in the sale, only to be advised there had been a mix up as now out of stock.Payntr offered refund or direct exchange for another colour ( which were dearer in the sale) at no extra charge.Great service as ever.

records.title: Excellent company to deal with and…
records.text: Excellent company to deal with and superb products. I ordered 2 pairs of boots (different sizes for different people) and one pair was slightly too small. I emailed to find out the best way of returning and getting a larger size and the response was very quick. The suggestion was to send both pairs back as the new size was a different price and order 2 new pairs. Pay for these and get a refund. All worked really well and returning was a very simple task and FOC.

records.title: credit where credits due
records.text: I see a few negative reviews on here , but credit where credits due . I can't fault there customer. service or products.bought a pair of golf shoes , and as they claimed they were comfortable straight away . fitted perfectly .the shoes developed a problem not through out of anybodies control .I contacted them via email on Sunday ,first thing Monday morning I received a response . now id just contacted to enquire after should this problem have happened nothing more . I didn't ask for refunds or replacements at this point .however in the email they said that this issue shouldn't have occurred and they would be sending out replacements .I just had to send them some pictures of the shoes and confirm the delivery address. that was on Monday. first thing Thursday morning a new pair arrived .so in less than a working week they resolved the problem.so I cannot fault them at all and have to give them 5 stars for their performance on this .thanks for your help

records.title: Very fast service
records.text: Very fast service, good quality shoes.

records.title: Great spikes, customer service poor
records.text: Ordered spikes and socks - spikes arrived and some socks missing from order.Mailed 3 times and got no response, eventually used a letter and got a great response and follow up to resolve.Its not easy to contact Payntr apart from the email provided.They are great products (spikes, socks) but customer services follow up lets it down.

records.title: Great products
records.text: Great products, but disappointed with Customer Service as i have been trying for a week to return  one product and no reply to direct email or contact form on website.Have since ordered product again with additional products as needed it replacing quickly but also need to return one of those.No customer service number to follow this up

records.title: Best for the cricket
records.text: Awesome look and lightweight but the size is not perfect. Somehow it is still feel tight after using for a month. Recommendation: take one size bigger than of your normal size.

records.title: Good so far
records.text: Good so far, bit of an issue with getting them to fit to the right level of comfort so my big toe doesn't ram into the end running down hill

records.title: Great products at a great price
records.text: Date of experience: 20 June 2019

records.title: Grip socks
records.text: The Payntr socks themselves are really good quality and a decent length. I have ordered these before for my son. I do think the P&P is too pricey considering it took a week to be delivered and the only packaging was an envelope!

records.title: Great product but poor customer service
records.text: Great product as I have been using this brand from last two years but this time I am trying to return shoes or exchange for the smaller size.I emailed them several time from last one week on they have provided on website under return and exchange section but haven’t received any reply. They don’t have any contact number.

records.title: Unavailable items
records.text: This was our second order from Payntr and on both occasions we have ordered and paid for items, received confirmation and then an email to say items have been dispatched only to then receive a further email to advise they have run out of stock on some items and refunded. They do refund straight away but to have this happen twice seems a bit strange.

records.title: Poor quality, slow customer service
records.text: Went to Bunkered live and purchased a pair of golf shoes from their stand. Got home and discovered one of the shoes to be faulty. Really poor quality leather upper. Marked and damaged.48 hours following 2 emails and a message on their website and they haven't even acknowledged me.Shocking customer service, no phone number and completely unresponsive. 14/3/2023 - Issue is resolved and shoes have been replaced.  Getting in touch was the biggest headache and once I was able to do that they were indeed very helpful in getting me a new pair.Still wouldn't regard them as easy to get in touch with, but once I did then everything resolved.

records.title: Second time lucky
records.text: This Is the 2nd pair. The first one I had lasted 3 games. It had started to crack from sides after 1st game and was unwearable after 3 games.. but i thought I'll give it another go as they were on sale. So basically I paid double the price. The one I have now hasn't cracked yet after 3 games so I'm guessing it will last me the rest of the season..

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: Poor customer service. No delivery date provided, no tracking details provided and when I emailed customer support to ask where my package was, I received no reply

records.title: Poor customer service and late delivery
records.text: After receiving the pair of spikes, I realised it doesn’t fit me. I wanted to exchange them for a bigger size.. it was so difficult, stressful and time consuming… after 3 weeks, I am still waiting..

records.title: Poor communication, 10 working day dispatch.
records.text: Item was not dispatched until 10 working days (12 total) after purchase. Even when the website states it takes 2-4 working days for dispatch. Payntr do not reply to the only POC on their website info@ payntr.com. Over 5 working days they responded once saying they would check with logistics as to where the item was. No further correspondence was received or any emails acknowledged to say that the item would be dispatched. Very disappointing.

records.title: Excellent shoes but poor delivery experience this time
records.text: My kids have really liked their previous PAYNTR cricket spikes for quality and design. I ordered new spikes on 8th June with delivery due 13th to 17th June. Enquired on 18th and said they had been posted with delivery expected 19th or 20th. Finally received on 21st. Still no tracking information available in the Shop app. They were needed urgently because of upcoming games and growing feet so not impressed relative to other online shopping experiences.

records.title: Payntr trainers and spikes fall short.
records.text: Although payment, postage and the like were good, I have to say the quality of these new trainers and spikes was poor. The size was far too small, more like a narrow size 10 (supposed to be a size 13). The upper was hard, unyielding and felt cheap, not pliable like the other Payntr cricket footwear bought last season. These new trainers and spikes, being advertised as a new design have very little regard to quality. They look the part, but seriously fall short.

records.title: Cricket Shoes
records.text: Unfortunately my order made on the 3rd November was not received until the 17th November and communicating with DPD and Pantyr was not easy. I still have no idea why the order took so long to arrive.

records.title: Shoes split, poor customer service
records.text: Bought a pair of Payntr shoes for my (slight) 13 year old last summer. He wore them for about 15 matches and the side of one of the shoes split across half the length as he was bowling (sufficiently that he had to go off in the middle of a match). I emailed Payntr as I didn’t feel the shoes were of sufficient quality given how little he’d worn them.They were totally unhelpful and said that, as I’d bought batting shoes not bowling shoes, it was my fault for not having separate pairs. My sons play club, school and county cricket and I’ve never seen a child have a separate pair of batting and bowling shoes (including the ones that play for Middlesex). I’d have understood their position if it was a six foot Jimmy Anderson pounding down the wicket, but not a child for 15 matches on grass wickets. They were adamant that batting shoes could not be worn by players for bowling.Only when I emailed back to say that was a shame as my son had wanted me to upgrade to their top of the range bowling shoes, did they then offer 20% off. On principle, I won’t buy Payntr shoes again as I felt their response was unhelpful and unreasonable. By comparison, my older son’s Adidas spikes are 3 years old, he’s probably played 200 matches in them and they’re still going strong.

records.title: Made an order two days and no…
records.text: Made an order two days and no confirmation email was really hoping to get my shoes by Friday so I can play Saturday 😭😭😭😭😭

records.title: Payntr are a dishonest company I…
records.text: Payntr are a dishonest company I returned cricket spikes by tracked delivery. The post office confirmed Payntr received the spikes, I emailed them regarding a refund. I was deliberately ignored. Worst customer service I've ever received. They will ignore you & steal your money. They don't have a customer contact number for a reason. You have been warned!

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: Initially fantastic golf shoes. Really comfortable and a great alternative to expensive brands. However, one of the shoes had a catastrophic failure in the heel where the shoe split. Subsequently, I have tried several times to contact the firm with photos to get an explanation and a replacement but after over 10 days waiting I'm out of patience. Will never be using the firm again. Disappointing for what was initially a great product.

description: Our centres have everything you need for a great day out and to put a smile on everyone's face! We have 46 centres that have on-site restaurants and bars. Many centres also include amusement arcades with attractions such as table tennis, pool tables, air hockey and shuffleboard. We also have some great activities at some of our centres like laser tag, escape rooms, karaoke and soft play.

records.title: A great evening and venue
records.text: Went the other night and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The ease of ugh which to book online is great, as is the venue. You can even book to have a pitcher of drink or food as part of your evening's entertainment, at a very reasonable cost as well. The screen used to place player names etc. is easy to use and adds a nice touch to proceedings. All in all I cannot fault anything in the service or game time we got to experience. Will definitely be going again.

records.title: Have the most amazing time for my…
records.text: Had the most amazing time for my daughters 17th Birthday, Bowling, Darts and Karaoke, Manchester Printworks, Fola should get employee of the month, made our night extra special 🙏🏼🎉

records.title: Great night
records.text: Food was great, atmosphere was lively and the staff were amazing, would definitely recommend and will be coming back!!

records.title: Fab work event location!
records.text: Organised a work do at Tenpin Plymouth Barbican and had the best time. Arrived a few minutes early to our booking and the lanes were all ready to go so we were seated swiftly, no waiting around for ages so thank you! Staff were extremely accommodating with our drinks and food order despite there being 12 of us and on a busy Friday night. Food arrived quickly and was delicious! Shout out to the bar staff who took the time to make some yummy cocktails too. Have had many work events booked here and have never been disappointed so thank you for another great evening!

records.title: Warrington!
records.text: Me and my family went to the Warrington branch for two birthdays, Chloe and the rest of the team were amazing and catered to everything we needed! Such a great bunch and they made our night. Would definitely recommend and will be coming back soon!

records.title: We went to tenpin avonmeads bristol and…
records.text: We went to tenpin avonmeads bristol and my grandson had accidentally tipped his lush puppy all over the floor, a kind gentleman whos name i did not catch came and cleared it up trying to make my grandson smile but he was upset so he came back with a brand new slush puppy which made his day! This was a cery kind gesture and much appreciated well done that man!

records.title: Brilliant Team Bowling Event at Swindon TenPin
records.text: We had a great works Team Bowling Event in Swindon, Tenpin, thanks to Vicky and the other two guys she was working with, sorry, didn't get their names!  Wednesday, 3rd July 2024, Swindon, 13.30 - 14.30 Lanes, perfectly booked, catered for and they extended for us when we ran out of time to finish our games.  Sorted us out with food and drinks very quickly and a pleasure to have as our hosts at TenPin.  They work so hard, much appreciated all

records.title: Went to our local bowling centre in…Worcester
records.text: Went to our local bowling centre in Worcester as I havent bowled since 1998 in the RAF, had a great time even had a strike first ball, then went downhill a bit. Got invited to join a team so will be back next week. Hopefully will improve.

records.title: Great Service by Management
records.text: Cannot thank the team at Tenpin Cheshire Oaks enough. Booked Huidini Escape room for myself and group of friends 3 weeks prior to visiting to find out nobody from Huidini was on site at Cheshire Oaks. The manager of Tenpin was superb she apologised even though Tenpin and Huidini are ran separately. The manager as a good will gesture gave us a free game of bowling to make up for the issue even though the companies are separate. Thanks again for your hospitality Tenpin.

records.title: Great team day out ! lots of fun! big kids at heart
records.text: I took a team of my clients out for a social day at Tenpin Leeds ! the staff were amazing from start to finish dealing with a very excited and rowdy bunch like us. They efficiently took our large food order and proceeded to guide us through all the attractions and games on offer before escorting us to our lanes.The atmosphere was really fun and we all felt like we could let out the big kids inside and let our hair down. the lights and décor made for a fun time and everyone thoroughly enjoyed themselves.would highly recommend for kids and adults alike !

records.title: They earned themselves a extra star…
records.text: They earned themselves a extra star than the 3 I wanted to give them as I had to ring twice and push our bowling and pizza from 1 to 2 to 4 which they did promptly and without issue. Lady booking us in was lovely and polite, and conscious we'd only booked an hour and didn't want to start it until we were ready. Expected our pre ordered drinks to be on the table ready though, not to be given a receipt to go and collect them ourselves. What was waiting for us was dirty glasses from the group before us. Same as all the other lanes and the tables. Although I respect they were busy when we arrived, as we were leaving the bar staff were just stood chatting to each other and noone glass collecting. Surprised they didn't run out of glasses.The pizza then wasn't a pizza. We had pre booked. They should have had enough pizza for their bookings. They offered us chicken nuggets or burger instead. I'm vegetarian. We got the burgers for 2 of the party and when they arrived we asked for chips for the other 2 members. The young lad was unsure and tried to get us to pay. I asked him to check with his boss because the pizza should have fed all 4 of us. And we got 2 burgers instead for 2 of the party. So they did bring an extra ONE portion of chips.Bowling was cramped. There was nowhere to put our coats and bags, and when it was put on the small table, there was no room for the drinks or food. Much less space than before. Even walking down to our lane you have to walk sidewards. Bit weird they have to manually pull the gutter guards up too in this day and age. I'm glad I got a cheaper deal rather than paying full price but didn't get the pizza which was unfortunate, and having to keep sitting at dirty tables was a inconvenience. Not going to hurry back.

records.title: Eastbourne Tenpin
records.text: Went into Eastbourne tenpin to book a laser tag birthday party as calls to centre cost 13min which is ludicrous. Despite the reception being understaffed and with long queues the lady Tas (Toni) was excellent. She talked me through the booking and party day clearly and calmly and was incredibly helpful.

records.title: Brilliant Karaoke Room(s)  🎤 They have…
records.text: Brilliant Karaoke Room(s)  🎤 They have at Telford Tenpin Bowling 🎳 I visited it yesterday. Although I found the price of hiring out the karaoke room expensive.I was amazed how smoothly and in sync the music along with the words appeared on Screen.Positive is : Great sound quality with smooth Lyrics to guide you in Sing the supposedly track you chose the Karaoke Computer to play. Negative : I do find the price of hiring out the room was expensive than I would of liked of paided. Would of been better if it was on a deal with the bowling.or even slightly discounted if someone took out the bowling at the centre.

records.title: We all enjoyed the experience and the…
records.text: We all enjoyed the experience and the food and pitcher of soft drink was fine. Our problem  started when we asked for a bottle of red wine it came to us straight from the chiller. We complained the red wine  was cold and they took into the cooking area to warm it through they did not understand our problem. Red  wine should be served at room temperature after waiting for half an hour we changed it to white wine instead.

records.title: Went 100s of times and my this is my experience
records.text: Went 100s of times and my experience is amazing but the problem is the tickets get stuck in the machines for an example, I get 100 tickets but some are missing.Almost all the machines are for tall people and the staff at the bar are nice but drinks are not that good.

records.title: Great place,but they need to bring back weekend breakfast bowl
records.text: We went to Rochdale sandbrook park Ten pin and its a Great place but a little pricey, even on the half price Tuesday deal but my children enjoyed it and the staff were friendly and helpful. I would recommend as it was good fun,but I think they should bring back the children's breakfast bowl on the weekend mornings.

records.title: We came as family of 9 and wanted 2…
records.text: We came as family of 9 and wanted 2 lanes together. Initially this didn't happen, but we spoke to Dennis the newly promoted manager who couldn't have been more helpful. He was so friendly and went over and above to make us happy. He did a great job and we will definitely go back because of Dennis. Cheers, Robbie.

records.title: Had a fun day with the Prison golf at…
records.text: Had a fun day with the Prison golf at Sheffield. Holes are fun. Only downside was a group of about 12 children without parents decided to start running all over the course and interrupting holes

records.title: Had a nice Saturday after at tenpin…
records.text: Had a nice Saturday after at tenpin Southampton, few lane resetting issues with the balls but the staff did help pretty quickly. Didn’t have any food but a nice cold pint. Family had fun and will return in the future. Good for a rainy afternoon with the kids

records.title: Milton Keynes one is great
records.text: Been twice to the Milton Keynes one, love the arcades and bowling. Me and my son love the Halo, space invaders and motorbike game they have. Booked bowling here as Hollywood bowl in MK is also booked for the times we want and I was not disappointed. We had a great time and the deals they do are really good. I love that you can download the app and keep track of your scores and earn points for money off vouchers. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is I ordered a pizza and it took about 40 minutes to come, it wasn't massively busy so don't know why it took so long but the staff are really nice and helpful. Will definitely be going often

records.title: Tenpin Milton Keynes
records.text: Had my son's 5th birthday party at Tenpin Milton Keynes. We hadn't been there before and were really impressed. It's a lovely new bowling alley. We had two lanes for eight children and accompanying adults and there was lots of space. The party host Hannah was very attentive, checking on us, bringing us the hot food as requested, bringing out the cake so we could sing and then cutting it all up. My son was given a great goody bag with a giant bowling pin and chocolate for him and all of his party guests in. We've also done parties at Hollywood Bowl and this was much better. The only reason I've given it 4 stars is because we had to share the kids ramp between two lanes which slowed things down. The staff did try to find another one but couldn't. They also said when I arrived that there was a balance outstanding which there wasn't but this was quickly rectified. It would also be better if scoring screens were up top as we couldn't see how the others on the next lane were doing. It's a really reasonable price for a great party. Would happily recommend and go again.

records.title: Visited Festival Park 22.11.22 at…
records.text: Visited Festival Park 22.11.22 at 13.00pm. New refurb throughout. More arcades, pool tables. But they have put the customer service desk and bar right next to each other and made them smaller. The queues here were long, took forever and only one person on each. Not enough staff here or walking around and no security either. Refurb is good. Girl who books you in, didn't seem to want to be there, miserable, not engaging etc . A man who was Tall, like 6ft, might have been Canadian or American was so helpful, friendly and nice sorted out a ticket issue for me. The display cabinet for prizes is around the corner, they expect young children to remember what item they want lol needs to be moved in view. Atmosphere was good, music was good, screens are good and you can personalise each screen/player.  Only issue is, it displays your full identity Christian and surname so the entire bowling alley can see, so GDPR isn't good  no Safeguarding people. Was packed out but good. Shall go again.*EDIT* Thanks Ruth for your kind reply. Shouldn't have to ask. Under GDPR, Safeguarding etc it should be natural. We are there with children, so full disclosure of identity isn't good, easy to be followed home. The onus is on the company not the person asking it to be changed when it's there before arriving etc. Also to go back the queue was long, so would of delayed our game time, and the next person who had booked the lane, as they were waiting already for us to finish. Thanks.

records.title: love to bowl at Exeter
records.text: At Exeter tenpin we are Always treated so well and enjoy our bowling.Is a little pricey for what it is but a half price deal helps!

records.title: Good for pool and bowling
records.text: Good for pool and bowling, a littleBusy does need to be booked but all in a good visit

records.title: came to telford bowl and had a great…
records.text: came to telford bowl and had a great time nothing was to much trouble and had a great game.

records.title: Disappointed with original visit but Tenpin did make up for it.
records.text: My original review is below, but I've updated it from 1 star to 3. The reason is because I was contacted by Tenpin and they did make up for the bad experience by giving us the missed items and organising bowling for us. Original post: We recently celebrated our son’s 10th birthday at your laser tag Walsall venue, and unfortunately, the experience was quite disappointing.Cake Storage: Despite requesting refrigeration for the cake, it was not stored appropriately, causing it to melt and lose its shape.Party Assistance: There was no assistance provided during the party. Our assigned party attendant was notably absent, leaving us to handle the setup, cleanup, and overall management ourselves.Promised Items: The birthday package, as advertised, was incomplete. The promised meal, giant chocolate bar, drawstring bag, party pin, T-shirt, and birthday sticker were not provided.Customer Service: Attempts to address these issues were met with silence. We tried complaining at the venue, via the feedback form, and through email but received no response.We are extremely disappointed with the service at Tenpin and would not recommend it for special occasions.

records.title: Nasty disinfectant smelling food
records.text: The game of bowling with my family was brilliant but the food was shocking! I got a family of 5, burger and bowling for £10. The burger was very basic, bun and burger…. Oh and the tomato ketchup sashes were so hard to get into I’m convinced you needed an actual GCSE to open it!! My daughter bite the life out of it and managed to get a small whole, enough for a drip. The pizza was the worst, it was stiff like card board and smelt strongly of disinfectant. I asked the manager to smell it and clearly he’s immune because he couldn’t smell anything. Needless to say I won’t be eating there ever again. Honestly eat at your own risk! Pizza with a side of bleach!!

records.title: Always have fun bowling here but we…
records.text: Always have fun bowling here but we used the karoake room for 6 people and there was only one microphone in usable condition. Wanted to use the arcade and found the card machine to not be working, informed a member of staff who said they knew and I then asked why a sign hadn't been put out and they just shrugged. Half the stuff advertised for ticket exchange is never available. There's always one or two things out of order in there. If they put as much effort into the rest of the place as they do the bowling, it would be a much better experience.

records.title: Visited the newly opened Tenpin, Walsall
records.text: Visited the newly opened Tenpin, Walsall on 15/10/22.Impressive set up but very busy and very noisy (music too loud), there appears to be teething issues with queue's at the bar and long waiting times for food to arrive. Burgers arrived cold, although fries were hot.The staff appear friendly and do their best to help (at the mo).For now, until the efficiency of the kitchen is sorted out I really wouldn't advise ordering food, you will be disappointed, also children would benefit from taking their own water bottles.Overall I rate our 1st visit 6/10 with definite room for improvement, the experience hasn't totally put us off and would consider returning.

records.title: The place it’s self amazing and the…
records.text: The place it’s self amazing and the kids love it. However the service is diabolical, the lady behind the bar snatched to money out of my hand coursing all the change to fall on the floor then failed with out food order and the manager was rather rude when I told him I’d paid in cash not card for my refund.

records.title: Went to Tenpin Camberly on Saturday
records.text: Went to Tenpin Camberly on Saturday. Booked for 15:00. Arrived at 14:45 as advised to be told previous group were running 28mins late. Eventually got on at 15:30. Touch screen wasn’t working so had to go to customer service desk twice to start our games. There was a ball stuck in gutter so again had to go to customer service twice again. Staff really were very unhelpful and our visit lasted an hour more than it should have. Kids running loose everywhere. Won’t be going again.

records.title: Booking experience was really good but…
records.text: Booking experience was really good but staff at Cambridge branch are appalling. No coordination or guiding about what would be the next step in the 2 hrs booked for the birthday party. They did not give the tenpin bowling pin until everyone left, so it was not signed by anyone and it was not given until I went asked for it.  The surprise gift to the party kids, which was a chocolate was just handed over to us only after all our party guests left, so could not put them in their party bags or give it to them. All staff just sit at the counter basically passing the buck to someone else.

records.title: Son's party.
records.text: Son's party.Reasonably priced, pleased with little extras such as balloons, more food than expected, keyrings.Staff were helpful and responded quickly. Pleasant to talk to.Son and friends had a great time!Unfortunately, we were not made aware of refurbishment and this was used as an excuse for the lack of organisation.Son was disappointed to find there was no bowling pin to be signed by his friends as stated when booking. When asked, a staff member came back to say there aren't any and no one else has had one. Not really the feedback I was hoping for when I had paid for it. Also no music.Overall a good bowling session for the children and would probably return. Would have been great if details stated would have been addressed.

records.title: Although the bowling is great the food…
records.text: Although the bowling is great the food is horrendous for extortionate prices. Drinks are really expensive too. Their machines are fixed (yes I know most of them are). So I ordered a large chips for just shy of £4 and they were not only a small child’s portion size but they were disgusting as if they have been fried numerous times. Made me feel really sick. 3 times on the teddy grab machine I grabbed a teddy, and 3 times half way up it conveniently fell. Not very happy with the service.

records.title: Freezing!!
records.text: My advice - wear a jumper! And coat, hat and scarf. For some reason it's absolutely freezing in this place, it ruined the experience for us. Also a very lengthy wait at the bar for drinks because of seemingly untrained bar staff?

records.title: Don’t order food
records.text: Golf was good, waited over 1 hour for food… wouldn’t recommend ordering food. Chips were cold not worth it

records.title: Walsall Tenpin
records.text: Visited the brand new walsall tenpin which has just opened. We visited in the day, so it was quiet. More staff than customers, but despite that, we seemed to wait a very long time to get served, as staff were talking amongst themselves rather than helping customers.On the plus side, everything was shiny, new and impeccable. I loved some of the innovative amusements like the giant hungry hippos and virtual reality ride. The bowling alley itself was also shiny and new and we liked the fact that we could take a group selfie. The score screens are to the side rather than above the lanes, which seemed to slightly detract from the usual bowling experience. Also there seemed to be a slight problem with the pin mechanism (maybe because it is so new?) but on one occasion I got a strike and the last pin stayed up but was tilted back and suspended somehow. It was very odd.Despite the fact that I came with my teenage kids, the lady at the checkout never mentioned the fact that they offer a student discount and I could have got them in for £5 instead of the £7.25 I paid. Also, unlike other bowling alleys, they don’t seem to offer any free carer places for disabled guests or have much in the way of a disability policy.Will definitely visit again as it’s our local and we want to support it. Most of the staff need to smile more, especially those on front desk who looked completely miserable. There was a nice lady on the lanes though who was very friendly and helpful.

records.title: Discrimination against disabled people
records.text: I went to tenpin chester today with a disabled man who I support I asked for disabled and carer but was told unavailable on bank holiday,  this is disgusting to discriminate like this I paid the extra as I promised him a good day out. Disabled people can't help being disabled and to deprive people on a bank holiday is actually not fair cost his parents  £30  bet if I go back Tuesday it will be cheaper  a license to take advantage as its bank holiday

records.title: We enjoyed the bowling though expensive…
records.text: We enjoyed the bowling though expensive I was even more shocked to find after I tried twice to book on line and unable it was premium rate I wondered why the man was taking so long to do a simple booking then checking my phone bill they charged £10 plus what a con for a family service

records.title: Tenpin, Derby
