records.text: Bowling good! Pricing of soft drinks are very expensive. Foods not brilliant!

records.title: The place is a building site but still…
records.text: The place is a building site but still open .staff friendly but over worked by the look of it. we intend to return when it is finished.

records.title: Don’t eat there !!!
records.text: We had a great time bowling there, everything was going smoothly until it was time to order our meals there. We had to wait for an hour with hungry kids just to discover that our order was taken into another table and they didn’t even tell us anything. When we asked them, there told us that it was “bad luck” and didn’t even apologize. This company won’t go far if they keep this up, absolutely rubbish. The very least they could have done was to make an apology. At least we got our refund back. Anyways, it was a bad experience and I’ll warn all my relatives of such outrageous experience. Thanks for nothing

records.title: Nice bowling alley but the lack of…
records.text: Nice bowling alley but the lack of choice on ball sizes and weights really lets it down for me, also i did talk to someone about this and they said they would come over with more balls but this never happened. I wouldn’t recommend or return to this venue quite disappointed.

records.title: Staff are great and helpful but the…
records.text: Staff are great and helpful but the site is poor. Men's toilets are absolutely disgusting. I have to to hold my breath to go out in. I don't often have a drink but when I do it tastes very watered down.I've recently been to a Hollywood Bowl and it was cheaper, much more authentically American vibe, clean and welcoming environment. Plus the toilets were not a health hazard!

records.title: DO NOT BUY SOFT DRINKS!
records.text: Overall, positive experience with bowling, even though the camera wasn’t working for us to take our grid photo. DO NOT BUY SOFT DRINKS FROM THE BAR!!! You have been warned. £2.45 for the smallest glass of Coke… It was actually embarrassing watching the bar staff serve our drink, as if he thought that was acceptable. No surprise he made us pay before pouring our drinks. Being overcharged for this made us wish we went and sat in McDonald’s across the road before we checked in for bowling. Hopefully, they find bigger glasses next time we visit.

records.title: Shambles
records.text: Booked the bowl and pizza deal to be told over half an hour later they had no pizza bases left which is fine so the lady said we can order food which was 2 burgers and a hot dog to which only received 1 burger and the hot dog. Partner asked twice to both ladies said they’ll go check on it but don’t think they did as never received the burger. Not impressed😠

records.title: Tenpin Stafford…
records.text: Currently sitting in Tenpin Stafford after 2 excellent games of bowling. The trouble started when it came to ordering some food and drinks. Initially the coffees were incorrect then two basic burgers and a kiddies hot dog took 55 minutes to arrive by which time we had finished our bowling and had to move to the tables in front of the soft play area.After ordering and paying for  2 more coffee's we were told after 30 minutes the coffee machines were playing up and could we change our order. On receiving two large lemonades we were still out of pocket the response from the staff was well they are large and we have filled it without any ice. The bowling and soft play area are great but when it comes to food and drink it is a disaster.The slot machines and games are also extremely expensive £1 for 20 seconds with one hungry hippo.

records.title: So dirty
records.text: Actual bowling game enjoyable but the Avonmeads site is so dirty and messy.  Empty food and drinks stuff in all areas.  Had to clear our lane before we could use.Bar area litter on the floor.Toilets very unclean, leaking toilet in right cubicle and no paper in left.No sense of pride or care take.

records.title: Technical difficulties, dirty toilets, chaotic reception, forgotten cashback.
records.text: After our arrival, receptionist did not serve us. She had to go somewhere else and we had to wait for somebody...Dirty and distgusting toilets. Problem with the tecnical equipment.Guiness was advertised, but it run out of stock.Cashback was not returned on my account as promised.

records.title: Bowling balls are not upto standard due to excessive wear and tear
records.text: We went to tenpin action for bowling and it wasn’t as expected. First of all the staff said it’s all booked till 10pm and we were there at 8. Which is disappointing to hear. However, we found slots at 9 pm online. I’m not sure why she said it’s full. Anyways, the bowling balls are not upto standard due to excessive wear and tear. Wouldn’t recommend if you are planning to go bowling here. Seems like a nice place for fun just not for bowling.

records.title: Bumper fiasco
records.text: It took four attempts to get the bumpers up. The young girl with black hair spoke to us as if we were muppets and told us the bumpers were up when they clearly weren’t. Another young lad was clueless as to how to put the bumpers up, took one look at our lane and walked away. If you didn’t want the bumpers up, I assume it would be a good experience. The manger is the only viable person to ask if you find yourself in a similar situation.

description: Come see what the Worm's got in store for you

records.title: Excellent so far
records.text: I placed the order on the Wednesday and received my product on Friday , speedy delivery .

records.title: Good bye Kookaburra, hello Woodworm!!
records.text: I've had so called 'quality branded products' before, but felt let down by the 'big companies' and what they actually offer. This time I went for Woodworm because I liked the company story and I wanted to support a homegrown family run style business. I have to say for the price the quality is brilliant and the customer service has been awesome. I am a brand convert for sure.

records.title: Fabulous quality for price paid!!..only…
records.text: Fabulous quality for price paid!!..only complaint I have is the delivery service was poor...1st item sent to wrong town and had to investigate myself to find out where my delivery was and 2nd delivery left on front doorstep in full view when we weren't in. Must point out this is dx delivery issues not woodworm!!

records.title: Great purchase
records.text: Great purchase, excellent delivery timeAbsolutely over the moon with these shoes Really comfortable and lightweight Wore for the first time on Thursday Would definitely recommend these shoes Great value for money Will definitely be purchasing another pair

records.title: First cricket set
records.text: I bought my 11 year old son a bat, bag and gloves from Woodworm as he has just joined a cricket club. The speed of delivery and quality of the items have been great. I think for reasonably priced, but good quality cricket equipment, Woodworm is a fantastic option.

records.title: All good - check sizes
records.text: All good, other than I had to change an item for a smaller size. Compared to earlier Woodworm purchases size "medium" was now larger, and "small" was the new "medium". My fault that I didn't check current sizes before ordering. 5 stars for item quality and ease of return and replacement.

records.title: Recent purchase of 3 golf shirts.
records.text: Easy to follow website, speedy delivery, I received my golf shirts in 2 days, very reasonable price and good quality. This is my 3rd or 4th purchase and I've been delighted with them all.

records.title: Cricket bat love!
records.text: Brought a bat for my son as the prices of bats are daunting and second hand ones are either covered in scuff sheets and tape or new sticker to bats  that are unknown and also soon he will be old enough to buy his own!! It comes knocked in but they do recommend  further knocking which we’ve done and oiled couple of times after… very very impressed with it, as are the players at my sons club. It’s only 7 grains but it has such and impressive bounce and balance to it. For £99 we haven’t wasted a thing. We also brought the Mega bite cover as we’ve invested so much time knocking and oiling we want to keep it sound. Over all great prices great products speedy service…. Am definitely a new fan of Woodworm.

records.title: I bought the ibat gloves and 625 pads
records.text: I bought the ibat gloves and 625 pads. the service was great got them next working day. I haven't had chance use them yet so i can only comment on how the look and feel.The gloves are low cost but plenty good enough for club cricket, I prefer a little less padding for dexterity but these will still offer good protection, they look and feel good but the non poteted thumb is a little long though.I am very impressed with the pads at the price point, lightweight (1.6Kg), again are going to give good protection, look well made and will resist some inclement weather due to the material. The middle strap is a little long (usual) but I just put some velsro tape on the pad to fix this and stop a it flapping loose, I am happy with the price and quality

records.title: Owzat
records.text: I ordered 2 pairs of batting gloves ....never had woodworm gloves before but my daughters first bat was woodworm and she did well with it.  The gloves are for 2 of my sons for Christmas and I'm sure they won't be disappointed.  They were delivered quickly, no messing, no problems.

records.title: Tracking trauma
records.text: The order showed as “Completed” very quickly, the Tracking showed as “Label Created” and that was how it stayed for 8 days.Requests for updates just advised to watch the tracking but nothing changed. I almost cancelled the order but then suddenly the order was out for delivery and arrived after 10 days.The quality and fit are brilliant and great value for money so we will buy again and would be 5* but for the promised 2-3 working day delivery.

records.title: Great multi pack of golf shirts
records.text: Bought a three pack of golf shirts to replace another Woodworm set that have done sterling service for the last decade. Excellent value for money, stylish and comfortable.  Everything you need. Fit is slightly larger than the size guide suggested but still good.

records.title: OK the purchase was good but the only…
records.text: OK the purchase was good but the only thing I was concerned about when I clicked  pay the screen vanished and just said you basket is empty and that's all. I didn't get a confirmation number or email for about two days.That aside the service is usually great and the products good value so would happily recommend but maybe look at that point of sale communication.Cheers Theo

records.title: Despite being let down on one of my 2…
records.text: Despite being let down on one of my 2 orders overall I was quite pleased with the service and items I received from this company. I would recommend in future that they check their products are in stock prior to charging and invoicing customers in order to avoid further disappointments down the line.Tony White

records.title: Excellent Quality clothing
records.text: I would give you 5 Stars if you had items in stock for my size (medium 3 pack short sleeve shirts), seems they’ve not been available for many months.  Overall though, the service was exceptional from start to finish. I’ve worn your clothing items for a long time now and the quality is just brilliant for the price. Thank you

records.title: excellent service prompt delivery super…
records.text: excellent service prompt delivery super product just one small snag on one of the shirts but may not be noticed as it may fit inside trousers

records.title: New balls please
records.text: Great service yet again from Woodworm. White match balls ordered...white match balls delivered. No fuss just straight forward! 👌

records.title: Prompt service,good quality and easy…
records.text: Prompt service,good quality and easy contact.

records.title: Woodworm have impressed me with
records.text: Woodworm have impressed me with, Good Quality, sports wear & cricket equipment products, most items are reasonably priced, their bats are well balanced & innovative by design, All this comes with, a very prompt & reliable delivery service.  Well done & Howzat! Woodworm

records.title: Great products
records.text: Great products. Arrived in Australia in reasonable time. Allow 4 weeks which is a little excessive in todays climate!Main gripe was the packaging. Very loosely packaged and the box had a hole in when it arrived. I ordered batting pads and gloves so luckily no damage, but not a good look upon arrival.

records.title: Hi Woodworm.
records.text: Hi, Ordered two packs of shirts and thay arrived two days early. I knew the quality would be good because I had purchased some before. Unfortunately won of the shirts arrived with some damage. I am waiting for their response, and shore l will get a satisfactory result.     AlanU

records.title: Recent order
records.text: I ordered spiked boots and pads . The boots arrived without spikes but a replacement set was sent promptly. The boots are good but the pads are terrible . Badly fitting  , straps way too long and after one net session the pads are scuffed .

records.title: Good clothing
records.text: Good clothing, exactly what I wanted. However the delivery system needs reviewing as it took longer than the expected 3 to 5 days and initially the tracker said it had been delivered to an address no where near me. When I queried this with the company I never received a response?

records.title: Ordered gifts for my partners…
records.text: Ordered gifts for my partners birthday.. Delivered in time and in excellent condition. One of my orders were wrong however as soon as I got in touch, it was dealt with straight away. Overall pleased with the gifts and will order again.

records.title: You was great as normal DX Logistics on…
records.text: You was great as normal DX Logistics on the other hand full address given can’t find us it was a company address which is online got the shirts I ordered thanks there great Thanks love you all just keep a eye on your courier

records.title: Had initial problem when order did not complete due ti system hiccup
records.text: Had initial problem when order did not complete but payment made. When I raised the problem it was quickly dealt with and I was kept informed. I am pleased with service given and the quality of the items ordered

records.title: Great Junior Bat
records.text: Great Bat, brought it for my daughter and she loves it, great service from Woodworm, will definitely consider when I change my Bat. Only criticism would have liked a toe protector on junior bat.

records.title: Overall Very Good
records.text: I tried to make my first purchase via Amazon, but was unsuccessful due to the advertised size not being available. However on the website the  unavailable size was still shown for a number of items, it became a frustrating trial an error exercise to find that actually there was no size at all. Woodworm did contact me and suggested the smaller size could fit as their clothing was generously proportioned, and this proved to be correct. For the price the products are good quality and therefore value. Also shipping is received next day at no extra cost. Despite the initial issue with unavailability everything else was good, and without that hiccup probably would have given five stars.

records.title: Received as promised next working day
records.text: Received as promised next working day, style, fit and colours are good not quite sure if the collars will wash and wear well, looks as though they may lose shape and crispness, in the round all good

records.title: Arrived in good time and appears to be…
records.text: Arrived in good time and appears to be of good quality and fit. Sizes are big for description so check the size chart before purchase. Just wished I could get out on the course and play!

records.title: I bought a pair last year and found…faulty
records.text: I bought a pair last year and found them comfortable,but after a while one of the seams split I am hoping that these last a while longer.

records.title: next day delivery failed
records.text: product looks good, however didn't arrive on next day despite paying the extra. I guess I wouldn't be writing this if they had apologised!

records.title: Problems with delivery
records.text: Quality of the shirts is excellent but, unfortunately, they did not arrive on time and when they did arrive they were the wrong shirts. After some confusion over order number which resulted in the wrong amount being refunded, the right shirts were eventually delivered thanks to Ed who was very helpful. This experience will not put me off reordering since the shirts are good quality.

records.title: Quick delivery, poor after care
records.text: Ordered new pads and gloves which were delivered ahead of schedule. Gloves great, pads looked good but middle straps would not scrunch up on the Velcro so stuck out by 6 inches when tightened. Emailed woodworm 5 days ago still waiting for a reply. Pads have now been returned (£14) as I can’t afford to get replacements and face the same problem. Disappointed with the after care, the kit looks good quality though

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Not as comfortable underfoot as I had hoped. Used for a long round of golf when new and had to return to the clubhouse halfway round to change out of them.

records.title: I only gave 3 stars because one of the…
records.text: I only gave 3 stars because one of the shirts is green in colour but looks light blue on your screen

records.title: Would really help if there where more…
records.text: Would really help if there where more products available on a regular basis

records.title: Okay, but not quite as advertised
records.text: Original package got lost in the mail, but this was handled quickly and well. I've not used the bat yet. However it isn't quite as advertised. The bat purchased was 2.9-2.10 the bats weight is over 2.10. I would have sent it back but I had already started to customise it (removing stickers)

records.title: I have ordered and received the order…
records.text: I have ordered and received the order in perfect condition and the products are very good quality but I did not receive my points yet to use for second order. It's very complicate and cannot sign back to my email or I can't see my points earned.Henry Nicolles have automated points system

records.title: Disappointed with the polo shirts
records.text: Disappointed with the polo shirts. They look and feel cheap. The colours are not like the colours in the website.On the plus side, they were well packaged and arrived reasonably promptly.Will not buy Woodworm polo shirts again.

records.title: No delivery updates.
records.text: The delivery was very slow, no contact saying dispatched or not. I was kept in the dark from the very beginning, but nevertheless the clothing is extremely good value for money! Really good quality for such a cheap price!

records.title: Concerns about Customer Service
records.text: I have purchased at least 9 Golf T shirts, 3 Golf Short Sleeve Jumpers and 3 Golf Long Sleeve Jumpers plus a pair of Summer Golf Shoes. Just about all very good quality and value for money in fact I love them! However (a shame I have to report this), one of the last batch of Golf T Shirts (Heather Design) had a water stain on the collar I was asked to photo it and email the result to Woodworm which I did but the picture wasn't great. The reply came back that is was impossible to see anything and try washing it! I have and the stain is still there. I did explain that this shirt was in an opened pack with no silica bag or indeed a label like the other two, giving the impression it was a returned item put back on their shelf. To be honest I now can' be bothered to take it up further as my time etc is worth more than the £8 I paid. Shame I am unlikely to order again unless their customer service improves

records.title: So nearly a great deal
records.text: I bought three shirts on a deal for £26.99 which is a stunning price.Some of the offers are even better than this!When the shirts arrived, which they did in a very timely fashion, two of the shirts were great and one had very poor stitching with loose threads hanging off from the shirt. I contacted Woodworm to ask what their thoughts were and attached pictures of the shoddy seams and stitching.I was told by Simon (S247PLC) that it was just loose thread and could be cut off and it wouldn't affect the shirt at all...Well Simon was wrong, it wasn't all loose threading and it did affect the shirt. The seam started to come apart!My wife repaired it but...it would appear they're cheap for a reason. Had I not had this experience with the one shirt I'd have given an easy 5 stars as who can beat, even match, Woodworm's prices...no one can.If you get them all perfect you've got a stunning deal...one or two or maybe even three with loose threads, overlocking not caught properly, then maybe not so stunning.

records.title: I BOUGHT SOME GOLF SHIRTS
records.text: I BOUGHT SOME GOLF SHIRTS Small and medium sizesThe collars are huge - Why?Make them normal pleaseI am not Harry Hill!

records.title: Good but seemed a little used
records.text: The purchasing experience and delivery was excellent, but the grips came with no packaging and looked a little bit used

records.title: Very poor delivery company
records.text: Very poor delivery company. No prior notice,so required to reset date,as a signature required.

records.title: Terrible customer care.
records.text: Lack of customer care, I left a voice message and was told someone would call back, It Never happened. No reply to a few emails, and I had to wait almost two weeks to get a refund. Terrible service. And Very Cheap products. I am amazed that you are still in business.

records.title: Great looking shoes at a great price but far too narrow.
records.text: Great looking shoes at a great price, but with an incredibly narrow fit. My shoes have been size 8.5 / 9 for many decades and I can't recall ever having a pair as tight as these, even though I've purchased shoes online many times before. A great shame because they really do look good. Sadly, I'll be returning them.

records.title: Set of 3 Golf Shirts
records.text: Item was purchased as a set of 3 shirts, they came in individual packs and the colours differed from the original picture.The company said I could return the shirts but when I requested that they cover the postage I heard nothing further.

records.title: Paid extra for 3 working days to be…
records.text: Paid extra for 3 working days to be told on 4th day delivery can’t seem to find address 5 days on still no goods or reply from address re conformationNot good

records.title: Would have given 5 if I actually got…
records.text: Would have given 5 if I actually got what I ordered , unfortunately, received wrong goods but was dealt with quickly and credited back to me.

records.title: Lost my parcel got a refund but had to…
records.text: Lost my parcel got a refund but had to do the chasing unfortunately in the day where competitor's are delivering in precise time windows to lose a shipment and not be aware of its lack of movement seems amateurish by comparison.

records.title: Too short in the body for me if you…
records.text: Too short in the body for me if you want to tuck in trousers

records.title: I expected a UK made bat with Grade 1…
records.text: I expected a UK made bat with Grade 1 English willow. The bat I received is good but made in India and probably grade 2 English willow

records.title: Didn't receive my items..
records.text: Didn't receive my items..Was told lost in post after chasing up 10 days later.. Refund was given... Disappointed..

records.title: Been waiting in all day for my purchase…
records.text: Been waiting in all day for my purchase of xxxl golf top still not arrived

description:
Rebound Fitness are the leading Rebounding company supplying high quality mini-trampolines to suit all budgets and 100s of rebounding workouts streamed through our online membership platform and also available on DVD.  

Through our flagship "Bounce & Burn" programme, we have trained over 2500 instructors  and helped to set up rebounding classes with freelance instructors in the community, gyms and health clubs, physio's and other therapists and junior/secondary schools - as well as individuals who prefer to Bounce to their own beat in the comfort of their own home, at the office or on the move!

records.title: good for low impact exercise
records.text: I have problems with my back, can no longer run because of the impact. Rebounding allows me to vigorously exercise for cardio benefits.Also so easy to put together, I managed it alone without difficulty.

records.title: The folding leg option is a game changer
records.text: I first experienced rebounding with Jason Vale at Juicy Oasis in Portugal. I did a LOT with f research into which rebounder was best and I landed with rebound fitness. I opted for the bungee cord rebounder with the legs that fold in for easy storage. I’m currently just doing a ten min health bounce in the mornings to build up to a more rigorous workout.

records.title: Feels solid and sturdy
records.text: Just got it today. I am new to rebounding world but super excited. This rebounder feels solid and sturdy. Great size for small space. It came fully assembled, which is fantastic! I am on a smaller size 5’1”, therefore this rebounder feels a bit too stiff for me.

records.title: Amazing customer service
records.text: Amazing customer service, got the rebounder its excellent quality and really pleased with it. I reached out to customer service and they handled all my requests swiftly and went out of their way to help me. Very pleased and would highly recommend this company.

records.title: I love the rebounder!
records.text: I love the rebounder!!   I've just started using it and am having so much fun.  I look forward to trying some of your workouts soon.

records.title: Great Customer Service / Care
records.text: Great Customer Service / Care - Looking to purchase a rebounder as a present for my wife at Christmas. Not knowing much about rebounders, I did some research and found Rebound Fitness to be the best option for proven quality. I emailed them and received a quick response from Liza.  Liza was amazing  - extremely helpful and explained everything I needed to know in detail.  No hard sell and actually suggested cheaper variants to what I initially enquired about. Also, can return product if not suitable.  Went ahead with purchase which arrived few days later – ready for me to wrap up for Christmas 😊.  Its refreshing to still be able to find good service nowadays – be it rare.

records.title: Very pleased with the order and shipping process!
records.text: I liked the periodic contact with me via e-mail regarding the order and shipment process.  I liked how I received the links for set-up before the rebounder arrived, so when it came I already knew how to unpack it properly and safely.

records.title: Very helpful customer service
records.text: Very helpful customer service.  Delivered as promised at short notice before Christmas.

records.title: A life changer for health n happiness
records.text: This is a top quality rebounder.  It is a smooth and quiet trampoline.  I notice from the different rebounders used in the different classes on UTube, some to be a tighter spring and at first I thought mine was a bit  soft with the bungee leads, but actually, it just makes me work harder so I have to keep up to speed with the instructor.    I’m using this daily.  The UTube classes are excellent. Worth mentioning Naomi Joy, Canadian instructor, does 10, 20,30,45 minute high impact classes.  I’m soaked and shattered but I recover quick.  It’s really made me very fit without damaging my joints.  Had to hang up my running shoes because of my knee and  so this has been a game changer.  It’s such a happy exercise class too.  You can’t help but enjoy it.  And you just feel like a different person afterwards.  It’s definately getting me through winter and I so hope it continues through the year.  Just 1 issue.  Iam really struggling to fold it up.  Watch the UTube instruction and so I’ve managed it twice but really struggle sometimes, having to leave it up standing.  I’ll keep at it.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Very impressed with the service and rebounder. Super fast delivery. Liza was excellent and a credit to the company. How refreshing to find a company that puts its customers first. Would highly recommend.

records.title: Still trying it out
records.text: The rebounder came very quickly while I was out.My son came to put it together as I can't bend down onto my knees, we've not been able to fit one side of the bar into into its slot. It is bigger than I thought, my own fault as I didn't read the measurements.But I’ve done lots of bouncing every day, we will see…Thank you

records.title: Boring
records.text: Ordering and delivery was no problem. Rebounding DVD was boring and second workout would not play. Worst rebounding DVD I've bought. Update: very good customer service by Lisa. Refunded for DVD and asked for info on kind of exercise I like.

records.title: Quality bouncer
records.text: I'm pleased with my Bounce & Burn as a first time rebounder.  I am a "senior" who will enjoy it for some low intensity aerobic and strengthening exercise.  The "bounce" is good and handle bar a must for balance and safety.  I'm happy with the quality but took off one star because the springs are not totally covered (as they appear to be in the pictures) which makes it hazardous for my grandchildren so I cannot leave it out when they are here.

records.title: This is a fantastic rebounder
records.text: This is a fantastic rebounder. So far I have used it once and it is so quiet and really sturdy. Has a very high quality look and feel. I was nearly paying €600 for another brand that did the very same thing as this!! The folding mechanism is great as it stays compact for storing away and the carrier bag is super handy too. Would highly recommend this bouncer.

records.title: Ease of folding feature misleading
records.text: I just received my rebounder yesterday and on the whole am very pleased with the quality. I chose this model because it came already assembled and the legs were easily laid flat for storage.  I paid extra for the folding feature thinking I could fit it into a closet if necessary.  I am a senior and am a small build. I was unable to unfold this rebounder by myself and a number of the bungees had come unhooked. Fortunately I noticed this and was able to correct it before asking for help from a neighbour. The videos show how simple it is with one person but the instructions say you will need 2 people to do this. Very misleading!  I seriously doubt I will ever use the folding feature now because of this.  I could have saved money by buying the non-folding model.

records.title: Sturdy kit but workouts not easy to locate/use.
records.text: Purchased the XL rebounder for the whole family. It is a robust and very sturdy product. Workouts are on-line but are not particularly easy to access. It would be better if there was an app that the user could download to partake in rebounder workouts. For this reason, it hardly gets used unfortunately ☹️

records.title: New fitness equipment Fitbounce Pro II
records.text: The bouncer arrived swiftly but it cost £20 delivery which was not apparent when originally ordering. Fitting was easy although one bungee strap had fallen off. It is a good size and should fit any room. Video was a good help. Quiet and well made. Should last a significant time.

records.title: only just got this
records.text: only just got this, but seems good so far.  didn't realise until getting this , that should i want to put the rebounder away , then it takes two people and as there is not two people here ,then unfortunately it is out on show which is not good when i need the space. video is poor quality but you can look up the exercises on the website.   Customer service very good

records.title: MAXIMUS Pro Bungee.    I initially ordered the maximus pro…
records.text: I initially ordered the maximus pro bungee from amazon.  However, amazon are a complete waste of time, as they could not be bothered to deliver it.  Not a good storefront for rebound.Anyway, got it direct from rebound, quite quickly.  Excellent service. The item looks to be well made and is perfect for our requirements.  I did hesitate about the stability bar, but not needed, and I'm a pensioner.  Once again, I'm really pleased with it.  However, one of my sons needs to be educated, because he thinks it's a toy.

records.title: The product came quickly but there is a…
records.text: The product came quickly but there is a £20 delivery charge which wasnt obvious when first ordering. Rebounder is well made and good size but one of the straps was not attached when delivered. I have refitted to best of my ability. Quiet, good quality and decent size, should fit in most rooms. Overall pleased with the purchase.

records.title: FITBOUNCE PRO 2 after hearing from…
records.text: FITBOUNCE PRO 2 after hearing from friends how good a bouncer was for you compared to running I went on the internet and found Rebound Fitness, looking at all the choices and reading lots of Reviews we decided to go for the Fitbounce Pro 2, really well made, easy to put up and put away in the carry bag. have done three workouts on it now and really enjoyed them, would definitely recommend using one if you have trouble with knees, so much better for the joints. GREAT PRODUCT, WOULD RECOMEND, ALSO IT WAS A VERY QUICK DELIVERY.

records.title: Really pleased with my choice of rebounder
records.text: Really pleased with my choice of rebounder, I went for the xl size so that I had room to enjoy the exercise routines. Customer service are very quick to respond to queries, literally within minutes which is reassuring.

records.title: I like it but…
records.text: I like the trampolín though it does make some noise which I thought it wouldn’t as I have tried others that make no noise.The way the trampolín is done makes the jumping harder that others so the workout is worth.

records.title: Squeaky Rebounder
records.text: Delivery Spot on! Made in China, not so impressed. Under the impression it was made in UK, my mistake. The rebounder squeaks, the cords rub against the frame, will give out over time. Purchased so my 6’ 7” husband could use too. Now worried it won’t last very long. Hope the product proves us wrong.

records.title: Happily My order was shipped out within a week…
records.text: My order was shipped out within a week of ordering and that included a bank holiday. Very impressed! I was kept inform at all times. Haven’t used my rebound yet, but my son assembled it and it looks very sturdy.

records.title: Excellent quality
records.text: Excellent quality!  Very pleased with the purchase.   Including in the instructions to  remove the zip ties on the bungy cords would have saved us some time

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Excellent customer service, really couldn’t fault it! Answered all my queries, were friendly and knowledgeable. Really pleased with my rebounder, would definitely recommend.

records.title: I love my rebounder and the workout…
records.text: I love my rebounder and the workout library. I do wish they would post more workouts; it is such a unique piece of equipment, the library is needed to support its use! Without the video library of workouts, there isn’t much else on line to support a work out program.

records.title: Excellent quality
records.text: Excellent quality, very well made. Just wish there were instructions about clipping off the zip ties. I had to search Amazon’s comments.

records.title: Good trampoline
records.text: Good trampoline, better than buying cheap and regretting it. Only rated 4/5 as time will tell regarding longevity and quality

records.title: The service was very good and delivered…
records.text: The service was very good and delivered promptly and the trampoline is excellent . I was just disappointed that 2 days after I purchased the fitbounce Pro XL it was reduced by £80 . The reason I only gave it 3 stars

records.title: The lower section of the stability bar…
records.text: The lower section of the stability bar will not come out even though the button is depressed outside of the hole that it inserts into.  I cannot remove it, and two of us were working on removal yesterday.  Other than that, I like the rebounder.

records.title: I purchased the rebounder as it was…
records.text: I purchased the rebounder as it was highly recommended with the caveat that it was quite noisy. It is extremely noisy which I find extremely off putting and am worried about upsetting my neighbours. Haven’t yet tried the Vaseline which is meant to help.As an exercise aid though it is very good.

records.title: Bit disappointed
records.text: Had to chase them to find out the shipment was delayed, also they advertised incorrect dates on their website. The 1-2 day dispatch was not true in my case. Eventually got my order in 40 days, rather than the 14 i expected when I ordered. I understand there are delays, but I feel customers should be informed as soon as possible.

records.title: I’m not sure if the product was new…
records.text: I’m not sure if the product was new when I purchased it as the disc was missing and there was marks on the booklet like it had been used. I understand that the company do sell their returns at nearly half the price but I was charged full price for mine. As far as the rebounder goes I would recommend this product.

records.title: After I ordered online I received a…
records.text: After I ordered online I received a email saying when the product left the warehouse that night I would receive a tracking number.  So I emailed and asked about the tracking number and then was told I should receive before Christmas.

records.title: Solid and good quality but extremely noisy (compared to previous rebounders I owned)
records.text: I ordered directly from Rebound Fitness, and my HIIT Bounce Pro Mini Trampoline was delivered promptly (Order #71586). It was easy to set up, and the rebounder feels well made and solid. However, the rebounder is extremely noisy/squeaky, and this is becoming worse (after just one month's use). I’ve had rebounders before, and none of them were ever this loud. In a way, I had hoped that this one as it was more expensive / better quality would be an improvement on my previous ones, but unfortunately this is not the case. Hence the average mark. I contacted the company before writing this review asking, but received no reply.

records.title: Great product
records.text: Great product - comms around order confirmation and delivery not great received the product before receiving confirmation it had been dispatched.Not managed to work out how to access the 3 months free access either.

records.title: Overall I am pleased with the…
records.text: Overall I am pleased with the rebounder.  Ordered on the 1st May and arrived on the 3rd, so very quick delivery.  It is obviously very good quality and looks sturdy and I'm beginning to get used to it slowly.  As a 65 year old with joint issues I'm taking things very carefully.  The only downside and the reason I have given this three stars is that two of the springs were loose when we unpacked it.  We couldn't find any details in the instruction booklet on how to re-attach.  We assumed that the long metal hook was to be used.  Unfortunately it buckled when we tried it.  Thankfully my husband still has some muscle strength left and he improvised with tools from the shed and between us we managed to do it, but it took an awful lot of effort.

records.title: Fast delivery and good service until…
records.text: Fast delivery and good service until there was a problem. I was hoping to be able to exchange or return but instead got a long email explaining why I had the wrong rebounder!

records.title: The rebounder is great apart from the…
records.text: The rebounder is great apart from the slings are not cover I didn't realice about that other wise I wouldn't purchase

records.title: I liked the opportunity to quickly …
records.text: I liked the opportunity to quickly order but am concerned at the length of time it takes to have the order fulfilled.

records.title: Long delivery date due to coronavirus…
records.text: Long delivery date due to coronavirus pandemic provided however no specific date given. Updates provided when prompted by me otherwise no communication. Package arrived in awful state. Damaged box held together by yellowing sellotape. Likely had delivery of very old stock imported from goodness knows where. Wanted to return unopened it was such a mess, however decided I had waited long enough. Upon opening found contents in polystyrene which was also broken and distressed. Rebounder appeared fine however thankfully. Contents complete but why DVD's - who has a DVD player anymore? DVD's looked a little bent anyway so probably wouldn't have played if I had. Very impressed with rebounder itself. Good quality, well made. Very easy to undo ready for action and to fold to put away into excellent storage bag. Good solid bounce, perfect width. Feels very safe. Safety bar not needed so no comment.Sand weights and elastic not really worth the extra in my opinion. Only 3 sessions and have had to use coconut oil to reduce squeaking already, which does work so we will have to see how long that lasts.

records.title: Great little rebounder but don't bother with membership or freebie DVDs
records.text: I love rebounding, which is great as I'm able to hop on and off and exercise whenever I feel the need. Bought a quarter-folding rebounder in the sale at a good price and very happy with it. Firm and steady with a great bounce action but a little too squeaky. Was able to unfold it by myself but wont be able to fold it up without help, which is a minus as it was bought for its mobility. It included 3 months free membership which I have now cancelled after 2 months.  Be aware of this as you need to cancel or it will take payment. The beginners DVD that came with the rebounder didn't work and I was sent a replacement plus a bonus one. Only one worked with my DVD player. I get messages saying that I have new workouts waiting but as I have had several problems accessing the members area I haven't bothered to try them out and as a result have now ended that membership. Am happy with my existing DVD bought elsewhere which offers three workouts sufficient for my needs. Customer service tried hard to make up for unhappy problems along the way but in the end, it just didn't do it for me. A great little rebounder but wouldn't bother with membership or any freebie DVDs.

records.title: The rebounder is quite noisy
records.text: The rebounder is quite noisy, I didnt expect this from the the price I paid for the product.

records.title: Very expensive though good Rebounder
records.text: Very expensive though good Rebounder. Still cannot work how to fold it confusing.

records.title: Shipping company has 1.7 stars for reason
records.text: The company they use to ship this thing couldn't deliver it to my college campus. They said it was because I didn't put the suite number even though I did it just didn't show on the shipping label. Addresses mean nothing now. The mail on campus goes through one place. You need a card to get in the building. 50 dollars in shipping fees. It will probably be two weeks before I get the item. Went to the warehouse and they mislabeled it and sent to the city 2 hours north of me. I offered to go pick it up there and they didn't know for certain it was even there.

records.title: Very disappointed so far
records.text: Very disappointed so far. Ordered and not yet received. After a number of weeks I made contact to find out when. Told not yet in stock and had never told me previously. Had to cancel and reorder a different smaller one. The 10% voucher was not added second time. Still waiting on delivery!  Eitherway no discount 10% or 20% is applied and I am still waiting on my purchase! (24 March)

records.title: I didnt get a confirmation email
records.text: I didnt get a confirmation email, I then had to get intouch to ask when my order would arrive. And there was no,thankyou for your order, and no receipt when arrived, plus I wasnt happy with the fact that I couldn't get a refund, if the item was wrong.

records.title: Still waiting on replacement mat that I…
records.text: Still waiting on replacement mat that I had to buy (it was not actually replaced by the company). It’s been over 4 weeks now. Four of the original mat straps very horrifyingly snapped while jumping.

records.title: From my Order till now is around 20…
records.text: From my Order till now is around 20 days and nothing was deliverd so far. Of course it is christmastime and the parcel Services a very busy, but 20 days are Not acceptable. Try to have a logistic hub or a Partner in the EU to ensure a faster Delivery.

records.title: MISLEADING WEBSITE - WITH LIES AND IN ACCURATE INFORMATION
records.text: WHILST THE TRAMPOLINE ITSELF IS GOOD... THE COMPANY ARE MIS-SELLING ON THEIR SITE AND TELLING LIES TO ALL POTENTIAL CUSTOMERS. Customers DO NOT get access to 100's of workout videos when they make a purchase... they only get access to 50! I'm not sure how they counted the number of videos they have but it is not 100's. Very misleading and disappointing for an over priced mini trampoline. You can probably get one just as good for a fraction of the price and not be mislead into buying it with the lure of 100's of workout videos. AFTER RAISING A DISPUTE, THEY ADMITTED THEY DO NOT HAVE MORE THAN 50 VIDEOS BUT STILL CONTINUE TO MISLEAD ON THEIR WEBSITE05/01/22 IN RESPONSE TO SELLER'S REPLY TO MY REVIEW:THEY ARE LIARS AND ARE CONTINUING TO LIE. I HAVE BEEN ADVISED BY PAYPAL THAT THE SELLER ADMITTED LIABILITY AND TOLD THEM THEY DO NOT HAVE MORE THAN 50 VIDEOS! ONCE YOU BUY A TRAMPOLINE, THE LINK WILL GIVE YOU ACCESS TO ONLY 50. THERE IS NO MENTION OF ADDITIONAL VIDEOS BEING AVAILABLE ELSEWHERE I.E. ON AN APP OR ANYWHERE ELSE AT ALL. THE WEBSITE CLEARLY STATES IN VARIOUS AREAS THAT CUSTOMERS WILL HAVE ACCESS TO 100'S OF VIDEOS WHEN A PURCHASE IS MADE. 2ND LIE IS THAT I DID NOT ASK THE SELLER TO SELL ME THE BUNGEE REBOUNDER AT THE SAME PRICE AS THE SPRING REBOUNDER, AFTER I REQUESTED TO CANCEL THE INITIAL ORDER. THE TRUTH IS, I ASKED IF I COULD HAVE THE SAME EXTRAS THAT CAME WITH THE SPRING REBOUNDER AS THE BUNGREE REBOUNDER COST A LOT MORE AND CAME WITH NOTHING, UNLIKE THE SPRING REBOUNDER THAT COMES WITH SAND WEIGHTS, RESISTANCE BANDS ETC. I HAVE MY EMAILS TO PROVE THIS. 3RD LIE IS THAT I DID NOT ASK HOW TO ACCESS THE VIDEOS (I KNEW HOW TO ACCESS THEM AND THIS IS HOW I LEARNED THERE ARE ONLY 50!), I QUERIED WHERE THE 100'S OF VIDEOS ARE AS THERE WERE ONLY 50 AVAILABLE AND NOT 100's AS STATED IN MANY AREAS ON THEIR WEBSITE. BASED ON THE FACT THAT THE SELLER MISLED ME INTO BELIEVING I WOULD HAVE ACCESS TO 100's OF VIDEO'S, I RIGHTFULLY REQUESTED A DISCOUNT AND THEY DECLINED, HENCE I RAISED A CASE WITH PAYPAL. THE FACT THAT THE SELLER CONTINUES TO LIE, SHOULD BE ENOUGH TO TELL POTENTIAL BUYERS TO BUY FROM A COMPANY THAT HAS INTEGRITY. THESE ARE BASIC MINI TRAMPOLINES AND THE PRICE DOES NOT WARRANT THE ACTUAL ITEM; PATENT PENDING/GRANTED OR NOT. IT'S A BASIC MINI TRAMPOLINE AND YOU CAN BUY ONE JUST AS GOOD FOR A FRACTION OF THE PRICE. ONCE AGAIN, I CAN COPY AND PASTE THE EXACT WORDING OF ALL MY EMAIL COMMUNICATION WITH THE SELLER. I AM HERE TO WARN OTHER BUYERS, WHEREAS THEY ARE HERE TO PROTECT THEIR BUSINESS. THE HAVE MORE REASON TO LIE THAN I DO. MANY THANKS

records.title: I'm still waiting on my trampoline!!
records.text: I'm still waiting on my trampoline!!. It is now over a month!! Review left previously. You have now sent me a a few more emails att: someone else's name. Please stop sending me review requests, just send the trampoline!!! Ps you did not apply discount when I had to order the second time despite you stating on your review reply that you did!!!

records.title: I was very happy with the customer…
records.text: I was very happy with the customer service particularly with Liza in the service department who helped clarify if I had chosen the correct mat to avoid any delays.One small criticism was using the tool provided to help fix the mat , I found it rather flimsy and bent easily and using  long screwdriver a better alternative.

records.title: customer service is aweful 0 stars
records.text: customer service is aweful , love the trampoline , but not the ripped foam for the handle that it arrived with ... customer service wont replace since I have no order number ..$200 trampoline  and cant use the stability bar  until I find some where to purchase some foam.. guess i will use duct tape since you dont back up your product when given as a gift. Gave you all the info I had ..

records.title: No notification of dispatch.
records.text: No notification of dispatch.No idea what courier it was coming with.I did get a DPD notification of delivery, but didn't know who the sender was.This was a Christmas present and the box arrived plastered with your logos and what's in the box.Recipient of gift answered the door...surprise ruined.I even called to check before ordering if it would arrive before Christmas, and I would have asked about the branded packaging...but no one answered the phone.Happy Christmas, please try harder in 2020.  Hopefully the product is great.

description:
Since 2013 we have been the premier Pre Owned bike experts in the UK. Our long established team are happy to chat and give honest advise. 

Safety - Buy in Confidence
Our buyers know what to look for. Our mechanics are thorough. Buying a pre-owned bike has pitfalls, we remove them. We check carbon thoroughly and ensure all components are sound. We ensure bikes are from a reliable source and not stolen. Every bike is serviced, tested and warranted.

Value for Money
Our network of suppliers and regular trusted customers means we have access to quality stock at the right price.

Sustainability
Our model extends the life cycle of quality products. We recycle, resell and reuse as many components as possible.

records.title: Excellent service and support for exchange
records.text: Excellent service and support during the exchange of my old bike for a new one. Special thanks to the staff who handled the purchasing process—they were incredibly helpful and made everything smooth and easy. Highly recommend!

records.title: Clear and fair buying and selling process
records.text: Very helpful staff and very smooth process to exchange one bike for another. Fair prices and free delivery/pickup over a long distance

records.title: The usual 5 star experience.
records.text: I have bought and sold bikes from Cycle Exchange for over 5 years. My recent part exchange was the normal 5 star experience. The level of customer service and attention to detail makes it simple and hassle free. The staff are always willing to help and give advice.

records.title: Very fair, quick and straightforward
records.text: The people I spoke with were really helpful and efficient. All communication was very quick and clear. The quotation was fair and once I had decided to go ahead with the transaction, everything went smoothly and quickly. Absolutely first class.

records.title: I exchanged a set of Trek Emonda carbon…
records.text: I exchanged a set of Trek Emonda carbon one piece bars which had too much reach for a shorter version. I was delighted with the bars I received and happy with the price I was given for my own bars in part exchange. It wasn’t deal of the century financially but at least I’m really comfortable on my bike now. Happy days

records.title: Great service experience!
records.text: Great service experience!Hazel was super helpful, informative, and patient with me as I tried to choose the right bike.

records.title: Overall a great experience
records.text: Overall a great experience Got good trade in for my bike against an electric Ribble Communication and staff support was fantastic I would use again The van driver was top notch long drive up north checked my bike and the swap was complete . The ribble was as described in excellent condition

records.title: Very Happy!!
records.text: The team were very helpful and were happy to answer all of my questions. Very happy with my new bike, it was exactly as sold and the delivery service arrived on time.Couldn’t ask for more and have already recommended Cycle Exchange to friends and colleagues.

records.title: Excellent all round service
records.text: This is the second bicycle I have purchased from Cycle Exchange. Great service both times. Great used bike, excellent condition, easy to complete the purchase online, and delivered boxed by Parcel Force within 3 working days of the order. Excellent all round service.

records.title: Excellent service, friendly & helpful
records.text: We all think our bikes are worth more than they are, but after a full examination I was offered a fair trade in value.  The extent of the examination gave me confidence in the bike I purchased and I have not been disappointed.  My email exchanges with the team were very helpful, polite and professional... Many Thanks

records.title: The bike I purchased was in fantastic…
records.text: The bike I purchased was in fantastic condition, the delivery was on the day agreed. I would definitely purchase again from this company.

records.title: great experience until my first ride!
records.text: It would have been 5 stars if i hadn't have had to pay for the gears to be set up properly by my local bike shop. It was apparent that during my first 10 miles the rear mech was all over the place so decided to get picked up rather than keeping riding. Yes I could have taken it back to Cycle Exchange but a 6 hour round trip journey seemed a little overkill LOL.

records.title: Such helpful and friendly staff
records.text: Such helpful and friendly staff. Communication throughout was brilliant. I've knocked a star off as bike was due earlier than when it arrived and caused a few issues with someone being at home. However, they did let me know and apologised.  I'd highly recommend

records.title: Trek Emonda P1 SLR Disc in Team Issue… Part II.  Missing control freak cable guide posted to me post haste by Josh and bike is built and beautiful.  Matches Fulcrum wheels I got from CE too! 5 stars
records.text: Trek Emonda P1 SLR Disc in Team Issue Red is stunning.  2019 frame that has never been built, is totally unmarked and £800 off original RRP.  It will work beautifully with my DA 9100 mechanical group set and a simply stunning bike will get the chance to live on and be ridden with pride.  Unfortunately came without the necessary frame fittings to cable and build immediately but CE team have been great and are sourcing all bits for me ASAP.  One star off but will give it back once I have turned a pedal in anger!

records.title: Nearly excellent
records.text: Some little mix ups with organising delivery but staff very easy to deal with. Delivery was very pleasant. Driver a cyclist himself with nice conversation and a very nice experience. Shame the the gears weren’t very well indexed - I will have to rework because the gears are jumping on first ride. However, bike is excellent and very good value.

records.title: I only received part of the order.
records.text: Initially I only received part of the order, in the end they did send me out another order because there was a delay or the product got lost with the delivery company. The team from cycle exchange sent me regular updates and were very helpful.

records.title: It was really easy to use site and buy…
records.text: It was really easy to use site and buy the bike for my husband. It came in condition described. Unfortunately the bank holiday made the express delivery longer as cycle exchange use Royal Mail, but postman brought the very large box into my house which was very helpful.

records.title: Bike was spot on
records.text: Bike was spot on, the problem (and this isn’t strictly their fault) is the bike was delivered to a neighbour and no card left at our house letting us know this. Had the neighbour not posted on Facebook that it was blocking her hall way and our friends told us (as neither of us are on Facebook) then we’d never had known. But yes the bike itself is excellent, in good condition and my son is really happy with it as his first ever road bike

records.title: Make sure you get your bike fully checked over first..
records.text: Good customer service. Only disappointment was after agreeing a price, only then did they want to do a proper check on my bike and I ended up paying more because it needed (according to their technician), a new chain, new break pads and a new cassette. I only had their word.

records.title: Customer service was great and the bike…
records.text: Customer service was great and the bike was delivered in good time once the payment was received. Very happy with the bike, the price and the presale customer service. Can’t help being slightly disappointed that the bike wasn’t finished in its cleaning. Would have happily paid a small fee for it to be polished and finished to a better condition.

records.title: Not very impressed order sunglasses…
records.text: Not very impressed order sunglasses last Wednesday20th June and still not received them 27th June.I have paid the £80 upfront.I must apologise to Cycle exchange as it appears the Post Office received the package and they don’t know where it is now.

records.title: Can’t fault the service I experienced…
records.text: Can’t fault the service I experienced purchasing my newest addition. Great communication on live text and a lovely place to grab a coffee and something naughty to eat. Giving the bike a test spin locally is very convenient too! Happy with my purchase. ☺️

records.title: Great Service
records.text: The process of exchanging bikes was straightforward and handled very well, however a day later I found that the new bike had 2 different length crankshafts. Cycle Exchange have ordered the new shafts and found a temporary solution in the interim, so all good in the end.

records.title: Cycle Exchange specialized tarmac.
records.text: I bought a specialized tarmac bike and a set of carbon rim wheels. I wanted to swap the wheels over but the workshop didn't have any brake pads for the carbon rims. They suggested I order them and then come back on a Saturday as a ' walk in'. I ended up swapping the wheels over myself and fitting new brake pads, cassette and chain. This is the fifth time I have used Cycle Exchange and always get good service particularly from Hazel. I would usually give a 5 star review but because I had to sort the wheels it's 4 star this time. I would much rather have just collected the bike with its new wheels fitted even if it meant waiting a bit longer.

records.title: I guess condition is relevant to the Judge. ***Cycle exchange paid for my bike to be corrected so fair play and increased by a star for customer care****
records.text: Communication very goodThe bike I bought was graded as mid way on excellent. I’d have said a mid point on good would have been fairer. Gears completely unset, cables worn, clearly a very well used bike and some of the bolts worn which I have had to replace when altering riding position etcFrame good condition but will need a full service soon and still lots. Bought as a good friend had a great bike in amazing condition so just a little bit jealous. Win some lose some. Not worth me returning as had used cycle to work which added 15% to initial cost then delivery. Probably worth a physical check rather than order.***to be fair cycle exchange we’re good to there word and my bike has been taken to a local cycle shop to me and gears set including new cables. Breaks were reset and cables corrected as well as headset tightened****

records.title: I recently bought a gravel bike and had…
records.text: I recently bought a gravel bike and had a good customer service while looking at it and test riding it. I was able to pick the bike up locally which was great and the staff there were also helpful. I also had some follow up questions which were answered quickly.

records.title: Expensive shipping
records.text: Everything was great! Only reason I gave 4: stars is because the cost to deliver was almost €100 and then I still had to pay another €134 for vat . Basically 55% of the cost was on logistics.

records.title: Highly recommended!
records.text: I stumbled upon Cycle Exchange purely by chance when looking to buy a gravel bike. I wanted to stretch my money further so their range of newly new stock was really appealing and it was clear to me that they take great care to prepare the bikes for resale so you know what you're looking to buy. I had exacting specifications are size, drivetrain and price that I was looking to achieve and found a bike on their coming soon section, I reached out to enquire and the team were great at keeping me informed of the bikes journey to be ready for purchase. Buying process was very straight forward (though I'm yet to process the Cycle2Work through [though great that this is possible also]) and shipping was fast. A few spacers went missing in transit and the team proceeded to get some posted out to me, sadly they were the wrong ones and not compatible with the proprietary frame so I organised some myself and Cycle Exchange even refunded me the cost of those. So, reason for 4 stars is really because of the parts being missing in the first place when I was itching to get out on my new bike but big credit to the team for addressing as best they could thereafter.

records.title: I traded in my old bike to buy a bike I…
records.text: I traded in my old bike to buy a bike I wanted, the process took few email exchanges and was very straight forward! I was pleased to get the app. After I tried it at the shop, the only gripe is that There was not enough sealant in the rear tyre it went flat and had to walk home half of the way! I top it up and it’s been fine since. Happy with the bike

records.title: Really pleased with my purchase
records.text: Really pleased with my purchase. Great price! Just missed 5 stars as I felt £5 postage was a little steep but to be honest I was still way up overall 👍👍👍

records.title: Did not like the nitpicking over my…
records.text: Did not like the nitpicking over my exchange bike while tbe one I purchased had a front wheel puncture on arriving home.

records.title: Trek Domane AL+ E-Bike
records.text: Ordered the Trek E-bike using the cyclesheme and purchasing went ok, made the point that I needed delivery by a certain day, over a week after ordering, let down twice due to a new delivery service, had to chase and chase...bike arrived 3 days later than expected...sent a link to one courier only to find it was another courier doing the delivery - nearly cancelled the order, very frustrating.

records.title: My Cycle Exchange Experience
records.text: Cycle exchange offer a great concept for upgrading or changing your bike. I was happy with my purchase and the pricing and exchange quotations seemed fair. I did experiences some issues with my new bike. Nevertheless, Cycle Exchange resolved them in a quick and pleasant manner. They have a great Coffee Shop. They also have a wide selection of high end bikes to choose from. Richmond Park is close by. This is a great place to thoroughly test ride your new bike our post purchase  Beforehand, you can test ride your potential purchase in close proximity to the shop. I would recommend Cycle Exchange to other cyclists.

records.title: Purchase quote shockingly low
records.text: I used Cycle Exchange to get a quote to sell my electric carbon road bicycle, which I wanted to trade so as to upgrade.  I was extremely disappointed with the quote offered given that the bike is only 1 year old, in perfect condition & with fairly high spec finishing kit.  Even the exchange price (which was higher) was not tempting.  I was prepared to take a reasonable hit, in order to upgrade, but as the Cycle Exchange Quote was so low, I decided not to sell my electric bike, and similarly decided I could not justify purchasing the new one I had my eye on. Altogether very disappointing.

records.title: Average
records.text: Not the best first time customer experience as the security tag was left in the garment so sent back for full refund.But a genuine error I think and sometimes these things happen.Returns process was easy!

records.title: My first experience of Cycle Exchange.
records.text: My first experience of Cycle Exchange.The online buying bit is quite straight forward, but then after paying a load of money you get an automated email and zero else.Was never told when it was coming and then after 5 days it did.Paid £85 for it to be delivered so be careful as you don’t get many options other than this silly amount.Ok so the bike turns up which was a canyon grail. I have had a lot of bikes and putting together the handlebars was a lot more complicated than I have ever seen but you don’t get any instructions just a box with a bike.So I kind of feel it wasn’t the best experience but I might have been unlucky

records.title: An ok experience
records.text: An ok experience, however, they were harsh with the part ex, although I understand the reasons why they have to be like that. They sold my bike about a week later for twice what they paid me which was a bit galling.When I received my rather expensive frame delivery in part ex back, the staples holding the top of the box down had come adrift so anyone could have reached inside and helped themselves, as well as potentially causing damage. Lastly, the frame was only wrapped in brown paper. Would have been useful to have had it in bubble wrap too. Not overly impressed with their packing dept.Oh, and they use Parcelforce, who are the worst shower of **** out there in terms of communication. They didn’t tell me the package was coming. Guy knocked at my door at 09:00 Monday morning out of the blue. Thank god I was in…

records.title: Bought pedals with my bike but wasn’t…
records.text: Bought pedals with my bike but wasn’t clear I wouldn’t get cleats too. When mentioned upon delivery I was told some cleats would be sent to me. When I chased this a number of days later no cleats were in the post and I had to source my own. This meant a very frustrating week of new bike I couldn’t ride which could have been sorted so easily

records.title: Use of ParcelFail the only negative
records.text: 5 stars for the bike, 3 stars because they use ParcelForce to deliver it ... who despite the value of the item, don't give you any warning whatsoever of the attempted delivery

records.title: The staff and team were professional…
records.text: The staff and team were professional and polite and the service very good. Sadly the bike was not how I would have liked it to have been. After the first ride it was evident that there were a few issues with the bike that should have been sorted before it was dispatched.Nick Baker

records.title: The price of the bike was way below of…
records.text: The price of the bike was way below of her specification and condition.

records.text: Over all good service. Kept in touch . Happy with the price. . The only negative point . The packing all the bits . Rear mech . Shiters chain cassette all put in same bag ?.not even wiped down . Straight of a bike in to a bag and into the post ?. But I would use them again . Bargain really .

records.title: Significant work was needed to re-build…
records.text: Significant work was needed to re-build the bike once received. Cycle Exchange has offered to fix, but obviously it would involved packing up and send the bike back. It doesn't make sense.

records.title: Some really good bikes  but lacks the…
records.text: Some really good bikes  but lacks the care and attention somewhat when someone is spending a not insignificant amount on a bike.Part exchange is OK but not much focus on customer retention.

records.title: I purchased a bike and it was not fully…
records.text: I purchased a bike and it was not fully serviced. A lot of the fittings needed to be tightened as they came loose. Bike was not in showroom condition when received. Oil marks and dirt from service..

records.title: Selling a Bike
records.text: I am currently trying to sell my bike and through an advert, came across Cycle Exchange. The process of obtaining a quote was quick, easy to use and very prompt in obtaining a response. However, the price they offer is below the mark, massively in fact. I appreciate the bike needs to through a service, checks, mark up selling etc, but that doesn't justify offering less than 50% of a bike's value. It's a real shame as I was hopeful.[Response] I really wish you could simply respond on Trust Pilot. The bike retailed at point of purchase for £1599. The ones now at £1399 are of smaller frame sizes, the bike I have is not in stock and hasn't been for months. The 3 sold on eBay in the last 6 months were the H30 model and also not near the valuation that I was offered. It will be sold privately of course, I was just hoping that the offer would be as good as the process. Thanks for the prompt response.

records.title: Recycled Cycle
records.text: I bought a bike based on the description, however when it arrived I wasn't happy with the condition as I didnt feel that it was accurate to the description on the website. I contacted Cycle Exchange and they agreed to accept the return and fund the return postage, I recieved a full refund on my purchase. It was a bit of a pain having to pack the bike up again, I would suggest they add a bit more detail to their description on the advert, they do a 100 point check but only highlight a couple of things that are wrong. They did point out that there are photos to attempt to highlight the damage but unfortunately the photos didn't do it justice. Anyway, all in all I am happy I got my money back.8th January update, I have checked the bike advert and it seems that the description has been updated, I did however get an email from Matt asking me how I'm enjoying my new bike, he was actually the one who authorised the free return...

records.title: Honest review here
records.text: Honest review here. First I will say that the staff was great communicating with me. The frame arrived in the description they described online. It took a while to ship but it arrived within 9 days of placing the order so I won’t complain about that. The frame is missing a few pieces of hardware. I had to buy parts for the seat post to use a carbon saddle which is pretty common. $30. This was a surprise. There were no extra headset spacers, I have to use round ones and they look terrible. To buy the proper ones $25. No water bottle holder screws. One of the bottom bracket bearings is rough. I replaced it. Tonight I discovered that the seat post is only 160mm and therefore it won’t fit me and I fit a size 54 frame perfectly. The new seat post is going to cost $300 Canadian dollars which I am not prepared to cover so unfortunately I need to sell this. I wish they would have provided measurements for the max seat post height instead of leaving it to me to guess, I was not familiar with the intricasies of this bike.

records.title: Great guys, kids bike, faulty rear tyre, no peddles ie on display but not fully checeked
records.text: Great business model and love the concept.  Interesting stock, liked the staff and the café.  Very best of luck

records.title: Very average experience
records.text: Very average experience, nothing to write home about. They focus on quantity rather than quality.

records.title: Sorry I wasted my time
records.text: I came across this site looking for an e-bike and was particularly intrigued by being able to part exchange my existing Mountain Bike for an E-Bike. After clicking the "Trade In" button on the bike I was looking to trade in against and going through a lengthy process of providing information and pictures of my immaculate, 6 month old MTB, it transpires that my bike, for unspecified reasons would not be eligible to be traded in against the E-Bike I was interested in and I was instead invited to choose a "manual MTB" to trade-in against. That's 30 minutes of my time wasted that could have been saved by simply advertising these exclusions on their website.Edit: they ask in their response how it gets to 30 mins, I’d ask them to see how long it takes to find the website, read about the bike, the process, get their bike out into a photographable position, take pics, transfer them to the computer and fill out the form rather than estimating how long it takes to fill out a form for someone familiar with it with pictures ready to upload.

records.title: Duplicate stock
records.text: Purchased the trek x-calibier 7 bike 2020 medium size which turned up very quickly within 3 days which I was happy about and the customer service was great. However, they sent out a large and said they didnt have a medium in stock. Other than that would recommend.

records.title: Bad experience
records.text: Had to call into my local bike shop to get my brand new bike fixed on its first ride out. Wheel buckled, brakes on the wrong way round, rear mech hanger bent and not working properly. Their response was that it was probably my fault. Seriously.

records.title: Incorrect fitting of tubeless tyres
records.text: Fitted new wheel set and tubeless tyres to my daughters road bike. Took the cycle to her race and wanted to pump some air into the front tyre, only for all the air to escape as the tyre was not fitted / sealed properly. I was unable to pump up the tyre and was extremely frustrated at the whole experience. You would expect Cycle Exchange to know how to fit wheels/tyres correctly onto cycle.

records.title: £6995 for a bike and they wouldn't fit…
records.text: £6995 for a bike and they wouldn't fit a pair of £50 pedals FOC.Tubeless ready but would cost £220 to be tubeless.The mechanics were excellent and set the bike up as requested.Sadly a potentially exciting purchase was soured.

records.title: Very disappointed with the service
records.text: Very disappointed with the service. I have sold my bike for a store credit but after 3 months there’s still no bikes available and the staff have been extremely unhelpful. The cash redemption offer is for 70% of the originaly agreed credit and only for less than 30% of the original price of the bike. I find the service just awful. I would be much better of by selling the bike privately in the first place. I did not expect such a poor experience.To call a customer a She is a very bad manners, I have been checking the stock or regular basis and when I deliver my bike I have indicated to the staff member what I’m looking for and have been assured that my requirements will be met. I have registered my interest in two bikes at the time and by the time I managed to visit the store they got sold even though I did mention that I would like to see them in person first. I have also emailed suggested of second hand bikes for cycle exchange and offered to buy them if they source them from eBay. I don’t think what else can I do as there is no stock and no willingness. Trying to find a resolution and best way within literally loosing all money on this deal was my best intention but I feel bullied by the owner and have been extremely stressed over this.

records.title: My delivery never arrived
records.text: My delivery never arrived. Fullstop.In today's world of multiple deliveries everyday (and the fact that because I had a bit of a deadline I ordered a second batch from a rival company which arrived sooner) it was after 50 days that it dawned on me that they had never materialised.When I asked about the delivery I was presented with the picture of a box in an industrial kitchen!From that point on all of Scott's responses read very much like his responses I see to many other 1 star reviews on Trust Pilot - Customer is always wrong. In near final correspondence, I was told how lucky I was that I was being provided a map of the location it had been delivered, but much like the original order I received nothing.My review has nothing to do with their sales, delivery or product (as I never had the joy of receiving the WRONG balls) but everything to do with the aftersales "care".I recommend people don't just take my word for it. People should read Scott's own responses to many of the 1 star reviews as a taster for how aftersales is handled.

records.title: Deceptive and no returns if you are in EU.
records.text: Ordered 100 "2017-2021 model only" balls with 10 balls extra free. 35% ended up 2015 model or older including 1x 2009 model and 1x 2011 model. Scott's explanation was that they were still making 2015 model until January 2017 so the website would take all 2015 models as 2017 models, (as if he had no input on packing the balls, running the website etc.) He did not give any thoughts on the balls older than 2015. I was not looking for a return however he did share with me "if you where UK mainland I would just collect and refund but as your IRELAND its next to impossible with Brexit and customs clearance issues to do this."Edit to respond below - Scott continues to display his "good business sense" as he called it himself. Firstly the full sentence in my initial email was "I am not looking for a return or anything but given the cost involved is there anything you can do re a voucher or similar for my next order?". I was assuming you made an honest mistake and was willing to work with you in future. My mistake.Second - I itemised 23x 2015 model balls, 14x 2013 models 1x 2011 and 1x 2009 model ball.So yes, thanks to the way you have dealt with this I have opened a Paypal dispute for 35% of the order cost as 35% of the balls were not the model described. They have the emails etc as well as the photo you requested then completely ignored. FYI my playing partners will totally agree with your golf game comments. Yes, I have no issue playing A grade balls, you wouldn't have many customers if they only wanted Pearl.
