records.title: Scam. Reviews definitely not real. You will not get as advertised and will not be refunded postage upon a return. Even if Scott (the owner) admits it was their mistake.
records.text: **look at any 1 star review this guys got and look at his respose to them all. The guy is an d*** to people and is never wrong.** Some reviews seem to get added to the site right after a bad review as well....paid reviews maybe? After 1 star review he had 6 5 star reviews all on the next day. With only 84 review all in all that's a lot of good ones in a very short amount of time after a bad review.... Scott has now responded. He says I can't have it both ways however the refund I asked for was the delivery charge I had to pay to return the product.£6 did not cover the return cost and I provided the invoice for him to review. He refused to refund my delivery charge so yes I was out of pocket. I do not understand how because I kept half the order I should still have to pay double the deliver fee to return the faulty product.The logic makes no sense?It's there fault I needed to post this product back as it was poor poor quality and not what was paid for but yet I'm still out of pocket as I needed to pay to return it, this was not refunded by Scott. So for their error I am the one who lost money and was out of pocket.The guys a joke.Review edited and changed to 1 star as they have now refused to refund my postage. So I am now out of pocket for their company's error.I was also told that he (Scott the owner) could have just ignored my emails all together if he wanted to. As if I should be honoured he even replied to begin with. Scott doesn't care about his customers and is happy to mislead buyers online. Be warned.I ordered AD333 Pearl / A grade - very poor scratches all over them, gouges in the coating looked like practice balls not as advertised at all. I also got Taylor Made super soft - these were only meant to be grade A - there were about 8 balls with bad marks and two with gouges in but the rest were okay. Again I sent images to evidence this. I emailed them as I thought it might just be a mistake and I was sent the wrong batch. Turned out it was correct. I was asked to send images to prove the state of the balls. I sent images and Scott agreed they were not of the grade promised. I offered to keep the Taylor Mades if Scott would reimburse my original postage cost and my return postage cost to return the Srixons. This totalled £10. Scott would not agree to this so I asked for the return address so I may send them all back for a full refund postage and all.My concern is these will simply be resold to another buyer as Scott did not really seem bothered to say the least.

description:
We are an online retailer of everything within the worlds of cuesports, darts, table football, table tennis and many more.  We also have a fully stocked store in Worksop with ample parking.  Within the store we have hundreds of sets of darts out on display for you to get the best setup for your throw.  We also have a snooker and pool table so you can try the snooker and pool cues to ensure you get the correct length and weight of cue.  We also offer a cue repair service Monday to Friday and are constantly re-tipping cues for our customers,  we also have a dart re-pointing service whilst you wait.

We traded with three separate websites called cuepower, dartspower and pingpongpower which were all very successful but we had numerous occasions where customers wanted to buy a cue, a set of darts and even sometimes a new table tennis bat but that meant three purchases across three sites so we built Sherwood Sport which has all the above and a lot more.  Our very first order on the site was a cue case and a set of darts so we knew the huge task we had completed was worthwhile and going to be a success.

We try incredibly hard to provide a fast and efficient service to all of our customers and are very proud of our Excellent feed back rating within the Trustpilot platform.

We hope to either see your orders on Sherwoodsport.co.uk or see you in our store soon.

Kindest regards

Team Sherwoodsport

records.title: Good service but all round experience could be improved
records.text: I’ve used Running Imp for many years for our running event and their products and service are always excellent which is why I carry on using them. What does irritate me though is that prices are always quoted without VAT and delivery and that they don’t always choose the cheapest means of delivery. My last order for example came in at a £27 initial quote but over £41 in the end (including over £10 for delivery). It means small orders can work out inordinately expensive. Other firms manage to quote with VAT and delivery charges so why not Running Imp? And please use the cheapest delivery method.

records.title: Disappointing customer service
records.text: I have used Running Imp before and had excellent service so didn’t think twice about ordering from then again.  Everything was going as expected with my order being delivered in 3 days which was brilliant.  However when I opened the package I saw that the engraving was not as I had expected.  When I phoned to inquire about it and explained the situation, I was told that if I wanted it changed I would have to pay for the order again.  When I explained why the error had occurred and that I thought the website was not clear, I was told that I was the first person to complain about it and it was basically tough.  I came off the phone feeling very disappointed at the lack of customer service and with my goodwill towards the company seriously compromised.  The order value was only a small sum but they definitely could have handled it better by at least acknowledging why the error had occurred.    Such a shame really when my previous experience of the company had been excellent.  Had it not been for that, my rating would have been 2 stars.

records.title: Whilst the manner and responsiveness of…
records.text: Whilst the manner and responsiveness of the team at Running Imp is very good, the timeliness and ongoing communication is not.The charity I work for ordered a product and had to continuously chase the order in terms of invoice, artwork, dispatch and delivery. Unfortunately the parcel went missing which meant we did not have it in time for our fundraising event.Upon pursuing the lost order, Running Imp always replied to me in good time, but I had to do all of the chasing. I only got updates as to their communication with the courier as to its whereabouts when I enquired. Which I did on an almost daily basis.In the end, they were kind enough to send out a replacement (once I pushed for this, and only then) which also got waylaid. It turned out that their staff were not labelling our address correctly so it got taken to the central stores unit at the hospital where we are based. Whilst it is not their fault that the courier was so slow to confirm this, it was their fault that the same mistake occurred twice and that their updates on the issue appeared to be at my request every step of the way.

records.title: Medals for children??
records.text: Ordered medals for 25 children, their ages ranged from around 5 to 7. Ordered ribbons separately and as they were for children I phoned customer service and asked if these ribbons had a safety fastening as these were going around children's necks. As these were not the cheapest ribbons, was assured they had.When arrived they did not have any safety releases. When I phoned they said the clips mentioned were for attaching medals. So these family and schools sports day friendly medals were not safe. We had to get the ribbons split and fit velcro fixings to make fit-for-purpose. Up till now had good service. Customers should be made aware of the potential hazard

records.title: DON’T deal with this place!!
records.text: DON’T deal with this place!!Completely unprofessional and has no idea about how to process orders, especially large orders for professional use.I contacted them to make an international order of 100pcs of plain 60g swimming caps (white colors), and my inquiry with very specific. At that time, I received a reply from Annie Flannery, Business Development Executive, with a quote of what I have asked for. Then, I asked for 2pcs samples to make a technical evaluation, before I place the main order, and I paid for the samples, and they did the shipping.When I received the samples, I was surprised that the swimming caps are blue and orange, although we’ve talking about white colors all the time, and they’ve never mentioned that they will send different colors, otherwise I wouldn’t have ordered the samples.When I raised my concern for the wrong samples, Annie said that they didn’t have the white color in stock when I ordered the samples, and it wouldn’t matter if the color is different. At that time, she mentioned that they have the white swimming caps back in stock and I can reorder the samples again. I stated clearly that she has to do that completely free of charge and it’s their mistake from the beginning to send wrong samples, and she didn’t agree with that. When I asked to contact her manager, her answer was that she spoke with her manager, and he supports her decision.Annie has never mentioned that they don’t have white swimming caps in stock when I ordered the samples. She should have mentioned that and gave me the option of ordering other colors or wait till the white is back in stock.All supporting emails and photos are available.Completely unprofessional and irresponsible company ☹

records.title: Used to be good but now poor quality. Beware being charged for a new die because they binned it
records.text: When I paid for the die for my medals I understood this would be a one off charge, however rather than email me to see if I might make future orders (considering I had already made 5 repeat orders of this design) the die was binned because I hadn't run the event during the pandemic and that design was deemed inactive. I had not been warned of this when the die was made.REMEMBER TO ASK FOR YOUR DIES TO BE RETAINED INDEFINITELY so that you don't get charged again as I have.I paid for a new die and checked that the design was identical, however the new medals are far inferior. It is impossible to see the design clearly despite differences in relief and texture being requested. Apparently this is a new factory and I was warned that the medals would not be identical to the old ones - I did not expect the quality to be so much worse. I have tried to resolve this with the Running Imp but have not had a helpful response. To throw in some positives, the new bespoke ribbons are really nice, and the turnaround time to delivery was good.However, despite being a happy customer of Running Imp for 10 years, the first two points make me question my continued custom.

records.title: Let down badly by Runningimp
records.text: Let down badly by Runningimp. No flexibility. No willingness to build a relationship with customer. Unwilling to offer escalation route. I will not be using them again, and will be reporting to my central procurement team at the university with a view to recommend that we do not engage in business with again.  Avoid at all costs.

records.title: Ruined my  school coronation party
records.text: Ruined my  school coronation party. We ordered medals  in March in plenty of time , I even called the company to check they could fulfill the order they said they could in bot hthe call and in writing. Then on 31st April I chase upp no medals arrive to be told they have NOT fulfilled the order and cannot fulfill the order. They can send a cheaper alternative medal. I agreed reluctantly offered no refund for the different on indeed offered any other gift for the children.  It is now thurs 4th May not all the order has arrived and now I have 125 children due to have a coronation party in school without a gift as this 'specialised schools company' have let 125 children down. I am still waiting for a call from the MD to apologise and fix my issue as yet this has not happened

records.title: AVOID!
records.text: AVOID!I don't normally stick my neck out on reviews but feel like I need to warn other businesses about Running Imp's practices. Running Imp are a classic middleman outsource company that rely upon overseas third party manufacturers to make their stuff. They put up a veneer of professionalism on the operation with their UK in house account managers. However they don't have much control or influence over the companies they use to make their kit. I asked for a repeat order of some snoods that they had made before. They told me they had changed manufacturers since we last had snoods made. However I was assured that they would be able to do the same pattern on the snood as last time. Heres the crucial bit - I go the physical final draft photo through for sign off. It looked fine, matched up with the pattern and was what we had agreed. I duly signed it off. When the 500 snoods arrived they looked very different to what I had signed off. The join in the pattern was completely misaligned. It looks v shoddy and not what I had signed off. I complained about it. Running Imp then were contacting their manufacturers abroad to trying to negotiate a refund for me. Seemed they had little control over the makers. They refused to give me a refund or remake the snoods. Claimed as I had signed it off they couldn't do anything. I continued to complain and eventually got a 10% discount in the end. Pretty disgusting to be honest. The mistake I made was not pushing them to show me the printing join in the snood.  The sign off images they sent didn't show to join. I signed off in good faith as it was a repeat order. This seems like dodgy misleading practice to me.Obviously I won't be using these people again and would avoid them.

records.title: Ridiculous Postage charges
records.text: I work in a school in the Highlands of Scotland, which contrary to Running Imp's perception is Mainland Scotland.  We were still charged nearly £30 for delivery.   When I phoned to query this, I was fobbed with the excuse that it costs a lot more to deliver to us.  This is patently not true as we get deliveries from lots of other companies, who don't charge these exorbitant postage fees.  Really disappointed and will be looking for another supplier for next year.

records.title: Yet more spam after unsubscribing 3 times
records.text: Happy to write another bad review because Running Imp continue to send me spam emails every few days and I have unsubscribed three times. This is a company that I have no relationship with, have bought nothing from and, responding to my last complaint said that had bought my address. But sending junk emails to people is not, in my view, ths sign of a professional or trustworthy business.

records.title: Great products, great prices, great support but incompetent shipping
records.text: I liked the range of products on Vector Air's website, their prices were competitive and their home delivery service really appealed to me, so I decided to make Vector Air my preferred supplier for this new hobby of mine and placed an order.As it turns out, this was the start of an experience marred by what can only be described as a great customer service sadly paired with extreme incompetence in the shipping department.Order #1: Reximex MitoIssue: the gun had a faulty sight that didn't sit properly on the barrel and it looked like it had been messed around with. I returned the gun for a refund.Order #2: Umarex Reign M2Issue: missing magazine. I ordered 2 in addition to the 1 that came with the gun; I received 2 in total with 1 absent. The additional magazine was dispatched the next day.Order #3: AGT Uragan 2At this point I was beginning to doubt competence levels and as I'd noticed they sold 2 different types of magazine (the new design for £40 and the older design for £37), I emailed beforehand specifically to ask that they ensure they send the correct one with the gun. In fact, I sent 2 emails about it. And they replied to those emails.Issue: incorrect magazine sent. The correct one was sent the next day while I returned the incorrect one.Order #4: Weihrauch HW50S 125th Jubilee EditionPretty confident now that Frank Spencer was working at Vector Air, I emailed beforehand to ask if they could confirm that this gun was in stock, not damaged and in the condition I'd expect before ordering. They replied and confirmed that yes, everything was good. So I placed the order.Issue: 2 days after I placed the order, they emailed to say the gun's barrel had some bluing on it and that I could either cancel the order or wait 2-3 months for Weihrauch to send them a replacement barrel. I cancelled. Annoyingly, I'd ordered a scope for the gun separately which had already been dispatched when they emailed about the gun, so I then had the hassle of having to return that for a refund.I've moved on from suppliers of other hobbies for less than this in the past but the difference here was that when dealing with airguns, there aren't many that will deliver to your home: most of them will only deliver to a local gun shop and some won't deliver at all. And as I said before, I liked their stock. So I had perhaps allowed myself to give them more opportunities to be competent than I should have.Reassurances from Julie (the MD) after each of these problems - only for the very next order to have the same problems - quickly lost their significance.I needed one more order before I could move on though as I really wanted another AGT Uragan 2 in a different colour and different calibre, with the accessories that matched those from the first order. So, fully expecting more hassle, I took a deep breath and placed the order.This one actually arrived with everything present and correct. They had actually managed to get things right on the 6th attempt. At last!I decided to pause my purchases with Vector Air on that high note in order consider my future purchasing options and to recharge my patience.The one saving grace in all this is that they were very reactive to fixing the various issues: refunds were swift and hassle-free and they were quick to send out replacements - even sending me one part while the incorrect one was still on its way back to them. I really couldn't fault the after-sales customer service.But failing to deliver the products the customer ordered on 5 out of 6 occasions is quite ridiculous. I don't know how a business hopes to be successful with that kind of failure rate.This failure rate was achieved with a customer who had even resorted to emailing alongside orders to double- and triple-confirm the items in the order to try to help them get it right. Short of driving to their warehouse and packing the boxes myself, I can't think what else I could have done.I feel pretty disappointed and frustrated with how things turned out: on paper I'd found the perfect supplier but in practice Vector Air just couldn't get the job done.With the customer service in mind though, perhaps what I'll do is give them another go every so often in the hope that they manage to overcome these fulfilment issues. I hope so!

records.title: Chiappa Charging Rhino,, NOT
records.text: we hope you are enjoying your Chiappa Charging Rhino 60DS Magnum.Right then as this is asking me to do a reveiw of Vector Air I will for a change firstly I purchased a pistol from them thinking that I would be getting the above-mentioned pistol the CHARGING RHINO I have been looking for one of those for a while. I had a look on Vector Air website and to my delight saw they had one CHARGING Rhino in black anx ond CHARGING Rhino in silver I thought I would go for the last black one they had rather than the last silver one they had.So off I go and purchase it straight away as I really didn't want to miss my chance at getting a CHARGING Rhino pistol I contacted the store to see if this came with a case and was told no so also ordered a case and some extra shells.About 10 days later I got a call to say my CHARGING Rhino would be delivered on Saturday morning. I was really looking forward to receiving my CHARGING Rhino  pistol when it arrived I was very happy with the way it looked and thought I had made the right decision going with the black model of CHARGING Rhino.I then put it away as due to bad health issues at the present time I am unable to use it so I thought I would order some moon clips for it as these make loading a lot easier apparently. I was ask to check the model as these clip only fit the CHARGING RHINO which is what I believed I had purchased. So I went off to collect and check the model and it turns out it's NOT a CHARGING RHINO pistol I have its just a Standard Rhino 60ds if I had known this I would have gone with the silver model which may have been the correctly advertised model. I must be honest when I say surely somebody checks these things as it now transpires I cannot get moon clips for this version as the standard Rhino pistol is not as refined as the CHARGING RHINO pistol which I thought I had purchased. I know I'm as much to blame as anyone else for not checking the item before binning all of the packaging materials. But I was sure the amount of times that CHARGING Rhino is mentioned in the sales blurb and its the tag line for the pistol on the website should someone not have seen this error.I must admit I didn't know there was a standard pistol as apposed to the CHARGING RHINO model but as sellers they should I would of thought.This has soured my experience with Vector Air and casts doubt on whether I will use them again.I take back that last bit as it would appear its just bad wording from supplier and not down to Vector air UPDATE THE SITE HAS NOW BEEN UPDATED TO STATE THAT THE ONES THEY ARE SELLING ARE JUST THE RHINO 60DS MODELS AND NOT THE CHARGING VERSION, this it would appear down to the supplier that Vector air used and the advertising blurb that came as standard from them.perhaps i should have been a bit more on the ball and kept the box it came in as im sure that had all the details on.

description:
Welcome to Home Pool Tables, a family-owned business offering top-quality British-made slate bed pool tables at affordable prices. Established in 1974, we started by manufacturing and supplying coin-operated pool tables to pubs, youth clubs, and leisure centers. Our late father helped design the early Super League 7 x 4 pool table, which evolved into the UK 8-ball pool table.

By the 1990s, we operated over 2,000 amusement machines and provided snooker table installation, recovering, and refurbishment services nationwide. As the domestic pool table market grew, we shifted focus to producing high-quality tables for home use, with custom design options.

In 2016, we opened Scotland's largest Pool and Snooker Showroom in Hamilton, South Lanarkshire. Today, we offer a wide range of games room products, including air hockey, football tables, and accessories. Our experienced team is available to assist with product advice, and we provide nationwide delivery and ongoing support through our Midlands distribution hub.

records.title: I bought the 6ft Gamesson Harvard pool…
records.text: I bought the 6ft Gamesson Harvard pool table.  Great table, absolutely fantastic, but no markings at all on the cloth. No Black Spot, no D area, nothing at all.  Messaged liberty games who sent out some spots, but wanted me to purchase a thing that marks out the D and do it myself. This is a brand new MDF table, not a slate bed. records.title: Website unclear and poor communication
records.text: Pre ordered a table which said was expected in stock within certain dates which was about three weeks. Then receive an email saying the table is with the delivery company and they will be in to touch. Left for three weeks chasing to see what was happening under the impression the item was now in stock and available to order as per the website and my email. I was wrong. Contacted livery games and we told they the delivery company will be in touch and that may be as little as 1 day before. In the end I had to contact he delivery company myself on what turned out to be three days before delivery. Website says they can't have the item assembled which under a pandemic is acceptable. What they don't make clear is that if you live in a flat the item will not be delivered to your do and left in the close. So your options are either leave it until you can make arrangements to have it moved and risk it being stolen or try your best to get it upstairs and be left with a damaged table.Cloth for pool table isn't the best and will tear very easily. Liberty Games will ask for a review you give them the above and they say someone will contact you. 4 days later you are sent an email saying I'm glad you love the product can you leave a review? Don't get me wrong the product was a great price but don't expect much in terms of delivery updates or service and read the full website before ordering just in case. A shame really because I did ask for a change to be made the first working day after the order was placed due to PayPal changing the address and the girl I spoke to was lovely and helpful.

records.title: Good Customer Service, Poor quality product
records.text: We ordered a multi-games table with dining tops from Liberty Games and were told immediately that there would be a delay, as the table wasn't in stock. This wasn't a problem, as we weren't in a rush for it, so no complaints there.Before the estimated delivery date, we were contacted by the courier, as they could deliver the table within a couple of days. This was sooner than we had anticipated, but managed to arrange our work schedules so that someone would be home to accept delivery.We had three rugby-playing friends and some workbenches to help to assemble the table, but it was immediately apparent that something wasn't right. The 'inner' rotating part of the table wasn't level with the 'outer part, so when the dining tops are on the table, there is quite a gap between the table and the tops, so we cannot use the table for dining as the tops aren't stable. The MDF surface of the pool table isn't flat, so is impossible to be level. The pool cushions are not very responsive, and there is a defined 'thud' as the balls hit them. The balls even leave the bed of the table when they hit two of the cushions, even though they aren't hit hard.We did bring these issues up with Liberty Games, who offered us some upgraded cues, but the table is just not fit for purpose. The cushions absorb so much momentum of the balls that it is nearly impossible to hit the cue ball down the length of the table and get it to return to its starting position. We have arranged to donate it to a local youth club, who will be collecting it when the autumn term starts in ten weeks. Until then, it's taking space up while we decide on a different table to replace it.We do wonder if it was manufactured too quickly, so Liberty's supplier (Pureline) cut corners during the manufacturing process. There was some minor superficial damage to the table on delivery, with one of the bolts needed for the legs missing also. Other customers seem happy with their tables, so we were unfortunate in being sold a 'dud', and despite the efforts of the Customer Services Department at Liberty Games, are unlikely to buy our replacement table from them.

records.title: Poor Customer Services

I haven’t and don’t even want to look if it even fits. Pool table works well without the silver trim sent today. Also had trouble with balls going through particular pockets. Eventually fixed. So defo for sure with all the hassle we could have bought a pool table from eBay and maybe who knows had less trouble then we had with a brand new one. 16/06/2023UPDATE 20/06/23CUSTOMER SERVICE HAVE BEEN IN TOUCH AND OFFERED AN APOLOGY WITH AN EXPLANATION AND COMPENSATION FOR OUR TROUBLES 👍👍😀😀

records.title: Non existent customer service - Update 14.12.2022
records.text: Update 14.12.2022 - we had a second attempt at delivery yesterday, installation team were excellent and first class, unfortunately again the table we received was damaged, although we were promised that this would have been Quality checked prior to dispatch, luckily they had another of these tables onboard and that was in better condition (but not ideal).The finish of the table is poor and the table tops we have (which were the best two out of four) have the laminate peeling away.Accessories for this table are very poor quality (not liberty games's fault), one of the table tennis balls had holes in and is unusable for example and if we used the clamps for the net it would damage the table top further.Original post - Terrible experience, ordered a brand new pool table with installation, what we received was a damaged/used pool table with the logistics team not contracted for the install.  Quickly established on delivery that the product was not straight  from the manufacturer, box.had been sellotaped together, on opening table was clearly damaged, 3 unsuccessful attempts to contact customer services with no response, appalling service and a highly disappointing experience

records.title: I ordered my 7' Supreme Winner pool…

records.title: I  hope this message finds you well
records.text: I  hope this message finds you well. I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service I have received following my recent purchase of three machines from your store. While the payment process was smooth and efficient, the post-purchase support has been extremely disappointing, and my issue remains unresolved.Here is a summary of the situation:Incorrect Delivery: Initially, I received two wrong machines, rather than the ones I had ordered. After several emails and phone calls, your team agreed to replace the incorrect units with the correct ones, which I appreciated.Decision to Exchange One Machine: After the correct machines were delivered, we decided to keep one of the machines and exchange the other. However, upon testing, we found that the Time Crisis machine was not working properly.Faulty Product: Despite sending more than 4-5 follow-up emails and making several calls to your customer support team, the issue with the Time Crisis machine has still not been resolved. Unfortunately, after these numerous attempts to contact your team, I have not received any replies, and my issue remains unaddressed.It is extremely frustrating that after making the purchase, I have been left with a faulty product and no assistance from your team. It is clear that your customer service, which was responsive up until the point of payment, has become non-existent once the sale was completed.I request the following actions be taken:Immediate attention to the faulty Time Crisis machine: Please provide a resolution, either through a replacement, repair, or a full refund for the faulty machine.Improved customer service communication: I kindly ask that you respond to my emails and phone calls in a timely manner, as this issue has been dragging on for far too long.Please acknowledge receipt of this complaint and inform me of the next steps for resolving this matter as soon as possible.I look forward to your prompt response and a resolution to this issue.Sincerely,[CUSTOMER NUMBER 242955]

description:
Zerofit is a Japanese specialist baselayer brand which was founded by Mr Koji Higashi in 2005. It launched in the UK and Europe in 2018 before further expansion into North America in 2020 and Australasia in 2021. 
The award-winning Heatrub Ultimate baselayer was unveiled to the Japanese public in 2011 and since then hundreds of thousands of outdoor enthusiasts have discovered the benefits of that best-in-class product. Independently tested and proven to be five times warmer than a standard baselayer, the Heatrub Ultimate has become a must-have item in the coldest months of the year and, such was the popularity of the baselayer, Zerofit now offer leggings and socks made from the same material.
Other key products include the Heatrub Move baselayer, which features Adaptable Warmth Technology, keeping you warm while at a standstill but also temperature regulation when you’re working up a sweat. For the summer months, the Cold Skin baselayer is three times colder than a competitor product, while the Ice Weave is the master when it comes to wicking excess sweat in the hottest conditions.
Following exponential growth across industries including motorcycling, angling, running, hiking, sailing, golf, gardening, birdwatching and equestrian sports, Zerofit welcomed a new shareholder and ambassador in February 2023 - Brian O'Driscoll, the former Leinster, Ireland and British & Irish Lions rugby captain in order to help further enhance the business across multiple categories. And since November 2023, Bennetts British Superbikes Runner-Up Glenn Irwin has joined the brand as an ambassador. He will rely on Zerofit baselayers while racing during the 2024 season. 
The European HQ of Zerofit is in County Antrim, Northern Ireland, with further offices in Adelaide, Australia and San Diego in the US. Specialist customer service teams in each country ensure prompt and accurate delivery of products as the brand continues to grow globally.
Whatever your sport or activity, we hope Zerofit will become your baselayer brand of choice.

records.title: My zerofit ultimate baselayer top and…

I don't like the GAME you and many manfacturers play with the ORIGIN of goods though. The JAPAN design on line statements and the JAPAN trade mark on the boxes, implies PERHAPS the product is made in Japan. As I suspected, the Zerofit products are MADE IN CHINA.I know this game. Marketing products as MADE IN CHINA, does not improve their appeal to some potential customers like me. Japanese manufactured goods have a long held reputation for quality.Lack of regulation is the real issue here. Labelling regulations on food, have to state country of origin or at least identify the EU.

Tested it on a motorcycle ride at 6 degrees and it was warm for a while, I usually wear two long sleeve thermal vests and I would say that the zerofit base layer was about the same. The neck on the top is a bit ...wide or loose feeling in the fit, not snug to keep out the weather...the pants are a bit short feeling in the rise for a good base layer fit but not by much...over all the product is impressive and I am looking forward to testing in cold conditions in the Rockies this winter. records.title: Lovely fit

records.text: They do keep you VERY warm. Much thicker than other thermal base layers I own. After several hours working outside they were very damp, almost soggy when peeled off. Excellent insulation but I wouldn't like to wear them for a whole day.

Had them on during the day and twice on the golf course and must admit don’t think they are much warmer than my normal footjoy or under armour socks.I bought a pair for my son who works at a lorry driver and he said the same I wanted them to be great the same as the tops but a bit disappointed with them.

records.title: Beware The Short Sleeves!

Cannot possibly recommend for cycling, motorcycling or any other 'arms out/forward' activity. They should offer a long sleeved option, preferably with thumb loops  if they want to be taken seriously. records.title: First time customer, cards were not factory sealed as advertised
records.text: First time using the website and I upon receiving a box of prizm soccer cards I was surprised to see the box was not sealed. As per the images on the website the particular product was plastic wrapped. I have also purchased these products from other sellers and they have always arrived with a plastic seal. records.title: A cautionary tale
records.text: My son purchased some WWE cards which were delivered earlier this week. The boxes were sealed in shrinkwrap, and inside the boxes, the individual packs appeared to be sealed, however he told me that with one of the boxes "something just didn't feel right" as the packs didn't appear to be as tightly sealed as normal. His fears were further compounded when one pack only contained three cards instead of four. I was unaware of all this until after he'd opened all the packs, or I would have advised him not to open any more. I suggested he contact the company, however he quite rightly pointed out that as he'd opened them all, there was no proof, and he also said that if he did complain it would only make it look like he was moaning because there weren't any decent cards in any of the packs. He's a keen collector, and he's not stupid, but his gut feeling was that these packs were not factory sealed. I'm not suggesting that anything untoward happened at the retailers, but there is a possibility it could have somewhere along the supply chain. I've advised him not to buy from this retailer again to be on the safe side.

description:
Clubhouse Golf is the largest and most trusted independent golf retailer in the UK.

As a multi-channel golf company we are passionate about the game as we don't just sell golf products, we also live golf! With over 30 years experience in golf retail we have established ourselves as one of the most trusted companies both online and on the high street. 
With over 250,000 customers across the UK and Europe, our success is down to providing total commitment and dedication to all our customers giving them 100% satisfaction. With a full team of PGA Golf Professional's and expert staff, our philosophy is to provide industry leading customer service coupled with the largest range of golf products at the lowest possible prices!

records.title: Mixed opinion..
records.text: A decent selection of kit. I was impressed with the range of footwear and ease of searching for particular sizes. I bought a pair of New Balance spikeless golf shoes, which feel like good quality, although do need some breaking in (big blisters on my first round, despite ordering a larger size). I was less impressed with the Big Max stand bag I bought. It is very short on space - I'm only carrying 10 clubs, and they feel a bit of a squeeze. Likewise, number and size of pockets. The 'phone' pocket is barely big enough to squeeze a normal smartphone into. I can just about get a small set of waterproofs in. Delivery was disappointing, with an initial email suggesting delivery the following day (as per the 'next working day' option at the time of purchase. In the end, the parcel appeared to be sitting with DPD, until 6 days later, despite DPD stating they'd already delivered it, with a blurred photo of a bit of rough ground as 'evidence'. Clubhouse would do well to recognise that their reputation is only as good as their weakest link...

records.text: This soccer store is a game-changer for soccer enthusiasts. They stock a wide variety of accessories and items, ensuring you'll find what you're looking for. Plus, their fast delivery service ensures you won't miss a beat on the field.

records.title: Really like the products received.
records.text: Really like the products received.Timeframe for receiving goods was protracted due to stock issues but kept up to date throughout.P&P was on the expensive side but like all things prices are rising.Would use again.

records.title: Excellent service!
records.text: Excellent service!Really good support from a relatively new company. Made sure I was notified every step of the way with my order, from payment received to order being dispatched and delivered.Well done guys!

records.title: Happy
records.text: Finally got my 2 shirts after ordering them in February. A little bit more communication needed but I’m happy with what I got.

records.title: Thanks For the service
records.text: Always had a good experience ordering from these boys, can’t fault the quality of the gear I’ve received as well 👍

records.title: it stated that you get a pad of 50…

records.title: Quick-ish delivery on the socks that I…
records.text: Quick-ish delivery on the socks that I ordered. However, I was charged £4.49 for postage. On arrival the packaging stated it only cost £2.85 in postage!! This is something that should be sorted.UPDATE: Thanks for the reply. I don't think you got my point. You're overcharging on delivery for no valid reason.

records.title: Ordered the new FA referee tracksuit…
records.text: Ordered the new FA referee tracksuit large but the size is misleading comes up a lot smaller so advise to order one size above

records.title: Asked for priority delivery and still…
records.text: Asked for priority delivery and still been waiting a week for it to come

records.title: Poor quality and customer service.
records.text: I received two notebooks (A5) which I ordered and was extremely disappointed with the quality and end result. The picture on their website shows a picture of the book and a pen, there was no pens with either of the books.The decals on the front were home made and just stuck on to an ordinary black A4 notebook (not even level).I called the shop to explain but the customer service was about as good as the books which are useless.I will pull the labels of and give them to the children for school.I won’t be buying anything else from these two guys.

records.title: I purchased a 3 XL Joma refs shirt
records.text: I purchased a 3 XL Joma refs shirt. Lucky if it’s XL !!!!Awful sizing.

records.title: Very cheap letter initials and fa logo
records.text: Very cheap letter initials and fa logo. Cheap iron on ones.

records.title: Placed an order over a week ago and…
records.text: Placed an order over a week ago and paid for 1st class delivery. Over a week later after emailing them they informed me that part of my order is now not in stock but it was in stock when the order was placed. Had to order from another company and had to pay again for shipping. Would never use this company again.....

records.title: Not a great experience.
records.text: Ordered a reorder item along with a regular in stock item back in February. Online stated for April dispatch. Order finally arrived today! Found out on Facebook that the item was delayed until June! Was not notified by the company until I got in touch with them. This whole time they also kept hold of the non preorder item saying they would lose money if they shipped it but run several free postage offeres in between. Used this company a few times but this is definitely our last. Awful service.

records.title: Two times unlucky
records.text: Had two issues with two deliveries. First one arrived with damaged packaging and product had become wet with rain. (Understandably Royal Mail are partly to blame)Second one parts arrived damaged and had technical issues that were just ignored when requested technical advice. After sales are difficult to get hold of taking nearly two weeks eventually leading me to return as felt that help wasn’t there. Messages received appeared rude and abrupt

records.title: Bad product and customer service
records.text: I bought a ref jacket for my son, after 1 wash the badge came off, I contacted refstop, they said send jacket back and they would check. They then told me  it was washed more than once (so I must have  lied??) They then said that they will put another badge on but don't know how long it will last !! They refused to pay return costs. Never use. Extremely bad customer service

records.title: Long delivery time and poor service
records.text: 4 weeks delivery time and unable to get hold of anyone from customer support, clearly taken on to much that they can handle, shame as they used to be very good

records.title: Awful customer service and awful…
records.text: Awful customer service and awful quality badges, leaving unremovable residue on the top. Refusal to come up with any practical solution meaning I have had to go and buy another top from another supplier.

records.title: The Joma top and Jacket were far too…
records.text: The Joma top and Jacket were far too small - there is no way they are a large & extra large No happy with those products at all

description:
Welcome to over 110 years of performance experience.

As the leading UK manufacturer and supplier of high-quality strength and conditioning equipment, we are dedicated to serving the needs of serious athletes and passionate lifters at every level.

With complete control over every aspect of our production and processes, all Pullum gym equipment is designed, manufactured, and built by our team here in the UK. This empowers us to create and deliver custom strength and functional training solutions while offering unparalleled product choice, quality and flexibility that is unmatched in the industry.

As the sole UK stockist of Eleiko, Titan & Titex, we also proudly offer a range of equipment from Ivanko, Adidas, Ironmind, Sabo, Capps, Jordan, in addition to our own Pullum branded and manufactured items.

records.title: First class service 10 out of 10 I’ve…
records.text: First class service 10 out of 10 I’ve been using this company for over 15 years never disappoints

records.title: Everything I needed in one place
records.text: Everything I needed in one place. New to weightlifting and extremely happy with the quality and range on offer AND managed to make savings on the items I needed due to sales and offers. Shipping was very quick and would absolutely recommend Pullum to anyone! Will use, without doubt, in the future. Thanks! 🏋️‍♀️

records.title: Great service
records.text: Fast delivery and easy to deal with.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, excellent products. I’ve used Pullum Spirts for over 20 years and they’ve always delivered great service.

records.title: British made, high quality, fast dispatch
records.text: I needed a part for a Pullum Scorpion Pro-R stand I bought second hand.  A quick phone call and it arrived the next morning. If they had run out, they would simply have made another for me. The quality of materials, practical experience and speed of service you get cannot be matched by a Chinese contract-manufacturer. They are a rare thing -- a fitness business that has been around for 117 years.

records.title: Excellent customer service no problems…
records.text: Excellent customer service no problems at all

records.title: Excellent service and excellent quality…
records.text: Excellent service and excellent quality of care

records.title: Have used this company for a number of…
records.text: Have used this company for a number of years now and can vouch for the fact that they consistently supply top quality items at good prices along with quick delivery. Will keep coming back for more. Thanks Guys.

records.title: Perfect company to deal with in my…
records.text: Perfect company to deal with in my experience. Emailed to ask a question regarding the Titan triumph singlet as they offer both single and double crotch and they replied quickly.Placed the order and within the hour I had the tracking information and it arrived the next day.

records.title: Pleasant to deal with!
records.text: They had what I needed in-stock for a reasonable price. It was dispatched quickly and communication was good. I had some issues with the courier which were handled well. All-in-all, I would order from Pullum again!

records.title: I received the item i ordered but only…
records.text: I received the item i ordered but only after emailing them so I ordered and 6 days later still no parcel I emailed them for them to say it was out of stock but then the same day it was sent for next day delivery.

records.title: Wasn't sent everything within the first…
records.text: Wasn't sent everything within the first package but the second package came quickly and the customer service was good.

records.title: Item arrived stained.
records.text: Item arrived stained.Sent video of the stains and was ignored

records.title: Wrong colour
records.text: Wrong colour, and wrong size delivered

records.title: Very bad experience the sizes for knee…
records.text: Very bad experience the sizes for knee sleeves are not accurate on the websites misleading the cx

records.title: Tracking number issue
records.text: I’ve been emailing the support team about the wrong tracking number sent to me but until now I haven’t receive any number to track my shipment. As the order number is 14072

description:
SportsShoes.com, the UK's number 1 Run, Gym & Hike retailer. 

We specialise in footwear and apparel for beginner enthusiasts to elite level athletes. 

Our teams work tirelessly to make our customer experience better and better so people can choose the right shoes and apparel to achieve their fitness goals.

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: Sadly had to send my order back as the sizing wasn’t quite right, but the customer service team were very helpful and quick at responding, even over the busy Christmas period! Special thanks to Abi S and Abi R who both helped sort my return and refund. Thank you! Would definitely recommend and use this site again.

records.title: Thanks for the Trainers.
records.text: Thanks for the Trainers.I struggle to get these since Brexit at a good price.I was surprised to receive them quickly and via Royal mail who I see as a quality delivery compared to evri bod else if you know what I mean,you pay for postage and appreciate that small charge here in the Highlands of Scotland.Usual Salomon wacky colours on your website which I think are GreatCheers to the staff who sent my parcel and the family business.

records.title: Inov8 boots
records.text: Bought Inov8 boots the site says recommend 1/2 size smaller I don't agree if anything 1/2 size bigger if available.The boots are very comfortable and light and waterproof to a degree !Good communication from Sports Shoes and great sale price would recommend

records.title: Vasque 'Sundowner' walking boots great price ,great boots.
records.text: Bought a pair of Vasque 'Sundowner' walking boots in the sale .Excellent boots at a massive discount .They were delivered quickly , with good communication enroute .I'm really pleased with my purchase .

records.title: Great price and store
records.text: Great price and store. Sadly let down by a poor courier experience. Evri had it for four days before delivery. Emailed to say it would email when it was out for delivery with a time. That was sent 5 minutes before arriving at door. Courier rang the bell but then immediately began hammering on the door!

records.title: Another purchase from SportsSgies.com.
records.text: Another great purchase from Sportsshoes.com. very good value - both itmes were in the Christmas sale - Top quality winter running gear to get me through marathon training in the cold months

records.title: First Class Customer Service
records.text: I recently had some issues with the returns portal not generating a QR code, and not for the first time. I was also trying to exchange one pair and get a refund on another.Becki and Chris were straight on it as soon as I let them know there were issues, and when it couldn't be solved the first time they tried workarounds until it was. A big thank you to you both for your patience and time in sorting this out - 5 stars and then some!

records.title: SportsShoes highly recommended!
records.text: SportsShoes have always been reliable and communicated effectively where needed. Products are genuine, high quality and great value for money. Keep up the good work! :)

records.title: Impressive selection of products from a…
records.text: Impressive selection of products from a number of big name companies. I particularly find the product advice useful. However the sizing advice on clothing could be improved, it would be useful to include a guide to women’s uk sizes or cm/inch.

records.title: Superb customer service!
records.text: Huge thanks to Abi R who dealt with my query quickly and professionally. Superb customer service which allowed me to order the trainers I wanted. Thank you!I will definitely use sportshoes.com again.

records.title: Good choice, standard prices, mixed results
records.text: Bought a few items in the sale: running shoes, tops and shorts. Shoes were good, tops just about OK, shorts not great fit at all. To be fair tops and shorts heavily discounted so I should have lowered my expectations.Main problem is the cost of delivery and then return. This means I doubt I'll use the site again unless I'm 100% sure of all items as known makes are same price as high street where I can try before I buy.

records.title: Good first purchase, shame about delivery charges
records.text: First purchase from SportsShoes.com and very pleased with the product, price and delivery timing, but a bit disappointed to have to pay £4.99 when buying over £142's worth of shoes - especially when being delivered to a collection point.  That aside, there's a great selection of product available at decent discounts, so not too bad overall

records.title: All good except the Evri delivery
records.text: All good except the Evri delivery, just left on a landing in a large office block (on the right floor though).

records.title: Skins
records.text: Super Cheap prices on the skins,delivery was acceptable for an overseas parcel,however lost a star due to the series 1 skins sizing being under sized,I purchased a coupla pairs from each series 1,3 and 5 in large and the series 1 are too tight, 3 and 5 good.Im 75kg wringing wet 175cm ( 5' 10") 35" waist.Way too tight.Whats doing there with the sizing?

records.title: Placed two orders
records.text: Placed two orders. First came next day. Unbelievable effort. The second one is lost with evri. Il definitely use again if there’s an option to avoid evri. Would have been an easy 5 stars if it wasn’t for the cowboy delivery firm.

records.title: Shoe is great,but no free delivery,…
records.text: Shoe is great,but no free delivery,I bought £90 shoe,Less colour, other shop have many colours, maybe next time will go to the free delivery shop to buy shoes

records.title: Good service quick delivery
records.text: Good service quick delivery . Unfortunately one of shoe laces holder is ripped . keeping the shoes cause needed them quickly Still good price for KEEN walking boots

records.title: Good selection and information on the shoe
records.text: I have used sports shoes off and on for a number of years. Good selection and information on the shoe. It is a shame you have to pay postage. My preferred running shoe retailer is Northern runner, however Sports Shoe does offer more brands.

records.title: Delivery issue handled well
records.text: Shoes are with me, look good and appear to fit.Delivery was a problem, but not down to SportsShoes as the pick up point sent the shoes back for some unknown reason.   I rang SportsShoes and got straight through to a human being who promised to fix. Followed up with an email the next day and got an almost immediate and helpful response from Ryan (cheers Ryan!). The shoes arrived the next day.  Great all round customer service.

records.title: Customer support was easy to contact…
records.text: Customer support was easy to contact and recovery was very good. But the initial delivery was incorrectly addressed which resulted in the parcel shop refusing to accept the order which then needed to be resent by SportsShoes with the associated delay

records.title: Great delivery in terms of speed…
records.text: Great delivery in terms of speed however paying to return goods is annoying.

records.title: Good service and delivery, but a problem
records.text: Good service and delivery. Only problem was the sticker that was left on the cardboard presentation packing which left a sticky mess when removed - made it difficult to wrap as a Christmas present and looked tacky. Why put in there?! Very annoying

records.title: Reliable and recommandable site
records.text: Good choice and quality shoes. Nice prices. Possibility of exchange and process OK.But delivery too slow.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Score 4.5 out of 5 Positives1) Call centre staff quick to answer despite the storms going on that day!2) Very helpful about sending the order by Royal Mail3) Exchange very efficient.Even better ifs1) The link to "advanced" what's my size is more obvious.  The current font just looks like irrelevant blurb. A nice, obvious button thingy will do.  If I had seen it, I would have used it first time round and got the correct sizes.2) At checkout give the customer the option to choose Royal Mail. That saves time for your colleagues. I know delivery companies are rather hit and miss depending on the postcode lottery.3) I really hope this brilliant efficiency doesn't come at a cost to the welfare of your staff. No Amazon style work practices please, otherwise I won't enjoy the products.

records.title: Good Ordering Experience, Delivery Less So.
records.text: Straitforward and rapid order processing/dispatch, good prices on the limited sizes available. Unfortunately let down by the carrier Evri who seem to have no capable delivery tracking information system available to the customer, the item turns up when it turns up without warning.

records.title: No complains
records.text: Shoes are perfect quality and match the description. Only thing is that thy arrived a bit later than the set date.

records.title: address mix-up sorted
records.text: I made a mess of a recent order by mixing up delivery and payment addresses.  Whilst I accept this was my fault I do feel that other websites allow an additional 'check' page before the order is placed to help prevent this (which is why this is not a 5X rating).  However once I realised the problem  it was resolved very quickly through the prompt and careful attention of Charlene.  The shoes are now on their way and I am very grateful for her help.

records.title: The initial delivery arrived in good…
records.text: The initial delivery arrived in good timescale and was what was ordered; however the shoes were slightly too small for me. Returns process worked very well and the shoes returned arrived very quickly and were the correct size.The only issue is with the website. When filters are chosen they seem to get removed when going back a page, meaning that they had to keep on being reapplied.

records.title: Easy to place order, fast delivery service.
records.text: Easy to place order, goods received as promised, but the Royal Mail delivery service left the parcel on public corridor without knocking or ringing the door bell. Anyone could have taken the parcel, happened twice on my last two order. But overall well satisfied with Sportshoes.com, would give 5 stars in the future, only if they sort out the delivery acknowledgement issue with Royal Mail.

records.title: Amazing customer service!…
records.text: I ordered running gloves from Amazon as a Christmas gift for my son not realising that they would come direct from Sportshoes rather than Amazon and would be delivered by Evri. We have serious issues with Evri in the village where I live with deliveries made to incorrect addresses, not being delivered at all or delivery photos being taken and then parcels being stolen by Evri drivers. My parcel did not arrive. The delivery photo showed the parcel outside my front porch although the delivery report said "Inside front porch". I was out when the delivery was made and no parcel was there when I returned home. Sportshoes have been excellent! I was emailed several times regarding this issue by Angela and she acted very promptly to send me a claim form and to arrange a refund as I was not prepared to have a replacement delivered by the dastardly Evri. I cannot praise this service enough but I won't order from Sportshoes again due to the ongoing issues regarding deliveries by Evri in our village.

records.title: FrustratingPaid extra postage but parcel was…
records.text: Paid extra postage but parcel was delivered late. When trying to return part of order had postage approved but no label issued, had to phone to get this sorted out. First attempt wanted email verification which took me to a war I g page so had to phone again. Angela finally issued me with return label. Very frustrating experience all round. I won’t use Sportsshoes again.

records.title: I still have not received my order
records.text: I still have not received my order, so I can't rate it any more than 3 stars. It is Christmas time, so that adds to delivery time, understandably.I asked for Evri to deliver to a pick up point, so that I could ensure I collected it straight away and it didn't require redelivery - I was aiming for efficiency ironically.

records.title: Trainers look good but when I ordered…
records.text: Trainers look good but when I ordered an expensive pair of Nike trainers, I don't expect them to come in a Sports Shoe box...where was the Nike box? No explanation but sold as brand new. My order number is: 19516944 if you want to contact me.

records.title: Product Was Hazy
records.text: The shipped package arrived materially later than the quoted date, but I expected that (being an overseas shipment). The reason for my rating was that the plastic was significantly cloudy. I realize that TPU is susceptible to developing a haze over time, but it seems the product I received was either used or was mishandled during storage to display the amount of wear it did out of the box.

records.title: A mixed bag experience
records.text: Very speedy delivery and really good price, didn't begrudge £4.99 delivery charge as service was excellent. Unfortunately the running shoes (i have had many pairs in this size and style) had a very small toe box and therefore need to be returned as too uncomfortable. Not sportsshoes fault i know (manufacturers issue). But to have to pay another £3.99 to return the shoes means £9 in charges and i am still without any running shoes. Won't use sportsshoes again because of this. I thought i was safe as i had had these trainers before.

records.title: Frustrating re trainers
records.text: Brilliant choice of clothing However ecery time I look for Sauciny Guide shoes ( older versions ) there is never stock of many sizings and never my sizeIts a great deal you have on the shoes, but pointless if all sizing us out of stock all the time

records.title: Duplicated order
records.text: Three stars because I have received and paid for two identical orders each with a £5 delivery charge!  Now I have to send one back and pay the delivery charge again!  Not good.  Unfortunately I won’t be using this site again.

records.title: Got a shoe made 2 years ago!
records.text: I spent 255 EUR on two shoes, everything came ok, not damaged. Shoes are comfortable and I got what I ordered. The reason for 3 star review is that I got one pair that was made 2 years ago. The shoe is in mint condition but if I had known that it is 2 years old I would have not bought it. As new as it is (not used) the glue on the shoe deteriorates over time thus making the product having shorter "life span".All in all I like sportsshoes and would buy from them again.

records.title: Good service but be mindful of returns policy
records.text: Liked- promptness Disliked- paid for delivery, paid for delivery of return, free delivery for exchange only but didn’t have size so chose different shoe £10 cheaper and this has only been offered as a credit

records.title: I like Sportshoes but why Evri…
records.text: I like Sportshoes but you keep using the services of Evri that make the overall experience disappointing. I'm just glad the products we bought from you wasn't for a gift but 2 missing parcels for me and 3 From my partner I would call it a record. I order my shoes first week of November and just arrive last week! A MONTH  after ordering. Change your delivery company..

records.title: These runners are quite slippey on wet…
records.text: These runners are quite slippey on wet ground. I wear these inside for work but I have noticed they are quite slippery on wet ground and that's just in my local town.

records.title: I love SportsShoes but am most…
records.text: I love SportsShoes but am most disappointed that they used Evri for my last delivery. Twice I was e-mailed to be given times for delivery but no parcel. I called SportsShoes who were very helpful and at the third attempt I got my parcel. At 8.30 at night, the courier knocked and sprinted away to their car before I could get to the door. It was less than 30 seconds. Parcel abandoned on the floor. Not good.

records.title: Battered, scuffy box. Not ideal
records.text: The shoes are for a Christmas present: it's only the 17th Dec so I can't comment on them. The shoes arrived in a very battered and ripped box, which whilst I appreciate is purely cosmetic, does have the effect of making the present look old/from the back of the shelf! Not ideal but too late in the day to do anything but wrap them!

records.title: Alright
records.text: I LVOE the item and is very good the customer support was really good but the shipping is quite bad as it took almost 3 weeks to come

records.title: Sizing wildly  wrong
records.text: Bought my usual size of shoes but found they were enormously oversized and had to go through the hassle  - and additional expense - of exchanging them.  Advice regarding the sizing on their website would have prevented this. Probably won't shop with them again.

records.title: Watch out for delivery/return charges
records.text: Disappointed with having to pay for postage for delivery and return of hockey shoes that were the wrong size. Ended up costing me £10 for nothing. Other online retailers offer a better delivery service.

records.title: Easy to use website and ordering…
records.text: Easy to use website and ordering process. Delivery is naff as I could not get shoes delivered to my home address. Home address option was greyed out and I could not select it. Had to wait and go to an Evri pick up point, queue for 20 mins, wait while assistant went to find my goods, scan it etc then drive back home. Crap system and it want any cheaper on the delivery either. Will think twice about ordering from here again purely because of this. Everything else was top notch though.

records.title: Poor choice of Evri as delivery company
records.text: I selected the option to have my shoes left at my local "Parcelshop" store.Evri sent me an email on Monday saying they'd received the parcel and would keep me updated.Having heard nothing by Saturday, I checked the tracking link and found that they'd actually dropped it off on Tuesday, but not bothered to tell me.  I then got two emails a few minutes _after_ I'd gone to the shop to pick it up on Sunday, one telling me that my parcel was ready to collect, and the other thanking me for collecting it.  Really unimpressed.

records.title: Disappointed that both delivery and returns incur charges
records.text: Charged for delivery whatever you spend, and charged for return. You’re the only place that does that, so I might avoid for that reason in future. It’s a shame because the selection of products is good.

records.title: Disappointing delivery and return costs…
records.text: Disappointing delivery and return costs - shame as first time purchasing from SportsShoes and would be discouraged from ordering again due to high costs for postage and again for returns! Initially ordeered on the website and was encouraged to dowload the app for free postage. This then wasn't available - due to the items being exempt as per the t&c small print! So that was £4.99 delivery as the cheapest option. The shoes sadly did not fit well so need to return and charged another £3.99 to return - total of £8.98 in postage to have no shoes at the end is a bit excessive!

records.title: You use Evri.
records.text: You use Evri.They give late notification of when they will deliver, usually only the same day they intend to deliver.Then they deliver the item usually 2 weeks later than advertised.STOP USING EVRI !!!!

records.title: Item still not arrived and paid for…
records.text: Item still not arrived and paid for premium delivery. Have been advised this is only standard in fact which wasn’t clear. Item was dispatched a week ago but courier stating they are still awaiting the item which said should have been delivered 3 days ago at the latest. Have corresponded via email chasing the delivery as it was an expensive item and told to bear with it due to Christmas delays. I have used other retailers and same couriers and had no issues so not sure who is too blame currently.

records.title: No longer worth the hassle ordering online
records.text: Used to be my go to for training footwear but delivery has become so poor that I likely won’t use them again.  They use Evri who are below useless, and said they tried delivery and it was refused?  A blatant lie, as myself and others were at the delivery address at the time.   I had to waste time communicating with SS to get them sent out again as I wasn’t advised in any way, other than checking Evri’s tracking details.All round a really poor experience.  Better off going to a shop to purchase.

records.title: Disappointing support with a premium product
records.text: Had a number of good experiences with Sportsshoes, however I have a pair of adidas terrex boots which have had a fault a month after the warranty expired (13 months) and they refuse to offer any resolution. Extremely disappointing given the high price of the boots. I wont be ordering with them again.

records.title: Supposedly new trainers with compressed zoomx foam
records.text: I brought the Nike Vomero 17, and the zoomx part of the sole seems to have crease/compressed marks on it. I thought I was buying new shoes, I think I was given some kind of used shoes instead :(Maybe ex-display shoe or a store try on shoes or something. As there is not much wear in the underpart of the sole, but the top part of the sole has the compression marks on the zoomx  foam. The trainers was on 40% sale, so I guess I got what I paid for. And I paid £5 or £6 delivery, so not worth returning and re-buying again.

records.title: Model mismatch
records.text: I bought shoes from them few times before. They are very quick to dispatch. I am highly pleased at their dispatch time. This time I ordered 7.5 size of Asics Metaspeed Edge plus. It seems that I received Asics Metaspeed Edge in the Asics Metaspeed Edge Plus box. Asics Metaspeed Edge is narrow and its weight is about 195gm accordibg to Asics's description. As I received the narrow width shoe with 195gm weight, it must be Asics Metaspeed Edge I received instead of Asics Metaspeed Edge Plus. But Sportshoes does not have any option to notify them about such issue.

records.title: I was unable to use my Athletics NI…
records.text: I was unable to use my Athletics NI discount code that I've used for years. The discount is only available to Athletics England. Very disappointed.As a follow up to Sports Shoes.com replying vaguely to my review, I had replied to the alternative email address and didn't receive a resolution to my issue. Their response to my review suggests they tried to assist me with a potential resolution by reaching out to me. Unfortunately, they didn't. Still disappointed.

records.title: I find it a shame that they made me pay…
records.text: I find it a shame that they made me pay for a send back of shoes that already came as a replacement for a faulty pair. left me out of pocket 10 pounds going with amazon in the future!

records.title: Slow delivery but good customer service
records.text: Still don't have the item 1 week on. No idea where it is despite paying for 48 hr delivery and tracking.Update - Gloves arrived but after 6 days of no updates on tracking. Sportshoes very good at following up but they seem to be getting let down by their couriers who are not providing the service they are being paid for. £4.99 for 48hr delivery taking 8 days for a tiny pair of £10 gloves isn't really good enough.

records.title: Delivery by Evri
records.text: Delivery by Evri, out for "delivery" 20/12, no attempt made on that day, still waiting 24/12.For us, this seems to be standard Evri behaviour

description: We are dedicated to making the game of golf more afforadable. We are a team of golfers and take what's on the market - and we improve it! We offer a wide variety of clothing and accessories. We are the Future of Golf!

records.title: Quality products and customer service
records.text: Quality brand with even better customer service. The price is amazing as well compared to other brands without lacking in quality!I have used Druids for a few years now and I’ll continue using them long into the future hopefully.

records.title: All excellent
records.text: All excellent. Bought goods very near to Christmas Day and the delivery was fast and efficient. One item was a little big and a replacement was quickly despatched. Well done Druids.I will definitely deal with you again and I can definitely recommend you!

records.title: Druids is a great value and quality clothes
records.text: Druids selection and prices are terrific. The fits are good for my 8 year old and I can see how he can wear them for a couple of years as he grows. Kids golf wear is tricky and expensive, and Druid has nailed the intersection of value, style, and quality.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Second time I’ve purchased from Druids and it won’t be the last. Golf clothing is top quality and style, as well as washing really well. But I want to call out their amazing customer service. I’d purchased a men’s waterproof bundle and kids ambassador pack as Christmas presents. Totally my fault, the parcel had been delivered in plenty of time but I only opened it 9 days before Christmas and noticed I’d ordered the kids jacket in a size too small. I contacted them and they immediately responded with how to return. I returned but was worried about the timescale quoted for the exchange to be sent out. Someone really helpful asked me to send proof of postage, and they sent me the exchange without waiting for the other one to arrive their end. It arrived in time for Xmas so I wasn’t a gift short. Thank you so much! Will definitely use again and recommend!

records.title: l bought a few items before Xmas very…
records.text: l bought a few items before Xmas very nice quality but a but to small , exchanged them and l'm so pleased .Will definitely order more clothing and l'm sure my golfing friends will after them.seeing me in the new clothing.

records.title: the items I ordered were sent out very…
records.text: the items I ordered were sent out very quickly and I received them with 2 days good quality base layers excellent and the fleece trousers did the job all round very good

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: I had a small issue with my delivered order. I contacted the Customer Support Druids Team. They resolved my issue in less than 24 hours to my complete satisfaction in a very professional manner. I will continue to be a customer of Druids and would highly recommend purchasing from them. Great selection and quality of products. Sincerely Todd K

records.title: Have ordered 3 times now
records.text: Have ordered 3 times now. The products are really nice quality. Sizing is slightly smaller so may be worth going up a size. Communication is great and delivery times are super fast.

records.title: Fantastic! *****
records.text: Quick delivery. Very high quality products. Very impressed. Will definitely be using Druids again and highly recommend them. Thanks

records.title: Dougmac
records.text: Never any problems with this company what you order you get and if there’s anything wrong they sort it out right away

records.title: Pretty good in general, with room for improvement.
records.text: GOOD:PricingWebsite ease of useStylingMy personal experience with customer service wasnt too bad.Managed to organise a return without major issues, not as smooth as it could be but not too bad.COULD DO BETTER:Careful if you're buying from outside of UK as you have to pay for returns and could be expensiveSizing is on the large size and fit could be better, which may be due to patterns used in manufacturing process.Could do with a human chat / WhatsApp option for customer service.OVERALL:Four out of five

records.title: I got my order but not in the color I…
records.text: I got my order but not in the color I requested. The product met my expectations.  The zipper could have been made with better materials. Where the zipper meets the button it tends to bind.  Overall I’d rate my pants at an 8.

records.title: Great products
records.text: Fantastic products. The trousers keep me very warm with no need for thermal protection. The only downside is the sizes available, limited short leg, fine if you only want grey trousers.

records.title: Very efficient delivery and updates
records.text: Very efficient delivery and updates.  Item is great for the price, I just think that the neck fit could be improved as it constantly folds down.

records.title: The garments are great
records.text: The garments are great, however delivery was due before Xmas but didn’t come till after and as it was a present was rather disappointing.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Although there was a wrong sized item in the bundle I had ordered the team have been very efficient in sorting out the issue (even though it was Christmas they were very prompt in their responses). Great customer service and I would not hesitate in ordering again.

records.title: Absolutely incredible
records.text: The first time I’ve ever ordered of you and I have to say I’m highly, highly impressed. I’m a golf professional & I’ll never buy from the other brands again, when you can offer these quality appreal at these prices. Wasn’t the best pleased that I had paid 14.98 in postage for 2 day delivery and received 5 days later. However your products make up for that massively & I’ll be ordering a lot more off you in the future! Well done Team Druids, you should be very proud. Kindest Regards, Lew.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery, quality mid layer, light jacket, jogger pants.  Polo is garbage.  I guess you get that for the price just didn’t understand why the material for polo was so poor vs others

records.title: I ordered as a birthday present an item…
records.text: I ordered as a birthday present an item was missing from the order which was frustrating as I had paid for express delivery. However Rashid sorted my issue out promptly and responded very quickly to sort my issue thank you Rashid.

records.title: Didn’t got the right size for the…
records.text: Didn’t got the right size for the trousers but ne would have cost me to send it back… but not my fault why should i pay ? I’ve ordered 32/34 and received 34/34…But ther than that the fast delivery before christmas should be the only delivery option (because we’re paying for sending…)

records.title: Nice stuff but difficult to exchange or…
records.text: Nice stuff but difficult to exchange or return items after Christmas . Size guide not accurate . Medium is more like large .

records.title: Good quality trousers that fitted…
records.text: Good quality trousers that fitted perfectly. Four stars as the price seems to vary, less for Black Friday, more when I bought them, and back down a bit as I write !

records.title: Good Quality
records.text: Great quality of items ordered however I did order a polo T-shirt short sleeved which turned up long sleeved. Good fast delivery.

records.title: Order placed on 30th November
