records.text: Order placed on 30th November, advised order had been sent but nothing arrived, chased order but was told my items were no longer in stock so need to order alternatives.I did this, order arrived yesterday incorrect size! So disappointed, these are Christmas presents.I have raised a complaint but not heard back yet.Edit*** Change review, after the above message I was contacted and my order was corrected, item arrived today so only just after Christmas which isn't awful.Thank you

records.title: After ordering on 3rd Dec and needing…
records.text: After ordering on 3rd Dec and needing items for 14th Dec, that did not arrive,  I contacted Rashid in Druids who was very helpful and arranged a refund.  I think the problem is the company that they use for logistics, Evri. The information on their site was not up to date and showed no progress on the process for 7 days. Doesn't instill confidence,  especially at this time if year.

records.title: Size not right
records.text: Order delivered ok but nothing back on replacement itemOrdered what I thought would fit by going up a size but still didn’t fitUPDATE - Costumer service responded quickly to my review and reply to them. Evri still have not returned the item 10 days after sending back but a replacement has been issued. Can’t fault the CS team

records.title: Happy customer
records.text: Items were sent quickly and fit as expected.One of my items was picked incorrectly (right item, wrong size).  The exchange/return process was easy to use. Due to time of year the exchange to longer than expected but happy with the items and shopping experience.Will definitely buy from Druids again.

records.title: Great quality, great price but sleeves tight.
records.text: Really good quality products and very good prices. Sleeves on hoodies are quite tight, especially around the armpit area and forearms. Joggers are a great fit and very comfortable.

records.title: Selection is great
records.text: Selection is great. Quality has been as advertised. Shipping has been very quick. Only wish there was a free shipping option with purchases over a certain amount.

records.title: Originally a two star rating due to…
records.text: Originally a two star rating due to delivery, however as correct item was finally sent (late) I will say 4

records.title: No rear pocket rainsuit trousers.
records.text: I bought a rainsuit in October 2024. There was no rear trouser pocket but a trouser flap. The pocket on trousers is for your score card. I emailed Druids and please see their response. Absence of pocket is intentional. A pocket here would increase the chances of water leakage when weather is wet.The flap is there to provide an added layer of protection while maintaining the suit's waterproof properties. My response to Druids was that their explanation was ridiculous but that they would contact their providers for future consideration. Druids contacted me by email on my Review and were  extremely happy with the absence of the trouser pocket. Nothing wrong with the trousers otherwise. I will not use them for golf on wet days,the jacket, yes with a trousers from Stuburt.

records.title: The navy pair of pants showed up with a…
records.text: The navy pair of pants showed up with a broken zipper on the left hand pocketThe sweat shirts I ordered a size bigger and are still too small.The products are good quality and the delivery time was impressive but will think twice before ordering again.

records.title: Took longer than it should to arrive…
records.text: Took longer than it should to arrive and in my opinion the sizing is out. I ordered a large top, i normally have medium tops and it's not a generous as i would expect.Thought it would be wind proof but it turns out not to be the case.Don't think I will be buying again.

records.title: Clothing is nice
records.text: Clothing is nice, runs a bit small, order one size bigger than you think. Return Policy is suspect, very limited follow up and you pay a hefty price to send items back.

records.title: Very quick delivery but received one…
records.text: Very quick delivery but received one incorrect item which wasn't even close to what I ordered

records.title: Good quality clothing, great price
records.text: Good quality clothing, well priced, definitely value for money and great choice. However...made another order last 9th December...courier (Evri) haven't yet received it from Druids despite 2-3 day delivery shown...hence 3 stars

records.title: Good fast delivery but sizing left a…
records.text: Good fast delivery but sizing left a bit to be desired

records.title: Returned parcel
records.text: Returned parcel.  For exchange. Haven’t received any correspondence.  It’s now been 10 days  I understand it’s a busy period  parcel return reference DR754689 returned as large jacket was to small looking to exchange for a xtra large

records.title: Druids were great, however delivery partner Evri were poor
records.text: Druids were great, however your delivery partner Evri were shockingly poor.They managed to deliver my package to a neighbour several doors down, even although both our door clearly show the house numbers.I will not buy again from Druids if they continue to use Evri

records.title: Delivery Expectations Not Met
records.text: My order, placed three weeks ago, was finally delivered today. Please consider improving your shipment process or providing more realistic delivery estimates on your website for orders shipped outside the UK, such as to France. Therefore only 3 stars. The items delivered appear to be of good quality, but their durability will need to be assessed after a few months of use.

records.title: Second time lucky...
records.text: I was disappointed with my first order - the 'joggers' are extremely thin and not at all what I was expecting. The upper body sizings are on the large side too. I sent these back not realising the refund policy only offers and exchange or credit note. Therefore I re-ordered different products in smaller sizes ans they're actually really nice. The thermal winter trousers are much more practical (probably for most of the year) than other golf trousers I've found else where.

records.title: Order delivery
records.text: The item I ordered is a good item but getting them was a nightmare sent the wrong trouser twice then I had to pay for returns when it was not my fault eventually I had a free return. And I had the trousers I ordered in the 1st.   I do recommend these winter trousers to anyone

records.title: EVRI, oh dear
records.text: Unfortunately for Druids, they use EVRI as a parcel service. EVRI have a tracking system that doesn't tell the truth. When reporting to Druids yes they did reply within 24 hours I sent an email, first response was generic impersonal nonsense and felt like it was A.I. generated. When this was pointed out the next response was better but still no answers. Its a shame as the products are great. EVRI received goods from Druids but took a week to deliver (which I would have been fine with if I didn't receive emails from EVRI stating the delay was down to an issue at delivery point, just lies to make it look like they attempted to fulfill deliveries). Lies bug me. Delays are acceptable, just own your ineptitude EVRI. Royal Mail are exactly the same.

records.title: Good value for money but poor refunds service
records.text: Items: good quality at a reasonable costDelivery: reasonable- items arrived but a little longer than expectedReturns process: a little clunky with a few steps to jump through and they push you to have store credit. I opted for refund via bank transfer which wasn’t doneCustomer service/after care: no refund received after 14 days so I sent an email to query. A store credit was sent shortly after which I have emailed twice to rectify this. Still no further to getting a refund on the item sent back.

records.title: I have recently purchased many items…
records.text: I have recently purchased many items from Druids and I must say that the clothing design and price are totally unmatched with many other golf appreal manufacturers. I would say that the sizes of the clothing is a little disappointing as I ordered 3 jumpers all in the same size and 2 of the 3 jumpers were a lot shorter. I would say that the length of the clothing are all on the short side so the clothing is wide but leaving you exposed from the belt to the midriff. The quality of the clothing is also pretty inconsistent. On the whole though, some really nice items and definitely worth having when so many other golf clothing companies charge a fortune.

records.title: Lack of contact information and contact,
records.text: Good quality low cost products. I inadvertently ordered one wrong size shirt in a bundle of 3 shirts. Just after I pressed send I tried to find a contact number but none were shown. I immediately e-mailed the only number that I could find. Nobody replied.I then phoned the Druids warehouse twice. Could not speak to anyone and no one responded to my requests.I passed the small size non fitting shirt to a family friend because I could no longer be bothered.

records.title: Just bought a "members Jacket" Sage…
records.text: Just bought a "members Jacket" Sage ...quality looks all right, fells ok to wera, howerver not untill in the golf course, as the jacket doesn't breath and so it keeps all the sweat inside , horrible feeling. Very unfortunate as it looks nice. There are no ways to contact then via the website.

records.title: Pants ran small for size
records.text: Purchased my size but the pants ran small. Druids doesn’t make a larger size. Too bad because I like the quality.

records.title: The package had a small size rain coat…
records.text: The package had a small size rain coat in a pants bag. The bag had been opened. I order a large druids rain coat!! There were several other items order that were correct. I sent rain coat back that cost me $103.00 to send back!!!I’m hoping that I will get the correct coat and reimbursement for shipping.

records.title: Ordered wrong size trousers
records.text: Ordered wrong size trousers in the package deal so asked for an exchange however the next size had then gone out of stock instead of contacting me to tell me i waited 2 weeks then contacted them and instead of offering me a different colour or style they sent me a gift card for 2/3 of the price of a pair or trousers. Great products that I did receive but very disappointed in the customer service!

records.title: First time ordering from Druids
records.text: First time ordering from Druids. Item (quarter-zip pullover) arrived in timely fashion. Quality was ok for the price but the size was completely unacceptable. 6'2" 250 lbs medium build should fit comfortably in XXL with room for a shirt underneath. What Druids sent me would barely qualify as LARGE. Too short, too tight, no room for shirt.  $25 to return it. No repeat customer here.

records.title: Payment custom duties
records.text: Goods received are in order.  However customs dues and associated costs had to be paid.  These will be reimbursed by Druids as also stated on its website.  However to date (some 1 month later) nothing received.

records.title: I have purchased numerous times from…
records.text: I have purchased numerous times from here, and the clothing has been great,this last purchase the sizings are all over and differ immensely from what they are advertised as.Also if you can not supply the advertised sizes, do not offer me a credit voucher I will just have my money back as no trust in sizing means no more purchases

records.title: Ordered a week ago
records.text: Ordered a week ago, no update, can’t get a hold of customer services to find out if the order is being processed at all… 3rd order and definitely the worst so far …

records.title: Terrible customer service.
records.text: Ordered 4 different items in ‘my size’, received 4 polo shirts all in the wrong size. (Picking list inside the pack was correct) Had to prove I was returning the items before Druids would consider shipping my correct items. Only started to process my replacements once they received the wrong items back. When replacements arrived, only 3 out of 4 were correct, so had to go through the process all over again. 🤬 Received email to say the colour polo I wanted was now out of stock 🤬 so chose another colour and told that too was ‘out of stock’ and they had sent what was in stock. 🤬🤬 No apology until I asked for one.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: Tried to cancel the order. Emailed straight away to cancel before the item had been shipped but customer service came back 5 days later once the item left the country. What a waste of resources, time and money 🤷🏻‍♀️

records.title: I am quite unhappy because I still have…
records.text: I am quite unhappy because I still have not received my exchange of rain pants. I had returned these pants because the size was too big. I paid the sum of €12 to make this return. In addition, I was supposed to receive a "gift" golf cap that I did not receive with my last order... overall, I am disappointed even if the clothes I received suit me in terms of cut and quality.

records.title: Discolouration
records.text: When I wore this, the shirt I was wearing underneath became discoloured.

records.title: I ordered a gilet and it proved to be…
records.text: I ordered a gilet and it proved to be too small, I returned it for a larger size and instead got a smaller one? I contacted customer services but the response I finally got failed to address the issue. In frustration I donated the item to my local charity shop, not a great experience

records.title: Still missing
records.text: Well the purchase went well except I’ve still not got my goods!!!Getting in touch with you has been difficult and aoart from this mess the other communication was with Bot!!! Your delivery choice Evri hadn’t feared much better, despite me giving the full address and post code, still not here

description:
Europe's largest golf retailer. We have 85 stores in the UK and Republic of Ireland, and we're still growing! Either visit one of our stores, or order online in the knowledge that you will receive the very best service and after sales care
We stock a full range of golf equipment for golfers of all levels, including irons, drivers, putters, package sets, balls, shoes, clothing, plus much more. Both in-store and online, we have our expert teams on hand to help with any golfing query you may have. Most of our store managers are keen golfers just like you.
We aim to offer unbeatable value and an extensive range along with exclusive deals. We hope to be your first stop for all your golfing equipment needs.

records.title: Ethan and Tom
records.text: Ethan and Tom, Swindon branch were incredibly helpful and knowledgeable, I had had issues on a previous visit, but called the store and spoke with Tom who was very understanding and helpful, arranged a fitting for me the next day, I arrived and met Ethan who was incredibly helpful. I had a fantastic experience and left smiling.

records.title: Matthew .. what a star
records.text: Matthew ... what a star ... Customer service at its finest. We had a problem with 3 for 2 offer due to real time stock information not being available. We only received 2 items and missed out on the offer. Spoke to Mathew at Customer Service who was so kind and arranged alternative item to be shipped next day. What a star ... 🌟

records.title: NORTHOLT - DAVID
records.text: Hello I just would like to put in a review whilst I was at the Northolt branch. The staff member in question is called david.I believe he might be from South Africa. He is bold with a beard just for description purposes. David has been awesome. He has gone beyond what I would call customer services in the sense of recommending the very best of equipment. How to use the equipment and also the correct type of equipment. So we're talking about Golf clubs, we are talking about gloves and balls and the best type of clothing for the season. I have purchased a lot of items because of David's recommendations and he has been absolutely right. I don't know how you commend your staff, but please, could you do your very best for him. Being genuine makes people come back. Thank you

records.title: New putter
records.text: Purchased a new putter from the Stoke store,Nigel was very professional with helping me to select the correct club for myself and even gave me a few pointers   on how to put better. I wasn’t rushed at all and came away feeling very satisfied with my purchase.

records.title: Quality Service
records.text: Spent a considerable amount of time with Mark from the Preston branch of AG before finally purchasing a set of irons and woods. The service was first class and never felt under any pressure to purchase. Last week one of my new woods broke and with Mark's support returned the club to the manufacturer who repaired it within the week. The help and customer service has been first class and very I'm pleased I used AG to help me find the right clubs.

records.title: High Legh American golf store
records.text: I visited the High Legh American golf store today and purchased a Powercaddy electric golf cart . I was assisted in store by a Lady called Jo Beddows who was a mine of useful  information and answered all the questions I had professionally . I would not hesitate to recommend this store and Jo to anybody looking to buy any golf product and will be back to be fitted for new clubs in the near future .

records.title: Randall at the Wakefield store assisted…
records.text: Randall at the Wakefield store assisted me in a highly professional way. I was filled with confidence and feel so very pleased with his attitude, delivery of services, and his painstaking way of assisting my choices. I highly recommend this person as your point of call to not only choose your clubs but also improve your game! Top service!

records.title: Fantastic fitting experience with AG at High Legh
records.text: I went to AG at High Legh because it was described a an AG Golf Academy and situated on a golf course with a driving range (rather than one of the in town shops with a simulator).  My fitting was done by Antony.  I was taking up golf again after a gap of approx 20 years to go rallying - before that I played 3 x per week, so had some experience.  The fitting was carried out in a bay on the driving range, so Antony and I could see how the balls were flying. I had complete confidence in Antony, he listened to the feedback I gave was experienced, knowledgeable, friendly and gave explanations throughout.  How golf has changed since I last played - the information from the software etc was really interesting and confirmed the conclusions we were coming to as to which clubs, shafts grips would best suite me. Antony recommended different makes for irons and woods and explained why.  Delivery is as quoted at 3-4 weeks.  Although I have yet try the clubs on the course I am confident they will be OK - they just felt right.  Thanks Antony and AG for all your help.

records.title: Game review in Cardiff
records.text: Booked a game review in Cardiff with Wade, had a great experience. It was a very useful hour long session, with Wade fixing my grip/slice within a few minutes. Would recommend to anyone looking for a few pointers to help their golf game.

records.title: Liverpool Aintree store
records.text: Liverpool Aintree store ! I travel from North Yorkshire just to purchase my golfing 🏌️‍♂️ gear there ! ⛳️simply as the minute you enter the store the staff are very attentive , helpful , knowledgeable, courteous , whoever is on the till or shop floor always make themselves available to help ! My last visit I was dealt with by Tom who helped me choose the right jackets 👍Thankyou .

records.title: show stock not in stock
records.text: Placed an order for a stromberg ladies waterproof jacket and bottoms showing in stock as an xmas present, recieved half the order, presumed the other half would come seperate as stated on the website, over a week later and no emails or contact with them foned up to ask where it was, to which they said it’s sold out and have now refunded you.? If I hadn’t phoned still be waiting for it for xmas day.Update : have recieved gift voucher and prompt reply from the seller and appreciate the gesture. Have changed the rating to 4 star because of that.

records.title: Good deal. Bad packaging
records.text: I ordered some golf shoes for my husband and they arrived pretty quickly. They were in a good Black Friday deal. When I have opened the package to wrap them, the box looks like it has been kicked around the warehouse, quite damaged but the shoes look ok. Also their website needs some work, allows you to add things to your cart to be told upon purchase that they are unavailable. Maybe just a Christmas rush issue but a bit of a pain.

records.title: Very pleased with new custom fit irons…
records.text: Very pleased with new custom fit irons and drivers. Christian was very helpful. Delivery and addition of tape layer to grips took a long time , longer than expected. Communication dropped off I think due to length of delivery. Price was as advertised, given what I spent thought further discount could be offered ,  I asked. Bought shoes and bag elsewhere and saved £50.

records.title: Online ordering
records.text: Ordered a jacket from American golf, this got delivered to the wrong address, contacted American Golf, they arranged a refund.

records.title: Fitting.
records.text: Had a great fitting with Connor in the Plymouth store where I was fitted for some T200 irons, and some wedges! He explained everything thoroughly and this is showing with the results for my game.The customer service was excellent and am enjoying my new clubs.

records.title: Helpful assistant in the store
records.text: Helpful assistant in the store. I was looking for sketchers as this brand tends to fit better. Unfortunately the shoe colour I wanted was not in stock in the Aberdeen depo. The assistant looked at other American golf stores in UK for shoes in blue size (size 9) however without success. I settled for Grey colour which I previously have an identical pair. Little disappointing that AG didn’t have this colour and size in any of their UK Stores. Therefore slightly marked down rating.

records.title: Yes we travel some disrance and Always interesting to visit the store,
records.text: Always interesting to visit the store, sadly again, we are coming into winter so I was looking for winter trousers (FJs)... so only purchased balls and winter wet weather gloves, no quality winter trousers (FJs) my size or colour, I come to the store so I can try on sizes when buying trousers, didn't have my size ... and it's a 60 mile round trip,

records.title: Staff were very helpful and friendly
records.text: Staff were very helpful and friendly. Men's golf waterproof jackets had limited stock and limited sizes, which was a shame because I would have bought one. Only one jacket had waterproofing at 10,000mm saturation point.Also, poor range of equipment and clothing for women.I know everything is online now but I do like going to the shop to physically see and touch the items I buy. I am old school. Sorry. Many thanks.

records.title: Staff at your Chadwell Heath branch…
records.text: Staff at your Chadwell Heath branch very helpful in the purchase of items needed. Only downside was your advert for yellow or white balls. The yellow ball availability lacking in store. Something to review.

records.title: Happy customer
records.text: Chap who served me in the store was super helpful and offered advice on the product I was buying. If American Golf had been able to price match their competitors I would have went to 5 stars. Went ahead with the purchase anyway for ease and saved me having to order and collect elsewhere.

records.title: Little interaction
records.text: Friendly staff member. Little interaction in practice as I knew what I wanted and he found it on the shelf.Only docked one star because I had to wait around as staff were dealing with other customers and I felt that they could have at least acknowledged me.

records.title: Friendly guy in the shop
records.text: Friendly guy in the shop , I wasn’t dressed like your typical golfer , sometimes I find golf shops and driving range staff stuffy , unfriendly, elitist even . It’s like you don’t have the right to enjoy their game because you haven’t spent £1500 on clubs and £500 on clothes etc… but you still can hit the ball straighter than some of them. It was refreshing not to feel like that in AG . How it should be.🤘🏼

records.title: Glove purchase
records.text: Was in need of a new glove for a golfing holiday next week so popped into the store at CHX. I’ve worn FJ gloves and shoes for years and know my fit and trust the brand. Unfortunately there were no FJ XL summer gloves, I did try a L but it was too tight. I asked if they had any XL in stock but there wasn’t so I purchased an XL UA glove which felt fine, just haven’t had chance to try it out yet as my golf match today was cancelled. I live UA clothing, just hope their glove lives up to that standard

records.title: The staff member was so honest ,about…
records.text: The staff member was so honest ,about the footwear products your selling some from his own experience,and from feedback from dissatisfied customers whichI found refreshingly honest especially as he had no help with the stock held in sizes over 9+ on display.My size 11 actually found on display a new Addisas pair by your staff as I was about to leave empty handed much appreciated ,used my £40 voucher +£10 birthday gift from you happy days.

records.title: Stock issue
records.text: The store only had one part of the accessory I required. I was able to purchase an umbrella holder but sadly not the bracket that secures the holder to the trolly frame. The staff member was very good and very helpful, she kindly looked to see if the store could order it directly, but this was not possible. I subsequently had to order it on line, which has meant a delay in use.

records.title: Very helpful staff member.
records.text: Very helpful staff member.Disappointed that my American Golf card gave me no benefits - points, discounts or whatever! No point having one really

records.title: Bought coke sm10 50%f
records.text: Bought coke sm10 50%fKnew what the f stood for and was interested in the SM10 56% S wasn’t quite sure on what the S stood for and Carl didn’t either. He went away to clarify but I didn’t feel his explanation wasn’t convincing.I buy a lot of equipment from my pro shop at Enville GCAfter being given an AG voucher this was an opportunity for AG to shine good but not excellent

records.title: Loyalty should be rewarded at the till!
records.text: Great service and advice from John at Bird Hills. I’ve got exactly what I needed. I’d really appreciate a bit of a discount at the toll to reward my loyalty. Otherwise I might just sniff around AG stores and then go on-line.

records.title: Very knowledgeable staff who assisted…
records.text: Very knowledgeable staff who assisted me with my Putter fitting.I was impressed with the large selection of clubs on display, however slightly un impressed with selection of left handed putters

records.title: The sales assistant was very pleasant…
records.text: The sales assistant was very pleasant and chatty, however he omitted to suggest that I might need a further attachment to my golf umbrella holder.This I discovered when opening packing at home.

records.title: Good selection of equipment in the…
records.text: Good selection of equipment in the chandlers Ford store. however the staff were not very friendly and didn’t seem interested. Will not be returning in the future.

records.title: Shop v gift card Shop service fine but not happy that a…
records.text: Shop service fine but not happy that a gift card had only one year validation unlike other cards like one 4 all have a lot longer , £100 gained for no sales is a good profit the small print on the card could be more prominent . Going to specsavers to get some stronger glasses 👓

records.title: Not rocket science
records.text: I ordered something online, you took my payment, the bloke in the shop handed it to me when I collected it. Endless reminders to leave feedback - about what? A shopping transaction?How did I do with my review? Don’t forget to tell me, so I can improve my review next time.

records.title: Although there were no issues at all…
records.text: Although there were no issues at all with the customer service in the shop and I am happy with the product.  I was disappointed that I could only use my discount card (blue card) online.  This only encourages me to shop online and not visit the stalls.

records.title: Bought golf balls ,but they are all…
records.text: Bought golf balls ,but they are all behind counter , so I had to ask an assistant his opinion   All I got was these balls are good , ( 3 kinds ) never asked about swing speed etc .not the store it used to be seems different atmosphere for some reason

records.title: I liked that I received my message when…
records.text: I liked that I received my message when the driver was coming, I did not realize that knock and run was now an every day job, I have a perfectly working door bell which your failed to use also I have a very dry cupboard to put items in leaving it on at the front door on a main road is not so good either

records.title: Had to wait order was not ready
records.text: Had to wait order was not ready, would not match a better price from online store !!

records.title: The staff are great and helpfull but I…
records.text: The staff are great and helpfull but I find it extremely insulting and bad publicity after spending near on £50 you want an extortionate 65p for a bag

records.title: Unwanted Charity donation request
records.text: I’m not keen on being asked if I want to donate to charity after I’ve purchased something. I donate to several charities of my personal choice mainly for homeless. I think the Princes Trust does good work but is well supported. If you promoted a drug users rehabilitation charity or homelessness I’d be more likely to donate but these may not accord with your corporate image.

records.title: Buying a Putter
records.text: Asked about fitting and help picking a new putter and was told to just go hit a few to see which one I like.Was expecting a lot more than that.

records.title: Pretty PAR branch....
records.text: Store has again very little to offer women.....like most stores even though we were told their range was very broad. It isn't! The range is good. Staff seemed like it was an effort to be there. Didn't offer any information unless prompted.

records.title: When a customer approaches the sales…
records.text: When a customer approaches the sales desk acknowledge you’ve seen him. Good morning I’m busy just now I’ll be with you as soon as I can.I spent nearly 10 minutes waiting to speak with a member of staff. Communication is the number one necessity to keep your customers happy to wait.

records.title: Very disappointed with product range of women's shoes
records.text: My wife wanted some new golf shoes for her birthday so we visited our local AM golf in Lincoln. The choice was very disappointing, 2 pairs !!! The mens section must have had at least 20 . We decided to travel to the larger AM golf in Sheffield hoping to find a better range but once again the choice was very limited,probably 3 / 4 designs whilst the mens at least 20 We did purchase some Foot Joy shoes but my wife would have liked to have tried some others as per displayed on your website.

records.title: No one proactively to see if I needed…
records.text: No one proactively to see if I needed help. Also the sales assistant helping in the end did not seem to have clear idea of differences between the diffeerent shoes models and why the prices were different

records.title: Money talks
records.text: I get the impression that people shopping the lower priced equipment are not left feeling welcome

records.title: I had asked for a shirt to be put…
records.text: I had asked for a shirt to be put aside, after getting assurances that it would be there on my return. but when I got to the shop someone had sold it!! very annoying after having travelled a long way!

records.title: When visiting a store to use my £10…
records.text: When visiting a store to use my £10 birthday voucher,( thank you) , I discovered that the Nottingham store no longer caters for lady golfers. Why is this, I wonder, are we not as important as gentleman golfers.The very helpful staff explained that it was not the store’s decision, but management’s. Perhaps you would review your policy.

records.title: Store delivery…
records.text: I wanted a particular club said it could be with them by Tuesday, couldn't give me a date on the Tuesday. After complaining it eventually arrived Wednesday early evening. I could have a free 24 hour delivery from American golf. In future I will go online

records.title: Disinterested staff
records.text: Disinterested staff Did not engage Displays were boring so I had no desire to purchase

records.title: i was making quite a large list and…
records.text: i was making quite a large list and adding to my basket, then when i got to checkout i find out most of it was out of stock, perhaps have that before we get to checkout, i cancelled the rest of my items.

records.title: Great equipment,  Poor Service
records.text: Ordered new clubs online ( Cobra King Speedzone). Order was then cancelled 90 minutes later. Rang customer service who set you couldn't fulfill the order. Ckubs are still advertised on your website 5 days later?Went to your Bolton store and selected a different set. Cobra Kind ltdx.  Staff member just gave me the clubs, no box, no protective wrapping. When I asked if they had a box to transport them,  I was told they didn't have any. Very helpful. Staff seemed more interested trying to sell me more gear.Clubs themselves are great,  shame about the lack of customer service.

records.title: DO NOT BUY FROM THIS COMPANY ONLINE
records.text: DO NOT BUY FROM THIS COMPANY ONLINE. I ordered some ladies golf trousers according to the sizes given on the website as uk sizes. I normally have a 12 . However the measurements for a 10 looked more appropriate so I ordered those. They were still way too big! Must be American sizes even though it says UK size.I paid to get these delivered, I have to pay to send them back. Effectively, these have cost me £7 just to try on!!!Customer Service were not interested when I phoned them. DO NOT BUY FROM THIS COMPANY ONLINE

records.title: Don’t bother with online services
records.text: Don’t bother with online services. A putter ordered for husband’s birthday. Cancelled online order within an hour when found one in stock at a local AG store. Initially helpful and call taken by Daniella who cancelled the order and confirmed refund by e mail in 3-5 days for online cancellation. That was on 17th July. Now 30th July and still no refund despite e mails being sent as no longer can get through on phone.

records.title: Get fitted buy elsewhere
records.text: Interesting that the delivery times with American golf are so poor compared to others. Got fitted for driver and irons which was all goodHowever, they then quote 4 weeks for delivery!!!Take the fitting info and go to another retailer and they quote either next day or 5 days.Answer is simple, get fitted at AG and then buy elsewhere

records.title: umbrellas poor quality & along with gloves very overpriced
records.text: umbrellas overpriced & poor quality. 1 benross one failed during early use in 2023, handle seperated from foam surround in wind and spoke broke when it hit the ground - no durability. this was replaced with an identical one. this however also failed within a year when the internal wire holding the spokes together at the top just broke of its own accord. Now trying a Wilson tour one which looks better made, but time will tell. Most umbrellas look to be of same manufacture with just different branding. gloves way too expensive. full cabretta leather ones available online for under £3 from other retailers.

records.title: I ordered some shoes
records.text: I ordered some shoes, clothing and accessories 2 weeks ago to collect from in store I went in a few days later and they were very vague about the order but said to wait for notification I had notification that some of the order was in but no idea when the rest would be I spent over £100 I submitted a request on the website over a week ago requesting an update but no response , the virtual help is useless Very Poor customer service there is no phone number to speak to so left in limbo I only used American Golf because I had a voucher but very dissatisfied and will be using alternative in the future I am still missing my golf shoes I have heard from American golf and they said that the 2 main items I wanted ( shoes and socks ) were not available and offered a refund and when I pointed out that I only ordered the other items to use up the voucher they gave me a full refund . However I have just been on the website site and it shows the items available in my size which is confusing to say the least

records.title: Have to say staff seemed quite…
records.text: Have to say staff seemed quite disinterested,  maybe a long day?I purchased a golf shirt at full price, the realised later that the shirts were 2 for £40. At no point did the staff offer me the discount or suggest a deal was on offer. Poor customer experience I'm afraid

records.title: Trying the Titleist GT2 driver at the…
records.text: Trying the Titleist GT2 driver at the driving bay I was hitting the ball 10-15 yards further than my TaylorMade. On buying the club I was told that the shaft would be similar. On the golf course I found that on average i was only getting 3 yards extra distance. I returned to the range and asked to compare shafts, which was refused as I had played 4 rounds with the club. Neither the club or shaft could be changed. The extra distance I sought was not there leaving me very disappointed for the expensive cost of the driver.

records.title: No left handed equipment
records.text: Staff were great, informative and helpful.I will return for a fitting. Only giving two stars because you don’t carry any left handed equipment, except a very small  selection of gloves.There are many left handers out there!

description:
Founded in 2010 by Alan and Juliet Barratt, Grenade’s mission was simple: to create an iconic weight-management product and become THE brand within Sports Nutrition. 


Grenade’s first product was so effective, a friend described it as explosive, “like a grenade”. This product became Thermo Detonator and the brand name, Grenade, was born. 


Today, Grenade is available in over 80 countries, with a multi award-winning product range, including our best-selling Protein Bars and cutting-edge sports nutrition, we have you covered.

 
GRENADE HOMEPAGE 
 
BEST SELLERS 
 PROTEIN BARS 
 SPORTS NUTRITION 
 GRENADE OREO

records.title: Amazing service & great product
records.text: Amazing service, ordered late Boxing Day and arrived following day. Not only that but the product is excellent. Being a diabetic I can eat the bars without causing a rise in blood sugar which is a major plus

records.title: Swift and Effortless with Grenade
records.text: Swift and accurate service from Grenade. Browsing the web was smooth and effortless. Paying for the product was a breeze also and they kept me informed from time of purchase to time of delivery.

records.title: Having had an initial bad experience…
records.text: Having had an initial bad experience with customer services; had a missing product in my delivery & having complained twice, I finally had a really nice email from Grenade. I only had one box missing from my initial order but they sent me quite a few extra boxes free of charge - thank you Grenade - really appreciated - Merry Christmas

records.title: Don’t think there’s a better protein…
records.text: Don’t think there’s a better protein bar on the market! Always get great service with quick delivery

records.title: Swift delivery plus great deals
records.text: Swift delivery plus great deals in the Boxing Day sales 🥳

records.title: Absolute great protein bar
records.text: Absolute great protein bar, so much I bought 4 boxes. Thank you for the free gift, much appreciated

records.title: I find it really easy to order items, great choice
records.text: I find it really easy to order items, there were some special money saving offers and the delivery was really quick a very efficient service.

records.title: Great tasting bars
records.text: Super easy to order. Quick delivery and the bars taste amazing! (Flavours tried are Oreo, Cookie Dough and Gingerbread).

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, as usual. This order was INCREDIBLE value for money, with the offer bars Oreo bars worked out at about £1.00. That said buying direct from Grenade is always much better value than buying in a shop. Next day delivery is also a great plus.

records.title: After my 1st order going awol
records.text: After my 1st order going awol. Grenade reordered & sent me a new order. Big thank you to them for sorting it out. The oreo & white chocolate bars a lovely😋😋.

records.title: Great delivery of the full order and…
records.text: Great delivery of the full order and usual high standard product with the grenade protein barsDisappointed in the range of protein powders now, seems to have reduced drastically so unfortunately be buying elsewhere for meal replacements and protein powders going forward

records.title: Easy to order and quick delivery
records.text: Easy to order and quick delivery. Box was a little oversized for what was in it.

records.title: Issues with missing items
records.text: Ordered 5 items on next day delivery, took over a week to be delivered and only 4 items in box. Missing a full box of protein bars at £18. Wasn’t getting anywhere with customer services initially but now received response and posting missing item out.

records.title: Really great service of buying and…
records.text: Really great service of buying and packing to delivery

records.title: Great products / substitutes could be better
records.text: I really enjoy the taste of your products, however when I ordered this time, I received a box of ginger bread flavour instead of the caramel chaos I ordered. When I placed the order, it said that caramel chaos was in stock and so didn’t expect a substitute flavour and especially one which will not taste very close. I have emailed customer services and am waiting on a reply but perhaps if you are going to substitute, keep it as close to the original as possible. Other than that I am happy with the products, the deals are very good and I suspect one day soon you’ll bring out some additional products like low calorie syrups or sauces. This is only a 4* review based on my most recent experience and would have been 5* if maybe a note was put in the box or I was sent an email about the substitute flavour.

records.title: Love the taste
records.text: Love the taste, fast delivery, looking forward to using my advent calendar. Like the discount from loyalty points. Expiry Date on the other bars I paid for not very far away. Will keep buying though.

records.title: False advertising and expired product…eventually sorted
records.text: “ False advertising and expired product sold at 95% rrp disguised as a top offer won’t bother again really”Since the initial review you have now rectified the issue and replaced the missing box - first person i was in contact to was adamant to resolve the problem but second has sorted it -ammended the review

records.title: I really enjoy the numerous flavours…
records.text: I really enjoy the numerous flavours and so glad they are high protein and low sugar however I think there should be more fibre to make them even more beneficial

records.title: Great service but flavour not so much
records.text: First time of purchasing the bars good deal on free box but bought new flavours but wasn’t impressed.The mint bars are like cleaning your teeth very disappointed with the flavour.The lemon cheesecake ones are lovely.Service is great efficient and on time but need other new flavours.

records.title: Feels like Grenade have lost their way a bit
records.text: The products still taste great and if you shop around good deals can be found, but generally the products are quite steep for today's competitive market. Grenade currently seems so fixated on getting the protein bars on every shelf in every store in every country that the other ranges seem to have taken a back seat. The ranges have shrunk, not many flavours to choose from, not many varieties for different budgets. Please put some effort back into the other products now, the bars are everywhere.  I would always choose Grenade over the other market leaders, MP, better quality and MP will find other ways to deplete you of your money through sneaky subscription scams and price hikes. Grenade is at least transparent on pricing, and IMO a better quality product. Also customer service at Grenade puts the service at MP in the shadows. I'd just like them to not lose their way.

records.title: Love the salted caramel bars
records.text: Love the salted caramel bars, the bundle pricing is good, always on the look out for an even better bargain vs supermarkets. Not as much consistency in some packs being available - like the small size salted caramel isn't always available.The bunker area is great and adds value, bur update it more and give more stock. Fast delivery is great and website easy to use.

records.title: Love grenade
records.text: Love grenade, love the taste, and the cost ordering directly in the bulk buys are so worth it.Only reason I’m rating it down, is for such a small order it came it the biggest box which I don’t think was needed.

records.title: Ordering was easy enough
records.text: Ordering was easy enough, although I was a bit put off by the countdown to get other bars on a time limited special offer. The actual advent calendar looks ok, but obviously it hasn’t been opened yet.

records.title: Great tasting snack
records.text: Had my eyes on the gingerbread bar for a week or so but found it sold out really quickly.Popped an alert on and managed to bag a box.Speedy service as always and no disappointment. Well worth the wait, great tasting and not too heavy on the stomach.20g protein but feel if I had to be picky that it's higher in calories than most other bars I get that can pack higher protein in. Anyway I'd still recommend these bars without hesitation You won't regret it!!

records.title: Products generally fine
records.text: Products generally fine. Had a few recently that were crushed in packaging but not in delivery box.Delivery lot are very random. Some leave outside flat door. Some retry delivery or send to drop box somewhere. Normally Matalan which needs queuing up for 5 mins to get seen, then another 5 whilst they look for the package. Yes, this seems like a gripe at delivery, but it is still all part of the service.

records.title: Recommend tasty treat watch the price please
records.text: Easy to order with rapid delivery and well packaged. Great taste in all the bars - especially enjoy mint, raspberry (lowest sugar content) and birthday bar has a great texture. Feels like you’re having a tasty treat yet managing intake. It got 4 stars rather than the 5 because without a special offer these are just too expensive !

records.title: Tasty product and superb fast delivery
records.text: Tasty product and superb fast delivery.  Slightly let down by short use-by-dates not advertised.  I bought some bars advertised with short use-by-dates so happy with the discount.  Some others purchased at the same time only had 4 more weeks use-by-date, but were not advertised as short dated.   These bars were advertised as special price but no mention of short dates. Worries me when I buy multiple boxes to last.Other than that, excellent product.

records.title: Grenade is one of the best company for…
records.text: Grenade is one of the best company for fitness & sports nutrition products. It's products prices are reasonable. Their high protein bars & spreads taste very good. Fat burners etc. do actually work. Overall very good experience.

records.title: Short best before dates, poor customer service
records.text: Update 26.6.24 - Correct box now received, thanks. Ordered 4 for £80 protein bar bundle, 1 box defaulted to a random BBEJune’24 selection box during checkout, no response to my emails requesting the correct bars. Several of the boxes were BBEJuly’24 also, will buy elsewhere from now on.

records.title: Great delivery time
records.text: Great delivery time. Great options for protein bars.It would be great if there were always the snack size bars in stock as these are the best size for me.Oreo and white chocolate oreo are the best!

records.title: I ordered three boxes, only got two
records.text: I ordered three boxes, only two arrived. I sent photos of the big box and its weight etc for Customer Service to take up the issue with the Warehouse and four days later I am still awaiting a response, and a resolution to the problem

records.title: Prompt delivery but bad dates
records.text: Prompt delivery but disappointed that the oreo bar 'best before' date is end of December this year. Expensive items, regardless of any deals, so would expect a longer date on them!

records.title: I asked multiple times whether the…
records.text: I asked multiple times whether the protein powder is suitable for a halal diet (or at least a vegetarian diet) and was instead told the protein bars are halal certified

records.title: Great delivery however product is vile
records.text: Great delivery however product is vile! Unfortunately one of the worst tasting pre work outs I have bought with limited punch.

records.title: The Oreo Protein Bars are awful
records.text: The Oreo Protein Bars are awful. Soft, mushy texture and flavourless. Really unpleasant. The salted caramel spread on the other hand is surprising delicious on a toasted crumpet… or toast, or similar, very nice flavour!!!

records.title: Only part of the offer was dispatched
records.text: Only part of the offer was dispatched. When emailed they did send rest of the order but did not receive for several days when it is meant to be next day delivery. I had sent pictures of one box that was damaged and asked a question about whether it was meant to be in plastic like the other box. No response given. I was sent a follow up email to ask if happy. Wrote back repeating the question and no response.

records.title: Short dated product
records.text: Communication was good,  product dispatched and arrived quickly. However the grenade bars are short dated, as they were purchased as a Christmas present and all 4 boxes expire January 2025. This should have been made clear before purchase.

records.title: The advent calendar looks great. But…
records.text: The advent calendar looks great, and I was excited for my discounted box of white chocolate Oreo bars. Until they arrived and I realised they were manufactured in 2023, with a BBE of November 2024. Which I guess was the actual reason you were selling them, as opposed to a Black Friday deal like you advertised… Once again, another BF deal that is just more about shifting old warehouse stock… Pretty disappointed.

records.title: It's a shame.......
records.text: Usally great but the last two couple of times i have had an order issue (parcel not delivered but payment taken). This waa eventaully resolved as i got in touch after aboyt a week and grenade were very apologetic.  Then last time i have had the wrong items sent. I have contacted grenade but i am still awaiting a solution and have only had an automated reply saying high volume of emails so they will be in touch with 3-5days. It's been 5 days and i am awaiting a response.

records.title: Concerned about delivery and customer services
records.text: The quality of the protein bars is superb. Customer services not so much. They use DPD to deliver their products and the driver delivered it to the wrong address. When I emailed Grenade, they blamed me for the putting the wrong address which wasn't true and then ignored me for two days when I asked them for a refund. I like their protein but I am concerned about ordering anything again if that's how customers get treated

records.title: Delivery is no longer next day and…
records.text: Delivery is no longer next day and delays are becoming more prevalent. (Another delay today) Frustrating especially when you spend more to eliminate the cost of delivery to have next day

records.title: Disappointing customer service
records.text: I purchase regularly from Grenade as well all enjoy the grenade bars and ready to drink protein ..however, an order I placed last week when delivered was missing one item ..., protein shakes...and included a jar of protein spread I hadn't ordered!!... I sent an e mail immediately and was advised to take a photo of the delivery label which I did and the matter would be looked into...after a couple of days I hadn't heard a thing and had to chase up with another email...the correct product is being delivered today thankfully but I feel the situation could have been resolved much quicker had there been a customer service telephone line...I've been disappointed but will continue to purchase from Grenade and hope the aforementioned issue was a rarity

records.title: Excellent service but loyalty system is impossible to navigate.
records.text: Easy to order products and very speedy delivery. However, I ALWAYS find it impossible to redeem the loyalty points. PLEASE make this system easier.

records.title: No stock
records.text: No stock of the ready made protein shakes on line or on retailers. Had to buy a bulk powder which is overly sweet even for my sweet tooth. Fudged Up flavour

records.title: Good but bad
records.text: They are absolutely amazing, taste good and have great macros. The reason why it’s so low is because they are so damn expensive. However nice and good they are I still can’t bring myself to buy them.

records.title: Advent calendar
records.text: Brought the advent calendar very disappointed.  Thought it would be the same as last year. Same price for half the amount.Note to always read the product description.

records.title: JaffaQuake was disappointing
records.text: JaffaQuake was disappointing, way too sweet for me and I have a very sweet tooth Salted caramel however is the best

records.title: Fairly good value if you bulk order and…
records.text: Fairly good value if you bulk order and really tasty protein bars.  However, I was disappointed with the supposed '20% off first order' that lures you in initially.  After I tried this discount code that was emailed to me, it didn't work, so I emailed this query to Grenade - I was supposed to hear back within 3-5 working days.  To date, I still haven't heard back!  So, my impression of their customer service and after sales care, is not great...  This is something they need to focus on, if they want to keep customers, encourage loyalty and repeat business/orders!

records.title: The last two orders placed have not…
records.text: The last two orders placed have not been delivered and no updates provided until I contacted customer services. Each time being advised that the orders experienced a processing delay. Not sure if I would have been advised without having to contact customer services.

records.title: I still haven't received my package
records.text: I still haven't received my package. I'd like it if Grenade used a more competent delivery company than DPD.They lied and said they couldn't find my house, but i know they never even came to my town.Now they're just holding it at the depot with no updates. I can only assume that my protein bars will be past their best-before by the time they arrive. Please use Royal Mail or something. Not Evri though.

records.title: I have been sent the wrong item
records.text: I have been sent the wrong item. Now I don’t have the correct gift to give for Xmas. I do not wish to reorder and pay for delivery again when my issue has still not been acknowledged and payment has been taken.

records.title: Deceptive Bait + Switch Rewards
records.text: Deceptive Rewards I've accrued about £50 in rewards from Grenade.  They are impossible to redeem.  Even though it says "Redeeming your points is easy! Just click Redeem My Points, and select an eligible reward."   Feels very sneaky when they do this.  I've contacted support but no reply.  No small print either to explain why I can't redeem them - just a huge bait and switch.

records.title: Beware of close to expiry date
records.text: I decided to order directly from Grenade as I realised that the boxes via Amazon were very close to the expiry date upon receipt. Which definitely affects the taste heavily.So I was completely taken aback that all cases that were send to me are rather old / close to expiry date. With 2 out of 6 boxes expiring the same month as receipt.Emailed customer service 6 days ago to see if we can do something, no response to date. All just very meh.

records.title: Next Day delivery took a week, then the order was wrong
records.text: Next day delivery took a week, then the order was wrong - one item was missing. It took me three separate messages to customer service for them to look into it before I actually got my order sent out. When it arrived it was missing an item that was then sent in a different delivery. We got there in the end, but the service wasn't good.For what it's worth the products taste really good.

records.title: Protein shakes out of stock everywhere
records.text: I asked about there being no stock of protein shakes anywhere, in shops or online, and just got the brush off. Are they being discontinued? No info at all. To be fair to Grenade, there are no good alternatives, hence this isn’t one star.

records.title: Cookie dough bars very dry tasting
records.text: Cookie dough bars very dry tasting, free gift expires this month, not good when all the others are the same.

records.title: Didn't get a email notification on…
records.text: Didn't get a email notification on orderIt took 5 days for.dpd to deliver You have virtually no stock most items are sold out

records.title: Great tasting bars
records.text: Great tasting bars. First order was missing 3 boxes. (Rectified by customer services) 👍second order ...Still waiting for my next day delivery 3 days later unfortunately.

records.title: Wrong address delivered don’t care
records.text: My next day delivery was delivered to the wrong house by DPD - they sent a photo and it isn’t my front door. I can’t even find the house on my street. When I complained (within an hour of delivery) DPD said I had to contact Grenade to open a complaint. I have now completed the contact form 4x and all I get are apparently auto generated messages, the first two said something like ‘Once you place your order it is too late to change your address’ I gave them the correct address. No human is reading these messages, and I don’t have faith they have capacity to deal with things going wrong. I have paid £55 for the goods that I haven’t received and so far no indication that they can be bothered to help.UPDATE: In 3 days I did receive a human response and a new package was delivered & received, so I have given 2 stars instead of 1. If I had been told at my first contact someone was going to review and help me, I would not have worried. It was the auto-message that hadn’t responded appropriately and implied the mistake was all my fault, case closed, that caused me to escalate the situation.

records.title: It’s the 2nd time in a few months I’ve…
records.text: It’s the 2nd time in a few months I’ve had to chase up an order that wasn’t processed. I received a ‘next day delivery’ order 9 days late. I expressed my disappointment to customer services but they didn’t respond.

description: Nevisport is the UK's premier outdoor store. Find everything you need for camping, hiking, skiing, climbing and more. Buy online or from one of our nationwide stores.

records.title: Fantastic Service!
records.text: There was an error in my address from my online order. A polite, thoughtful lady rang me to check it and ensure it arrived correctly and in time for Christmas. Thank you so much!

records.title: It was a Christmas present delivery was…
records.text: It was a Christmas present delivery was first class and the jacket was awesome everything was great will definitely be buying again 👍

records.title: Xmas present shopping
records.text: Ordered present for my partner for Xmas. Good quality clothing with easy and efficient online ordering

records.title: Really quick delivery
records.text: Really quick delivery - ordered just before Christmas and it arrived in time, and a good price.

records.title: Excellent quality coat at the best…
records.text: Excellent quality coat at the best price by far. Delivered quickly, with payment options and good communication. Would definitely recommend 👌

records.title: I would use Nevisport again
records.text: Ordered a coat for a present, it came on timeDelivery was goodVery pleased with the coat, fit and colour as expected

records.title: Fast delivery and lovely bag ordered…
records.text: Fast delivery and lovely bag ordered and dispatched faster than expected

records.title: Unbelievable service
records.text: Unbelievable service. Placed order at 8pm Wednesday. Delivered Friday afternoon. Fantastic service at the busiest time of year. Website easy to navigate. To place orders is simple. Keep up the great work.

records.title: Would recomend
records.text: Great products and fantastic all round service provided.

records.title: Smooth transaction …
records.text: Smooth transaction from start to finish and very good price

records.title: The product was fine and what I ordered…
records.text: The product was fine and what I ordered but the box it came in looked like it had been under a bus

records.title: 2nd time ordering
records.text: 2nd time ordering. 1st item out of stock but took them 5 days to advise. Reordered same item in a different colour. No hassle this time , apart from confusing messages regarding dispatch of the item that had already been delivered.

records.title: Great quality products
records.text: Great quality products, as described. Would have given 5* dispatch and delivery had been within the timeframe stated or communication had taken place to relay that there was a delay. Thank you, though, for sorting promptly, once I’d logged a query.

records.title: Dispatch took longer than expected but…
records.text: Dispatch took longer than expected but good communication and great product. Thule day sack

records.title: Ordered a Rab jacket it came but…
records.text: Ordered a Rab Mens Mythic  Alpine Light Down Jacket it came quickly but unfortunately it had very poor stitching along the zip and was very noticeable. Called customer service and sent email with pics attached. Rab have gone down hill in their quality control or the jacket is a second. Im a bit disappointed as this was an nice looking jacket and I had to get the duffer , no replacement wanted, will send back via label provided by customer service.

records.title: I ordered 2 womens wet suit
records.text: I ordered 2 womens wet suit, sadly the first one was too small, the second arrived damaged, someone I think had previously tried on but not stopped when it obviously wasn't going to fit, so hand tears and nail marks of trying to pull it on.  Poor quality control before sending. However, this was turned round by the excellent customer service of John Cumming, who apologised, sent a returns label and will send a replacement or full refund. Would definitely recommend and use again

records.title: Ordering was easy and item arrived…
records.text: Ordering was easy and item arrived quickly and well packaged. Can't give 5 stars as I ordered a jacket in 2 sizes and one was cancelled, I have an issue with websites making things available when they aren't in stock. Unfortunately the size I received wasn't right. I was able to return to the Middlesborough store (not all store will accept web orders, check website) where it was sorted out and a refund was back in my account within a couple of days.

records.title: Great coat and value for money but the…
records.text: Great coat and value for money but the coat measurement I received did not match the stated website measurement. I have returned the coat for a larger replacement and a refund of my postage.

records.title: Great quality products at reasonable…
records.text: Great quality products at reasonable prices. The website has a few glitches and the photos and descriptions could be more detailed hence the four stars. Delivery separated in a number of parcels but all arrived in good time. Thanks!

records.title: Good service an a good price
records.text: Good service an a good price. Shipping was quick and with a reliable courier.

records.title: Mixed
records.text: Saarah, at customer service phone call very helpful and updated me right on time.The Parcelforce driver on my girlfriends birthday lied on the tracker about attempting delivery so my girlfriend had no present to open from me but the second delivery driver the next day- might I add, not the same driver as listed on the tracker on the first day. When delivery happed that driver was great

records.title: RAB coat at a great price…
records.text: Purchased a RAB coat at a great price but delivery was very slow, so 4 stars given for that reason.

records.title: Good but …
records.text: Good but …Nevisport excellent. But DHL failed to provide code so I could get delivery from local newsagent. Had to ring DHL customer service to get code. Result: Delivery several days late!

records.title: Nevisport are very competitive in the…
records.text: Nevisport are very competitive in the clothing market which makes their products great value. I marked them down as the product did not match what I ordered exactly.

records.title: Redemption of reputation after long delay
records.text: UPDATED ON 1/3/24.  Nevisport have redeemed themselves today.  Finally an email arrived asking me to post the boots back.  Within a day of receipt Grace telephoned me to say they had tested and were issuing an immediate refund.  Wow, an actual telephone call from an actual person, how nice!  She also checked stock and chatted about possible alternative boots.  I am hoping they can now keep this service up.  Disappointed with the long delay in hearing back from them but appreciate the great service today.

records.title: Great product and service from…
records.text: Great product and service from Nevisport. However, let down by the bad service from the delivery service. I had to email the company to release the parcel and send it as it had become 'stuck' in a depot.

records.title: Great product but was missing an item
records.text: Great product but was missing an item. Customer service was great and quickly sourced it for me and had it sent directly from the manufacturer

records.title: Good Company
records.text: Although product and service very good, the jacket ordered was too small but no fault of the company.The only negative was the expensive p & P as I had to also pay to return

records.title: Prompt accurate delivery of order
records.text: Prompt accurate delivery of order. Value for money on the product I purchased. Would have been 5 if they had kept me up to date regarding a return I made.

records.title: Sent the order out quickly
records.text: Sent the order out quickly. Item didn’t fit, sent it back and they acknowledged and refunded fast. My only issue is no one answers the customer support number and they are not great on responding to emails. However it was Xmas. They are a legit company and would be happy to use them again. Just wish they can step up the customer service response via phone and email.

records.title: Whilst the product had new tags on it
records.text: Whilst the product had new tags on it - the way the package was packed left me doubting if this was a legitimate company- The item was stuffed into a nevis spirt carrier bag and put into a grey plastic sac that had clearly been used before as it was sealed with copious amounts of brown parcel tape. Very difficult to unwrap and had to use scissors which easily could have cut the item inside. That said there are no issues with the item.

records.title: Asked for my order made on 7th Dec to…
records.text: Asked for my order made on 7th Dec to be delivered by Thursday 12th (today) but no response nor number to call nor response to customer services email enquiry...worried it's not a legitimate business when all goes quiet.

records.title: Lacking in Customer Service
records.text: Quick to dispatch, service let down by Parcel Force by two failed deliveries which I am still attempting to resolve. However, I contacted Nevisport Customer Services to help with the issues I was having and was promised a redirection which didn’t happen so I am still waiting for Customer Service to help. I have now arranged a redirection after numerous emails, telephone call and additional expense myself.

records.title: Item as expected but
records.text: Item as expected. Delivery promise not met due to courier delivering about. 25 mile away. Photo was pin location and was in a field. DHL did get courier to fix it and parcel arrived two days later.

records.title: wellingtons scuffed & looks blistered…
records.text: wellingtons scuffed & looks blistered in places, not sure if it is glue causing this appearance. These wellingtons are one of many things on my daughters xmas wish list. Return cost is not cheap. Although if returned via Asda is £3. My nearest Asda is roughly 45 minutes  drive if lucky with traffic. So not happy.

records.title: Nevisport sent the wrong item
records.text: Nevisport sent the wrong item . Lots of unnecessary hassle for me in the returns process . Wish I had purchased from someone with better stock control systems . Edited after Nevisport reply to say , yes, i was provided with an emailed returns label BUT you need to own a printer to use that so that requires ringing round to find someone to help .Then Nevisport dont use a pick up returns courier so its a trip in the car to find a post office . As i said hassle associated with Nevisports mistake.

records.title: Palmed off with a substandard product
records.text: Bought two packs of saxx underwear online for my other half. Disappointed to see that one of the packs sent had clearly been previously ripped open and one of the pairs had been removed and then half-heartedly stuffed back into the box. Not impressed that I was palmed off with this product that I clearly would not have picked if I'd been in store

records.title: Product good service poor
records.text: I was informed by e Mail , that when the goods were shipped, I would receive info on delivery. I received no communications and missed the delivery.Product good service poor

records.title: Delayed delivery
records.text: Initial review amended as Nevis Sport did reply to my query by email after being unsuccessful in calling them. Order as expected and just in time for a trip. It was 11 days from order before delivery however. I would suggest some form of contact if delay is inevitable.

records.title: terrible customer service
records.text: I made an order on Monday 4th December with the intention of receiving it before Thursday 14th December with the 3-7 business day delivery time. I feel this is acceptable.Now Thursday 7th and had no communication regarding dispatch. Website says "order being prepared" since Monday.Tried calling customer service which is apparently open mon-fri. No answer. Sent 4 emails. no answer.From a customer service perspective this website is terrible. I would not order from here. No option to cancel order either.EDIT: It has been dispatched on the 7th and is due to arrive today. I will give them the benefit of the doubt. I found out that they could have been snowed out of the head office but they could have at least advertised that somewhere. Also no response to emails or anything.

records.title: Just Acceptable Would use again customer service decent enough..
records.text: Cheap enough items but had to make 2 seperate phone calls on different days to find out where my orders where as parcelforce website was not recognising the tracking numbers because they were not sent out at time of recieving the tracking numbers ie but about 8 days later or nine they showed up so all in all ok.

records.title: Average experience
records.text: Average experience, order took some time to arrive making me think Nevisport didn’t actually have the item in stock?

records.title: No updates provided after order placed…
records.text: No updates provided after order placed until item had already been delivered. Ticket raised querying the order was not responded to in the time indicated and again not until the item had been delivered.

records.title: Failed to put the correct address on so…
records.text: Failed to put the correct address on so the order could not be delivered. This was eventually rectified through contact with Support.

records.title: Great prices, TERRIBLE customer service
records.text: Ordered about £85 worth of items. 5x items total. Nevisport split into 2 deliveries. One of which took 7 days to arrive via DHL!!!. One shipment contained correct items. Other shipment contained 2x items one of which they stated weren't in stock and refunded me. One item STILL missing a week later. No contact from Nevisport a week on and no resolution. Awful customer service and it seems the warehouse staff cannot tell the difference between a pair of jogging bottoms and a beanie hat. Avoid - despite their cheap prices you'll wait an age for delivery and there's no guarantee you'll get what you asked for. Then if you try to contact them , they'll just ignore you. AVOID. Just use Amazon!!

records.title: Too slow posting items out for…
records.text: Too slow posting items out for Christmas. Customer service unhelpful. Don't rush themselves even if you need it for a present. Won't order again

records.title: worried and disappointed
records.text: I ordered a £200 down jacket and have had nothing but worry waiting for the item to be delivered by DHL . There is confusing messaging from both Nevisport and DHL and I wish I'd never ordered the item .

records.title: Ordered Yeti wine cups and something…
records.text: Ordered Yeti wine cups and something completely different turned up.  On the positive (hence 2 stars and not one) the customer services were very helpful.  But still missed out purchasing the same item elsewhere in the sales.

records.title: Very poor experience
records.text: Ordered a jacket and headband, both in stock on website. Received headband, no jacket and no explanation or email. Rang to be told they were sourcing one from a store. Next day received email saying that no longer available so will issue a refund. Checked website and jacket still states it’s available to buy when it clearly is not! Will not purchase from website again all the messing about and lack of customer service.

records.title: Great prices, great products terrible eComm
records.text: Great range of products at great prices, but stock management and the post order process leaves a lot to be desired. Order & dispatch emails are useless and provide no info, left with me to chase to understand what was actually happening with my order. 4 coats ordered, 1 delivered automatically, 1 missing due to lack of stock, 2 others delivered once chased.

records.title: Sent the wrong item
records.text: Ordered a pair of Atomic ski boots, disappointing to see that someone had switched the boots to a similar pair (same colour, lower spec). Packaging looked battered. Have initiated contact with customer service, I called but was instructed to send an email. Apparently they don't work on weekends so it looks like this is going to take at least several days to sort out. I will update with their response/resolution but looking at others with a similar experience it looks like I'll be the one having to find somewhere to drop off the package at my expense.

records.title: Bought two coats both delivered…
records.text: Bought two coats both delivered separately. First one ok second was poor full of marks and stains not convinced that it’s even new. Reported to the company and free postage label sent out.
